template<typename T>
T* AActor::GetChildComponentByClass(UClass* class_)
{

  FName Decryption (Updated 12.07)

 Text encryption has been updated for Patch 12.07. Here's the new setup with HVCI support:

  Code:
```
uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
{
const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
uint64_t val = state[idx];
const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
const uint32_t m7 = (uint32_t)idx % 7;

auto lfsr1 = [](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
    return (x >> 1) ^ ((x >> 1) ^ (2 * x)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
};

auto bitrev_ror32 = [&](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
    uint64_t a = lfsr1(x);
    uint64_t b = (a >> 2) ^ ((a >> 2) ^ (4 * a)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
    uint64_t c = (b >> 4) ^ ((b >> 4) ^ (16 * b)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
    uint64_t d = (c >> 8) ^ ((c >> 8) ^ (c << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
    return _rotr64(d, 32);
};

auto rotr63 = [](uint64_t x, uint32_t r) -> uint64_t {
    uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
    return (x >> s) | (x << (64 - s));
};

if (m7 == 0) {
    val = bitrev_ror32(lfsr1(bitrev_ror32(val)));
}
else if (m7 == 1) {
    val = rotr63(~val, hi + (uint32_t)idx);
}
else if (m7 == 2) {
    val = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) ^ (val - (uint32_t)(hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx));
}
else if (m7 == 3) {
    val = ~rotr63(val, hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx);
}
else if (m7 == 4) {
    val = ~bitrev_ror32(val);
}
else if (m7 == 5) {
    val = lfsr1(~val);
}
else {
    val = (uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) + bitrev_ror32(val);
}

return val ^ key;
}
```
  [NEW] Agent Name Extraction / ESP

 Use KismetSystemLibrary to grab the object name and map it to the proper Agent string.

 Get Object Name Function:
  Code:
```
FString get_object_name(UObject* obj)
{
auto function_name = (L"Engine.KismetSystemLibrary.GetObjectName");
static UObject* functions;
if (!functions)
functions = UObject::StaticFindObject(nullptr, nullptr, function_name, false);

struct
{
    UObject* obj;
    FString out;
} Args;

Args.obj = obj;
functions->ProcessEvent(static_class(), functions, &Args);
return Args.out;
}
```

### Post #4400027 — slowlya — 1st June 2025, 01:11 PM

Code:
```
inline DWORD uworldState = 0x9F3F050;
inline DWORD uworldKey = 0x24A04C0;

__forceinline __int64 Decrypt_UWorld(const uint32_t key, const uintptr_t* state)
{
    if (state == nullptr) {
        return -1;
    }

    unsigned __int64 v19; // r11
    unsigned __int64 v20; // r8
    unsigned __int64 v21; // r9
    unsigned int v22; // er10
    unsigned __int64 v23; // rcx
    unsigned __int64 v24; // rdx
    unsigned __int64 v25; // rcx
    int v26; // ebx
    unsigned int v27; // ecx
    __int64 v28; // rax
    unsigned __int64 v29; // r8
    unsigned __int64 v30; // r8
    unsigned __int64 v31; // rcx
    unsigned __int64 v32; // rdx
    unsigned __int64 v33; // rcx

    v19 = 2685821657736338717i64
        * ((unsigned int)key ^ (unsigned int)(key << 25) ^ (((unsigned int)key ^ ((unsigned __int64)(unsigned int)key >> 15)) >> 12))
        % 7;

    if (v19 >= 7) {
        return -2;
    }

    v20 = state[v19];

    v21 = (2685821657736338717i64
        * ((unsigned int)key ^ (unsigned int)(key << 25) ^ (((unsigned int)key ^ ((unsigned __int64)(unsigned int)key >> 15)) >> 12))) >> 32;

    v22 = (unsigned int)v19 % 7;

    if (!((unsigned int)v19 % 7))
    {
        v23 = (2 * (v20 - (unsigned int)(v21 - 1))) ^ ((2 * (v20 - (unsigned int)(v21 - 1))) ^ ((v20
            - (unsigned int)(v21 - 1)) >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64;
        v24 = (4 * v23) ^ ((4 * v23) ^ (v23 >> 2)) & 0x3333333333333333i64;
        v25 = (16 * v24) ^ ((16 * v24) ^ (v24 >> 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0Fi64;
        v20 = __ROL8__((v25 << 8) ^ ((v25 << 8) ^ (v25 >> 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FFi64, 32);
    LABEL_26:
        v26 = 2 * v19;
        goto LABEL_27;
    }
    if (v22 != 1)
        goto LABEL_26;
    v26 = 2 * v19;
    v20 = __ROL8__(v20 - (unsigned int)(2 * v19 + v21), (unsigned __int8)(((int)v21 + (int)v19) % 0x3Fu) + 1);
LABEL_27:
    v27 = v26 + v21;
    if (v22 == 2)
        v20 = ~(v20 - v27);
    switch (v22)
    {
    case 3u:
        v28 = 2 * ((2 * v20) ^ ((2 * v20) ^ (v20 >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64);
        v20 = v28 ^ (v28 ^ (((2 * v20) ^ ((2 * v20) ^ (v20 >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64) >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64;
        break;
    case 4u:
        v29 = __ROR8__(v20, (unsigned __int8)(v27 % 0x3F) + 1);
        v20 = (2 * v29) ^ ((2 * v29) ^ (v29 >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64;
        break;
    case 5u:
        v30 = __ROR8__(v20, (unsigned __int8)(v27 % 0x3F) + 1);
        v31 = (2 * v30) ^ ((2 * v30) ^ (v30 >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64;
        v32 = (4 * v31) ^ ((4 * v31) ^ (v31 >> 2)) & 0x3333333333333333i64;
        v33 = (16 * v32) ^ ((16 * v32) ^ (v32 >> 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0Fi64;
        v20 = __ROL8__((v33 << 8) ^ ((v33 << 8) ^ (v33 >> 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FFi64, 32);
        break;
    case 6u:
        v20 = ~v20 - (unsigned int)(v21 + v19);
        break;
    }

    return v20 ^ (unsigned int)key;
}

inline auto decryptWorld(uintptr_t base_address) -> uintptr_t
{
    auto key = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(base_address + uworldKey);
    if (!key)
        return 0;

#pragma pack(push, 1)
    struct State {
        uint64_t Keys[7];
    };
#pragma pack(pop)
    auto state = *reinterpret_cast<State*>(base_address + uworldState);

    if (state.Keys[0] == 0)
        return 0;

    auto decrypt = Decrypt_UWorld(key, (uintptr_t*)&state);
    if (decrypt == -1 || decrypt == -2) return 0;

    auto decrypt_read = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(decrypt);
    return decrypt_read;
}
```

 void applyskinchanger(AAresEquippable* Equippable, UObject* SkinAsset, UObject* ChromaAsset, std::int32_t Level, UWorld* world)
 {

 inventory_manager* manager = ares_instance::get_ares_client_game_instance(world)->get_inventory_manager();

 auto ares_client_game_instance = ares_instance::get_ares_client_game_instance(world);
 auto v1 = *(uintptr_t*)(ares_client_game_instance + 0x360);
 auto v2 = *(uintptr_t*)(v1 + 0xB0);
 *(BYTE*)(v2 + 0x80) = 2;

 ContentLibrary::ClearWeaponComponents(Equippable);
 ContentLibrary::ApplySkin(Equippable, SkinAsset, ChromaAsset, Level, nullptr, -1);
 *(BYTE*)(v2 + 0x80) = 6;

 }

### Post #4412944 — rhaym — 20th June 2025, 12:05 AM

> **DoubleZocker:**
> Originally Posted by DoubleZocker   I want to make like a world esp kinda, but I dont have the newest FName decryption function.
>

Here's most readable decryption routine you can ever see
  Code:
```
#include <cstdint>
// 64-bit left rotation
inline uint64_t ROL8(uint64_t value, unsigned int shift) {
	const unsigned int mask = 63;
	shift &= mask;
	return (value << shift) | (value >> (64 - shift));
}

inline int64_t decryptXORKeys(const uint32_t key, const uintptr_t* state) {
    // Step 1.1: Compute the hash index and the high part from the key
    const uint32_t shifedKey = key << 25;
    const uint64_t mixedKey = 2685821657736338717i64 * ((unsigned int)key ^ shifedKey ^ (((unsigned int)key ^ ((uint64_t)(unsigned int)key >> 15)) >> 12)) % 7;
    const uint64_t hightPart = (2685821657736338717i64 * ((unsigned int)key ^ shifedKey ^ (((unsigned int)key ^ ((uint64_t)(unsigned int)key >> 15)) >> 12))) >> 32;
    const uint32_t index = (unsigned int)mixedKey % 7;

    // Step 1.2: Declare intermediate values
    uint32_t sumHighHashed, doubleHashed, sumHighDouble;

    // Step 1.3: Retrieve value from state array
    uint64_t value = state[mixedKey];

    // Step 2: Apply transformation based on index
    if (!index) { // Parity shuffle: Interleave bits
        int64_t temp = 2 * ((2 * value) ^ ((2 * value) ^ (value >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64);
        value = temp ^ (temp ^ (((2 * value) ^ ((2 * value) ^ (value >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64) >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64;
        goto SET_INTERMEDIATE_VARS;
    }

    if (index == 1) { // XOR with inverted sum and subtract adjusted sum
        doubleHashed = 2 * mixedKey;
        sumHighHashed = hightPart + mixedKey;
        value = ~(uint64_t)(unsigned int)(hightPart + mixedKey) ^ (value - (unsigned int)(hightPart + 2 * mixedKey));
    } else {
    SET_INTERMEDIATE_VARS:
        sumHighHashed = hightPart + mixedKey;
        doubleHashed = 2 * mixedKey;
    }

    if (index == 2) { // Parity shuffle followed by rotation
        value = ROL8((2 * value) ^ ((2 * value) ^ (value >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64, (uint8_t)(sumHighHashed % 0x3F) + 1);
        goto SET_SUM_HIGH_DOUBLE;
    }

    if (index == 3) { // Add and rotate
        sumHighDouble = hightPart + doubleHashed;
        value = ROL8((unsigned int)(hightPart + doubleHashed) + value, (uint8_t)(sumHighHashed % 0x3F) + 1);
    } else {
    SET_SUM_HIGH_DOUBLE:
        sumHighDouble = doubleHashed + hightPart;
    }

    if (index == 4) { // XOR with sum
        value ^= sumHighHashed;
    CHECK_FINAL_CASES:
        if (index == 6) { // Rotate and parity shuffle
            uint64_t temp = ROL8(value, (int8_t)(sumHighDouble % 0x3F) + 1);
            value = (2 * temp) ^ ((2 * temp) ^ (temp >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64;
        }
    } else {
        if (index != 5) // Adjust value with difference
            goto CHECK_FINAL_CASES;
        value += sumHighHashed - (uint64_t)sumHighDouble;
    }

    // Step 3: Final XOR with original key
    return static_cast<int64_t>(value ^ key);
}
```

>         goto SET_SUM_HIGH_DOUBLE;
>     }
>
>     if (index == 3) { // Add and rotate
>         sumHighDouble = hightPart + doubleHashed;
>         value = ROL8((unsigned int)(hightPart + doubleHashed) + value, (uint8_t)(sumHighHashed % 0x3F) + 1);
>     } else {
>     SET_SUM_HIGH_DOUBLE:
>         sumHighDouble = doubleHashed + hightPart;
>     }
>
>     if (index == 4) { // XOR with sum
>         value ^= sumHighHashed;
>     CHECK_FINAL_CASES:
>         if (index == 6) { // Rotate and parity shuffle
>             uint64_t temp = ROL8(value, (int8_t)(sumHighDouble % 0x3F) + 1);
>             value = (2 * temp) ^ ((2 * temp) ^ (temp >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64;
>         }
>     } else {
>         if (index != 5) // Adjust value with difference
>             goto CHECK_FINAL_CASES;
>         value += sumHighHashed - (uint64_t)sumHighDouble;
>     }
>
>     // Step 3: Final XOR with original key
>     return static_cast<int64_t>(value ^ key);
> }

### Post #4413263 — rhaym — 20th June 2025, 01:46 PM

> **DoubleZocker:**
> Originally Posted by DoubleZocker   could you maybe provide an example on how this gets used with FName, like decrypting the current Agent FName.

Man I hate spoonfeeding but this is too obvious, the function takes key and state

 to get FName you have to pass FName key and state pointers, this will return decrypted pointed to the FName

  Code:
```
uintptr_t key = vmread(base_addr + (Fname_State Offset + 0x38));
uintptr_t state = vmread(base_addr + Fname_State Offset);
uint64_t FnameKeyPointer = decryptXORKey(key, (uintptr_t*) &state);
uintptr_t FnameKey =  vmread(FnameKeyPointer);
```

  Code:
```
uintptr_t DecryptClonedCR3(uintptr_t cr3) {
	const uint8_t b = readvm(vgk_base_addr + 0x71C10);
	const uint64_t key = readvm(vgk_base_addr + 0x71CD0);

	const uint64_t inv_b = ~static_cast<uint64_t>(b);
	const uint64_t masked_and = static_cast<uint64_t>(b & cr3);
	const uint64_t masked_or = cr3 | inv_b;

	const int64_t term1 = (masked_and - masked_or);
	const int64_t term2 = (cr3 ^ b);
	const int64_t term3 = -2 * (b ^ (cr3 | b));
	const int64_t term4 = 2 * (((b | 0xE8ull) ^ 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFF17ull) + (~cr3 | (b ^ 0xE8ull)));
	const int64_t term5 = -static_cast<int64_t>(b ^ (~cr3 ^ 0xE8ull));
	const int64_t term6 = -3 * ~cr3;
	const int64_t term7 = -232;

	const int64_t multiplierA = term2 + term3 + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7;
	const uintptr_t v5 = (0x49B74B6480000000ull * cr3 + 0xC2D8B464B4418C6Cull * inv_b + 0x66B8CDC1FFFFFFFFull * b + 0x5C1FE6A2B4418C6Dull * term1) * multiplierA;
	const uint64_t innerMul = 0x13D0F34E00000000ull * cr3 + 0x483C4F8900000000ull;
	const uint64_t cr3MulInner = cr3 * innerMul;
	const uint64_t v6_part1 = ((cr3 ^ cr3MulInner) << 63);
	const uint64_t v6_part2 = cr3 * (0x7D90DC33C620C593ull * innerMul + 0x8000000000000000ull);
	const uint64_t term_cr3_qword = 0x55494E5B80000000ull * key + 0xC83B18136241A38Dull * ~key + 0xCE3CE5E180000000ull * ~cr3 + 0x72F1C9B7E241A38Dull * ((key | 0xE8ull) - (231ull - (key & 0xE8ull)));
	const uint64_t term_key_masked = 0x99BF7D2380CF6EC3ull * key + 0x664082DC7F30913Eull * (cr3 | b) + 0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ull * ~key + 0xE64082DC7F30913Eull * (~cr3 & ~static_cast<uint64_t>(b)) + ((cr3 + (b & (key ^ cr3)) + (key | b)) << 63);
	const uintptr_t v6 = v6_part1 + v6_part2 + (cr3 * term_cr3_qword + 0x71C31A1E80000000ull) * term_key_masked;
	const uint64_t common_expr = 0x8000000000000001ull * key + 0x2FDBF65F8A4AC9C9ull * cr3 + ((key ^ cr3) << 63) + 0x502409A075B53637ull * cr3;
	const uint64_t inner_expr = 0xFD90DC33C620C592ull * ~cr3MulInner + v6 + 0x2183995CC620C592ull;
	const uintptr_t result = 0x137FEEF6AB38CFB4ull * v5 + ((~v5 ^ ~(common_expr * inner_expr)) << 63) + 0x6C80110954C7304Dull * ((v5 & key) - (~key & ~v5) - key) - 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull * common_expr * inner_expr - 0x4F167C5CD4C7304Eull;
	return result;
}

uintptr_t DecryptClonedCR3(uintptr_t VGKBaseAddress) {
	uint64_t key = VGKBaseAddress + 0x7C150;
	uint64_t mask = VGKBaseAddress + 0x7C200 & 0x73;
	uint64_t cpu_id = cpuid_rax();
	uint64_t inv_key = ~key;

	uint64_t term1 = (mask & key) - (key | ~mask);
	uint64_t base_expr = 0x49B74B6480000000ull * key
		+ 0x66B8CDC1FFFFFFFFull * mask
		+ 0xC2D8B464B4418C6Cull * ~mask
		+ 0x5C1FE6A2B4418C6Dull * term1;

	int64_t modifier = -3 * ~key
		+ (mask ^ key)
		+ -2 * (mask ^ (mask | key))
		+ 2 * (((mask | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBull) ^ 0xC08E266D044D3314ull)
			+ (~key | (mask ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBull)))
		- (mask ^ ~key ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBull)
		- 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBull;

	uint64_t v13 = base_expr * modifier;
	uint64_t cr3_mul_expr = key * (0x13D0F34E00000000ull * key + 0x483C4F8900000000ull);
	uint64_t v15 = 0x7D90DC33C620C593ull * cr3_mul_expr;

	uint64_t term_cr3 = 0x55494E5B80000000ull * cpu_id
		+ 0xC83B18136241A38Dull * ~cpu_id
		+ 0xCE3CE5E180000000ull * ~key
		+ 0x72F1C9B7E241A38Dull * ((cpu_id | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBull) - (0x3F71D992FBB2CCEAll - (cpu_id & 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBull)));

	uint64_t term_key = 0x99BF7D2380CF6EC3ull * cpu_id
		+ 0x664082DC7F30913Eull * (mask | key)
		+ 0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ull * ~cpu_id
		+ 0xE64082DC7F30913Eull * (~key & ~mask)
		+ ((key + (mask & (key ^ cpu_id)) + (mask | cpu_id)) << 63);

	uint64_t inner_expr = v15
		+ 0xFD90DC33C620C592ull * ~cr3_mul_expr
		+ (key * term_cr3 + 0x71C31A1E80000000ull) * term_key
		+ 0x2183995CC620C592ull;

	uint64_t common_expr = 0x8000000000000001ull * cpu_id
		+ 0xAFDBF65F8A4AC9C9ull * ~key
		+ 0x2FDBF65F8A4AC9C9ull * (key + 1)
		+ (((key ^ cpu_id) << 63) ^ 0x8000000000000000ull);

	uint64_t result = 0x137FEEF6AB38CFB4ull * v13
		+ ((~v13 ^ ~(common_expr * inner_expr)) << 63)
		+ 0x6C80110954C7304Dull * ((cpu_id & v13) - (~cpu_id & ~v13) - cpu_id)
		- 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull * common_expr * inner_expr
		- 0x4F167C5CD4C7304Eull;

	return result;/*iblis.win*/
}
```

				}
			}
		}
	}

> Originally Posted by DoubleZocker   mhh okay, I was looking for returning like a string tho so I could compare that to "TimedBomb_C", I wanted to get a string from the id, but as I see that isnt the case with that xor_decryption.

  Code:
```
std::string resolveFNameFromID(uint32_t FNameID) {
	std::uintptr_t decryptionKey = getFNameKey(base_addr);

	uint32_t chunkIndex = FNameID >> 16;
	uint16_t nameOffset = FNameID & 0xFFFF;

	std::uintptr_t chunkPointerAddress = base_addr + 0xb4c0200 + ((chunkIndex + 2) * 8);
	std::uint64_t namePoolChunk = readvm(chunkPointerAddress);
	std::uintptr_t nameEntryAddress = namePoolChunk + (4 * nameOffset);

	FNameEntry entry = readvm(nameEntryAddress);
	auto& encryptedName = entry.GetAnsiName();

	const uint8_t* keyBytes = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&decryptionKey);
	for (uint16_t i = 0; i < entry.Header.Len; ++i) {
		encryptedName[i] ^= entry.Header.Len ^ keyBytes[i & 3];
	}

	return std::string(encryptedName, entry.Header.Len);
}
```
  use:
  Code:
```
if (resolveFNameFromID(actor->FNameID) == "TimedBomb_C") {
    // You found the spike!
}
```

 FNameEntry struct (in case you don't have SDK):
  Code:
```
struct FNameEntryHandle {
	uint16_t bIsWide : 1;
	uint16_t Len : 15;
};

struct FNameEntry {

	int32_t ComparisonId;
	FNameEntryHandle Header;
	union
	{
		char    AnsiName[1024];
		wchar_t    WideName[1024];
	};

	wchar_t const* GetWideName() const { return WideName; }
	char const* GetAnsiName() const { return AnsiName; }
	bool IsWide() const { return Header.bIsWide; }
};
```

inline std::uintptr_t get_module(const wchar_t* name)
{
    const auto handle = OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, 0, process_id);
    auto current = 0ull;
    auto mbi = MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION();
    while (VirtualQueryEx(handle, reinterpret_cast<void*>(current), &mbi, sizeof(MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION)))
    {
        if (mbi.Type == MEM_MAPPED || mbi.Type == MEM_IMAGE)
        {
            const auto buffer = malloc(1024);
            auto bytes = std::size_t();
            const static auto ntdll = GetModuleHandleA(("ntdll"));
            const static auto nt_query_virtual_memory_fn =
                reinterpret_cast<NTSTATUS(__stdcall*)(HANDLE, void*, std::int32_t, void*, std::size_t, std::size_t*)> (
                    GetProcAddress(ntdll, ("NtQueryVirtualMemory")));

            if (nt_query_virtual_memory_fn(handle, mbi.BaseAddress, 2, buffer, 1024, &bytes) != 0 ||
                !wcsstr(static_cast<UNICODE_STRING*>(buffer)->Buffer, name) ||
                wcsstr(static_cast<UNICODE_STRING*>(buffer)->Buffer, (L".mui")))
            {
                free(buffer);
                goto skip;
            }
            free(buffer);
            CloseHandle(handle);

            return reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(mbi.BaseAddress);
        }
    skip:
        current = reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(mbi.BaseAddress) + mbi.RegionSize;
    }
    CloseHandle(handle);
    return 0ull;
}

__forceinline __int64 decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uintptr_t* state)
{
	__int64 v2;
	unsigned __int64 v3;
	unsigned __int64 v4;
	unsigned __int64 v5;
	unsigned int v6;
	__int64 v7;
	unsigned int v8;
	int v9;
	unsigned int v10;
	unsigned __int64 v11;

	v2 = (unsigned int)(key << 25);
	v3 = 2685821657736338717i64 * ((unsigned int)key ^ v2 ^ (((unsigned int)key ^ ((unsigned __int64)(unsigned int)key >> 15)) >> 12)) % 7;
	v4 = state[v3];
	v5 = (2685821657736338717i64 * ((unsigned int)key ^ v2 ^ (((unsigned int)key ^ ((unsigned __int64)(unsigned int)key >> 15)) >> 12))) >> 32;
	v6 = (unsigned int)v3 % 7;
	if (!((unsigned int)v3 % 7))
	{
		v7 = 2 * ((2 * v4) ^ ((2 * v4) ^ (v4 >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64);
		v4 = v7 ^ (v7 ^ (((2 * v4) ^ ((2 * v4) ^ (v4 >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64) >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64;
		goto LABEL_5;
	}
	if (v6 == 1)
	{
		v9 = 2 * v3;
		v8 = v5 + v3;
		v4 = ~(unsigned __int64)(unsigned int)(v5 + v3) ^ (v4 - (unsigned int)(v5 + 2 * v3));
	}
	else
	{
	LABEL_5:
		v8 = v5 + v3;
		v9 = 2 * v3;
	}
	if (v6 == 2)
	{
		v4 = __ROL8__((2 * v4) ^ ((2 * v4) ^ (v4 >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64, (unsigned __int8)(v8 % 0x3F) + 1);
		goto LABEL_8;
	}
	if (v6 == 3)
	{
		v10 = v5 + v9;
		v4 = __ROL8__((unsigned int)(v5 + v9) + v4, (unsigned __int8)(v8 % 0x3F) + 1);
	}
	else
	{
	LABEL_8:
		v10 = v9 + v5;
	}
	if (v6 == 4)
	{
		v4 ^= v8;
	LABEL_11:
		if (v6 == 6)
		{
			v11 = __ROL8__(v4, (unsigned __int8)(v10 % 0x3F) + 1);
			v4 = (2 * v11) ^ ((2 * v11) ^ (v11 >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555i64;
		}

	}
	else
	{
		if (v6 != 5)
			goto LABEL_11;
		v4 += v8 - (unsigned __int64)v10;

	}
	return (v4 ^ key);

}

#define uint unsigned int
#define ushort unsigned short
#define ulong unsigned long

std::string get_fname(int key)
{
	uint chunkOffset = (uint)((int)(key) >> 16);
	ushort nameOffset = (ushort)key;
	std::uint64_t namePoolChunk = readcr3<std::uint64_t>((std::uintptr_t)(base + fnamepool + ((chunkOffset + 2) * 8)));

	std::uint64_t entryOffset = namePoolChunk + (ulong)(4 * nameOffset);
	FNameEntry nameEntry = readcr3<FNameEntry>(entryOffset);

	auto name = nameEntry.AnsiName;
	std::uintptr_t nameKey = getnamekey(base);

	if (nameEntry.Header.Len <= 365)
		for (std::uint16_t i = 0; i < nameEntry.Header.Len; i++)
		{
			BYTE b = i & 3;
			name[i] ^= nameEntry.Header.Len ^ *((LPBYTE)&nameKey + b);
		}

	return name;
}

  if (globals::aimbot::triggerbot && GetAsyncKeyState(globals::aimbot::trigger_key))
  {
      if (myweapon != nullptr) {
          for (int32_t idx = 0; idx < actors.count; ++idx) {
              ashootercharacter* actor = actors[idx];
              if (!actor || actor == character || !actor->is_alive()) continue;

              uskeletalmeshcomponent* mesh = actor->get_mesh();
              if (!mesh || actor->was_invisible()) continue;

              fvector head_location = mesh->get_bone_location(8);
              if (!head_location.is_valid()) continue;

              auto head_screen = controller->project_world_to_screen(head_location);
              if (!head_screen.is_valid()) continue;

              float dx = head_screen.x - screen_center_x;
              float dy = head_screen.y - screen_center_y;
              float dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
              if (dist <= globals::aimbot::fovtrigger) {
                  if (!globals::aimbot::vish_check || controller->line_of_sight(actor)) {
                      (mouse_event)(MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTDOWN, 0, 0, 0, 0);
                      (mouse_event)(MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTUP, 0, 0, 0, 0);
                      break;
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  }
```

/// <summary>
/// Retrieves the cached CPUID EAX value (Leaf 1) from the kernel's KPRCB structure.
/// Useful for environments lacking direct CPUID instruction access via VM libraries.
/// </summary>
/// <returns>The cached EAX value, or 0 on failure.</returns>
public static uint GetCpuidRaxFromKPRCB()
{
    try
    {
        Program.Log("Reading CPUID EAX value via kernel structures...");

        const uint systemPid = 4;

        var ntoskrnlBase = vmm.ProcessGetModuleBase(systemPid, "ntoskrnl.exe");
        if (ntoskrnlBase == 0)
        {
            Program.Log("Error: Could not locate ntoskrnl base address.");
            return 0;
        }

        if (!vmm.PdbLoad(systemPid, ntoskrnlBase, out string _))
        {
            Program.Log("Error: Failed to load symbols for ntoskrnl.");
            return 0;
        }

        if (!vmm.PdbSymbolAddress("nt", "KeProcessorBlock", out ulong keProcessorBlockAddr))
        {
            Program.Log("Error: Symbol lookup for KeProcessorBlock failed.");
            return 0;
        }

        ulong kprcbAddr = ReadKernelMemory<ulong>(keProcessorBlockAddr);
        if (kprcbAddr == 0)
        {
            Program.Log("Error: Failed to read KPRCB pointer for CPU 0.");
            return 0;
        }

        if (!vmm.PdbTypeChildOffset("nt", "_KPRCB", "ProcessorSignature", out uint procSigOffset))
        {
            Program.Log("Error: Could not determine offset for ProcessorSignature.");
            return 0;
        }

        uint eax = ReadKernelMemory<uint>(kprcbAddr + procSigOffset);
        Program.Log($"CPUID Leaf 1 EAX (cached): 0x{eax:X}");
        return eax;
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        Program.Log($"Unhandled exception while accessing CPUID info: {ex.Message}");
        return 0;
    }
}
```

	auto test_base = Memory::getBaseAddress();
	//key: 0xB5415B8
	const auto key = Memory::read<uint64_t>(test_base + 0xB5415B8);
	uint64_t state[7];
	for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
		state[i] = Memory::read<uint64_t>(test_base + 0xB5415B8 - 0x78 + (16 + 2 * i) * 4);
	}

	const auto gobject_ptr = routines::decrypt_uobject_array(key, state);
	printf("gobject ptr %llx\n", gobject_ptr);

	gUObjectManager.UObjectArray = Memory::read<TypeUObjectArray>(gobject_ptr);
	printf("gobject array %llx\n", gUObjectManager.UObjectArray);
```
   Code:
```
__forceinline __int64 decrypt_uobject_array(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t state[7])
{
	uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1D * (key ^ (key << 25) ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12));
	uint32_t index = hash % 7;
	uint64_t value = state[index];
	uint32_t high32 = hash >> 32;
	uint32_t case_num = index % 7;
	uint64_t result = value;

	if (case_num == 0) {
		result = __ROL8__(value ^ ~(uint64_t)(high32 - 1), (high32 % 0x3F) + 1);
	}
	else if (case_num == 1) {
		uint64_t temp1 = 2 * ((2 * value) ^ ((2 * value) ^ (value >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555LL);
		uint64_t temp2 = temp1 ^ (temp1 ^ (((2 * value) ^ ((2 * value) ^ (value >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555LL) >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555LL;
		uint64_t temp3 = (4 * temp2) ^ ((4 * temp2) ^ (temp2 >> 2)) & 0x3333333333333333LL;
		uint64_t temp4 = (16 * temp3) ^ ((16 * temp3) ^ (temp3 >> 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0FLL;
		result = __ROL8__((temp4 << 8) ^ ((temp4 << 8) ^ (temp4 >> 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FFLL, 32);
	}
	else if (case_num == 2) {
		result = (high32 + index) + __ROL8__(value, ((high32 + 2 * index) % 0x3F) + 1);
	}
	else if (case_num == 3) {
		result = __ROR8__((2 * result) ^ ((2 * result) ^ (result >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555LL, ((high32 + index) % 0x3F) + 1);
	}
	else if (case_num == 4) {
		result = ~(uint64_t)(high32 + index) ^ (2 * result) ^ ((2 * result) ^ (result >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555LL;
	}
	else if (case_num == 5) {
		result = ~result - (high32 + index);
	}
	else if (case_num == 6) {
		uint64_t temp1 = (2 * result) ^ ((2 * result) ^ (result >> 1)) & 0x5555555555555555LL;
		uint64_t temp2 = (4 * temp1) ^ ((4 * temp1) ^ (temp1 >> 2)) & 0x3333333333333333LL;
		uint64_t temp3 = (16 * temp2) ^ ((16 * temp2) ^ (temp2 >> 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0FLL;
		result = (high32 + index) + __ROL8__((temp3 << 8) ^ ((temp3 << 8) ^ (temp3 >> 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FFLL, 32);
	}

	return result ^ key;
}
```

    unsigned int v12;

    v10 = UWorldState[v9];
    v11 = v8 >> 32;
    v12 = (unsigned int)v9 % 7;

    if ((_DWORD)v9 == 7 * ((unsigned int)v9 / 7))
    {
        v13 = ~v11 ^ (v10 + (unsigned int)(v11 - 1));
    }
    else
    {
        v13 = UWorldState[v9];
        if (v12 == 1)
        {
            v13 = ((v10 >> ((unsigned __int8)(((int)v11 + 2 * (int)v9) % 0x3F) + 1)) |
                   (v10 << (63 * (unsigned __int8)(((int)v11 + 2 * (int)v9) / 0x3F)
                           - ((unsigned __int8)v11 + 2 * (unsigned __int8)v9) + 63)))
                   - (unsigned int)(v9 + v11);
            goto LABEL_11;
        }
    }

    if (v12 == 2)
    {
        v13 = (((unsigned int)(v11 + 2 * v9) + v13) >> 1) ^
              ((((unsigned int)(v11 + 2 * v9) + v13) >> 1) ^
               (2 * ((unsigned int)(v11 + 2 * v9) + v13))) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAull;
        goto LABEL_7;
    }

LABEL_11:
    if ((unsigned int)v9 % 7 == 3)
    {
        v13 = ~(unsigned __int64)(unsigned int)(v9 + v11) ^
              ((v13 >> (63 * (unsigned __int8)(((int)v11 + 2 * (int)v9) / 0x3F)
                      - ((unsigned __int8)v11 + 2 * (unsigned __int8)v9) + 63)) |
               (v13 << ((unsigned __int8)(((int)v11 + 2 * (int)v9) % 0x3F) + 1)));
        goto LABEL_13;
    }

LABEL_7:
    if ((unsigned int)v9 % 7 == 5)
    {
        v13 = (((v13 << (63 * (unsigned __int8)(((int)v11 + 2 * (int)v9) / 0x3F)
                      - ((unsigned __int8)v11 + 2 * (unsigned __int8)v9) + 63)) |
                (v13 >> ((unsigned __int8)(((int)v11 + 2 * (int)v9) % 0x3F) + 1))) >>

              (((v13 << (63 * (unsigned __int8)(((int)v11 + 2 * (int)v9) / 0x3F)

  Code:
```
void ProcessEvent(void* fnobject, void* parms)
        {
            auto index = *reinterpret_cast<void***>(this); // <-- Object VTable
            if (!index)
                return false;

            auto fProcessEvent = static_cast<void(*)(void*, void*, void*)>(index[0x53]);
            if (!fProcessEvent)
                return false;

            fProcessEvent(this, fnobject, parms);
        }
```

### Post #4442325 — Swarley12 — 30th July 2025, 12:08 AM

Code:
```
class FVector
{
public:
    FVector() : x(0.0), y(0.0), z(0.0)
    {
    }

    FVector(double _x, double _y, double _z) : x(_x), y(_y), z(_z)
    {
    }

    ~FVector()
    {
    }

    double x;
    double y;
    double z;

    inline double Dot(FVector v)
    {
        return x * v.x + y * v.y + z * v.z;
    }

    inline double Distance(FVector v)
    {
        double dx = this->x - v.x;
        double dy = this->y - v.y;
        double dz = this->z - v.z;

        return (double)sqrtf((dx * dx) + (dy * dy) + (dz * dz)) * 0.03048;
    }

    FVector operator+(FVector v)
    {
        return FVector(x + v.x, y + v.y, z + v.z);
    }

    FVector operator-(FVector v)
    {
        return FVector(x - v.x, y - v.y, z - v.z);
    }

    FVector operator*(double number) const
    {
        return FVector(x * number, y * number, z * number);
    }

    __forceinline double Magnitude() const
    {
        return (double)sqrtf(x * x + y * y + z * z);
    }

    inline double Length()
    {
        return (double)sqrtf((x * x) + (y * y) + (z * z));
    }

    inline bool IsNearlyZero(double Tolerance = 1e-4) const
    {
        return std::fabs(x) < Tolerance && std::fabs(y) < Tolerance && std::fabs(z) < Tolerance;
    }

    __forceinline FVector Normalize()
    {
        FVector vector;
        double length = this->Magnitude();

        if (length != 0)
        {
            vector.x = x / length;
            vector.y = y / length;
            vector.z = z / length;
        }
        else
        {
            vector.x = vector.y = 0.0;
            vector.z = 1.0;
        }
        return vector;
    }

    __forceinline FVector& operator+=(const FVector& v)
    {
        x += v.x;
        y += v.y;
        z += v.z;
        return *this;
    }
};

>
>     inline bool IsNearlyZero(double Tolerance = 1e-4) const
>     {
>         return std::fabs(x) < Tolerance && std::fabs(y) < Tolerance && std::fabs(z) < Tolerance;
>     }
>
>     __forceinline FVector Normalize()
>     {
>         FVector vector;
>         double length = this->Magnitude();
>
>         if (length != 0)
>         {
>             vector.x = x / length;
>             vector.y = y / length;
>             vector.z = z / length;
>         }
>         else
>         {
>             vector.x = vector.y = 0.0;
>             vector.z = 1.0;
>         }
>         return vector;
>     }
>
>     __forceinline FVector& operator+=(const FVector& v)
>     {
>         x += v.x;
>         y += v.y;
>         z += v.z;
>         return *this;
>     }
> };

inline u64 decrypt_world(const u32 key, const u64* state) {
	const u64 hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DLL * (key ^ (key << 25) ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12));
	const u64 index = hash % 7;
	const u64 high_bits = hash >> 32;
	const u32 mod_result = index % 7;

	u64 value = state[index];

	if (mod_result == 0) {
		value = high_bits + (value ^ ~(u64)(high_bits - 1));
	}
	else if (mod_result == 1) {
		value = (~value >> 1) ^ ((~value >> 1) ^ (2 * ~value)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAuLL;
	}
	else if (mod_result == 2) {
		const uint8_t shift = ((high_bits + 2 * index) % 0x3F) + 1;
		value = (u32)(high_bits + index) + ((value << shift) | (value >> (64 - shift)));
	}
	else if (mod_result == 3) {
		const uint8_t shift = ((high_bits + 2 * index) % 0x3F) + 1;
		const u64 rotated = (value >> shift) | (value << (64 - shift));
		value = (rotated >> 1) ^ ((rotated >> 1) ^ (2 * rotated)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAuLL;
	}
	else if (mod_result == 4) {
		const uint8_t shift1 = ((high_bits + 2 * index) % 0x3F) + 1;
		const uint8_t shift2 = ((high_bits + index) % 0x3F) + 1;
		const u64 temp = (value << shift1) | (value >> (64 - shift1));
		value = (temp << shift2) | (temp >> (64 - shift2));
	}
	else if (mod_result == 5) {
		const u64 bit_reverse = ((value >> 1) ^ ((value >> 1) ^ (2 * value)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAuLL) >> 2;
		const u64 step1 = bit_reverse ^ (bit_reverse ^ (4 * ((value >> 1) ^ ((value >> 1) ^ (2 * value)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAuLL))) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCuLL;
		const u64 step2 = step1 >> 4;
		const u64 step3 = (step2 ^ (step2 ^ (16 * step1)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0uLL) >> 8;
		const u64 byte_swap = step3 ^ (step3 ^ ((step2 ^ (step2 ^ (16 * step1)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0uLL) << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00uLL;
		value = ~(u64)(high_bits + index) ^ ((byte_swap << 32) | (u32)(byte_swap >> 32));
	}
	else if (mod_result == 6) {
		const uint8_t shift = ((high_bits + index) % 0x3F) + 1;
		value = (~value << shift) | (~value >> (64 - shift));
	}

	return value ^ key;
}

auto world_ptr = reinterpret_cast<UWorld*>(decrypt_world(world_key, world_state.data()));
```

  Code:
```
		auto ProjectWorldToScreen(FVector WorldLocation) -> FVector
		{
			FVector Screenlocation(0, 0, 0);

			auto ViewInfo = Driver->readv<FMinimalViewInfo>(PlayerCameraManager + 0x17B0 + 0x10);

			CameraLocation = ViewInfo.Location;
			CameraRotation = ViewInfo.Rotation;

			D3DMATRIX tempMatrix = Matrix(CameraRotation, FVector(0, 0, 0));

			FVector vAxisX(tempMatrix.m[0][0], tempMatrix.m[0][1], tempMatrix.m[0][2]);
			FVector vAxisY(tempMatrix.m[1][0], tempMatrix.m[1][1], tempMatrix.m[1][2]);
			FVector vAxisZ(tempMatrix.m[2][0], tempMatrix.m[2][1], tempMatrix.m[2][2]);

			FVector vDelta = WorldLocation - CameraLocation;
			FVector vTransformed(vDelta.Dot(vAxisY), vDelta.Dot(vAxisZ), vDelta.Dot(vAxisX));

			if (vTransformed.z < 1.0)
				return FVector(-1, -1, 0);

			float FovAngle = ViewInfo.FOV;
			if (FovAngle <= 10.f || FovAngle > 170.f)
				return FVector(-1, -1, 0);

			double ScreenCenterX = static_cast<double>(Width) / 2.0;
			double ScreenCenterY = static_cast<double>(Height) / 2.0;

			double tanFov = tan(static_cast<double>(FovAngle) * M_PI / 360.0);

			Screenlocation.x = ScreenCenterX + vTransformed.x * (ScreenCenterX / tanFov) / vTransformed.z;
			Screenlocation.y = ScreenCenterY - vTransformed.y * (ScreenCenterX / tanFov) / vTransformed.z;

			return Screenlocation;
		}
```

uintptr_t DecryptClonedCR3(uintptr_t VGKBaseAddress) {
	uint64_t key = *(uintptr_t*)(VGKBaseAddress + 0x80710);
	uint64_t mask = *(uintptr_t*)(VGKBaseAddress + 0x807C0) & 0x73;
	uint64_t cpu_id = cpuid_rax();
	uint64_t inv_key = ~key;

	uint64_t term1 = (mask & key) - (key | ~mask);
	uint64_t base_expr = 0x49B74B6480000000ull * key
		+ 0x66B8CDC1FFFFFFFFull * mask
		+ 0xC2D8B464B4418C6Cull * ~mask
		+ 0x5C1FE6A2B4418C6Dull * term1;

	int64_t modifier = -3 * ~key
		+ (mask ^ key)
		+ -2 * (mask ^ (mask | key))
		+ 2 * (((mask | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBull) ^ 0xC08E266D044D3314ull)
			+ (~key | (mask ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBull)))
		- (mask ^ ~key ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBull)
		- 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBull;

	uint64_t v13 = base_expr * modifier;
	uint64_t cr3_mul_expr = key * (0x13D0F34E00000000ull * key + 0x483C4F8900000000ull);
	uint64_t v15 = 0x7D90DC33C620C593ull * cr3_mul_expr;

	uint64_t term_cr3 = 0x55494E5B80000000ull * cpu_id
		+ 0xC83B18136241A38Dull * ~cpu_id
		+ 0xCE3CE5E180000000ull * ~key
		+ 0x72F1C9B7E241A38Dull * ((cpu_id | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBull) - (0x3F71D992FBB2CCEAll - (cpu_id & 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBull)));

	uint64_t term_key = 0x99BF7D2380CF6EC3ull * cpu_id
		+ 0x664082DC7F30913Eull * (mask | key)
		+ 0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ull * ~cpu_id
		+ 0xE64082DC7F30913Eull * (~key & ~mask)
		+ ((key + (mask & (key ^ cpu_id)) + (mask | cpu_id)) << 63);

	uint64_t inner_expr = v15
		+ 0xFD90DC33C620C592ull * ~cr3_mul_expr
		+ (key * term_cr3 + 0x71C31A1E80000000ull) * term_key
		+ 0x2183995CC620C592ull;

	uint64_t common_expr = 0x8000000000000001ull * cpu_id
		+ 0xAFDBF65F8A4AC9C9ull * ~key
		+ 0x2FDBF65F8A4AC9C9ull * (key + 1)
		+ (((key ^ cpu_id) << 63) ^ 0x8000000000000000ull);

	uint64_t result = 0x137FEEF6AB38CFB4ull * v13
		+ ((~v13 ^ ~(common_expr * inner_expr)) << 63)
		+ 0x6C80110954C7304Dull * ((cpu_id & v13) - (~cpu_id & ~v13) - cpu_id)
		- 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull * common_expr * inner_expr
		- 0x4F167C5CD4C7304Eull;

	return result;
}

class Vector3 {
public:
    Vector3() : x(0.f), y(0.f), z(0.f) {}
    Vector3(double _x, double _y, double _z) : x(_x), y(_y), z(_z) {}
    ~Vector3() {}

    double x;
    double y;
    double z;
    Vector3& operator+=(const Vector3& v) { x += v.x; y += v.y; z += v.z; return *this; }

    inline double Dot(Vector3 v) {
        return x * v.x + y * v.y + z * v.z;
    }

    inline double Distance(Vector3 v) {
        return double(sqrtf(powf(v.x - x, 2.0) + powf(v.y - y, 2.0) + powf(v.z - z, 2.0)));
    }

    Vector3 operator+(Vector3 v) {
        return Vector3(x + v.x, y + v.y, z + v.z);
    }

    Vector3 operator*(double factor) {
        return Vector3(x * factor, y * factor, z * factor);
    }

    Vector3 operator-(Vector3 v) {
        return Vector3(x - v.x, y - v.y, z - v.z);
    }

    inline double Length() {
        return sqrtf((x * x) + (y * y) + (z * z));
    }
    inline double Length2D() {
        return sqrtf((x * x) + (y * y));
    }

    Vector3 Clamp()
    {
        Vector3 clamped = { x, y, 0 };
        while (clamped.y < -180.0f)
            clamped.y += 360.0f;
        while (clamped.y > 180.0f)
            clamped.y -= 360.0f;
        while (clamped.x < -180.0f)
            clamped.x += 360.0f;
        while (clamped.x > 180.0f)
            clamped.x -= 360.0f;
        return clamped;
    }
    Vector3 ToRotator()
    {
        Vector3 rotator;
        rotator.x = -(double)atan(z / Length2D()) * (double)(180.0f / 3.14159265358979323846);
        rotator.y = (double)atan(y / x) * (double)(180.0f / 3.14159265358979323846);
        rotator.z = (double)0.f;
        if (x >= 0.f)
            rotator.y += 180.0f;
        return rotator;
    }
};
```

        m.ZPlane.w = 0.0f;
        m.WPlane.w = 1.0f;

    }

Vector3 getBonePosition(uintptr_t bone_array, FTransform componenttoworld, int index)

    FMatrix Matrix;

    return Vector3(Matrix.WPlane.x, Matrix.WPlane.y, Matrix.WPlane.z);
}

D3DMATRIX toMatrix(Vector3 Rotation, Vector3 origin = Vector3(0, 0, 0)) {

    double Pitch = (Rotation.x * double(M_PI) / 180.f);
    double Yaw = (Rotation.y * double(M_PI) / 180.f);
    double Roll = (Rotation.z * double(M_PI) / 180.f);

    double SP = sinf(Pitch);
    double CP = cosf(Pitch);
    double SY = sinf(Yaw);
    double CY = cosf(Yaw);
    double SR = sinf(Roll);
    double CR = cosf(Roll);

    D3DMATRIX Matrix;
    Matrix._11 = CP * CY;
    Matrix._12 = CP * SY;
    Matrix._13 = SP;
    Matrix._14 = 0.f;

    Matrix._21 = SR * SP * CY - CR * SY;
    Matrix._22 = SR * SP * SY + CR * CY;
    Matrix._23 = -SR * CP;
    Matrix._24 = 0.f;

    Matrix._31 = -(CR * SP * CY + SR * SY);
    Matrix._32 = CY * SR - CR * SP * SY;
    Matrix._33 = CR * CP;
    Matrix._34 = 0.f;

    Matrix._41 = origin.x;
    Matrix._42 = origin.y;
    Matrix._43 = origin.z;
    Matrix._44 = 1.f;

    return Matrix;
}

Vector2 w2s(Vector3 WorldLocation)
{
    viewInfo = process::read_valo<FMinimalViewInfo>((void*)(player_camera_manager + offsets::camera_private + 0x10));

    Vector2 Screenlocation = Vector2(0, 0);
    D3DMATRIX tempMatrix = toMatrix(viewInfo.Rotation, Vector3(0, 0, 0));

    Vector3 vAxisX = Vector3(tempMatrix.m[0][0], tempMatrix.m[0][1], tempMatrix.m[0][2]),
        vAxisY = Vector3(tempMatrix.m[1][0], tempMatrix.m[1][1], tempMatrix.m[1][2]),
        vAxisZ = Vector3(tempMatrix.m[2][0], tempMatrix.m[2][1], tempMatrix.m[2][2]);

    Vector3 vDelta = WorldLocation - viewInfo.Location;
    Vector3 vTransformed = Vector3(vDelta.Dot(vAxisY), vDelta.Dot(vAxisZ), vDelta.Dot(vAxisX));

    if (vTransformed.z < 1.f) vTransformed.z = 1.f;

    Screenlocation.x = (configs::width / 2.f) + vTransformed.x * ((configs::width / 2.f) / tanf(viewInfo.FOV * (double)M_PI / 360.f)) / vTransformed.z;
    Screenlocation.y = (configs::height / 2.f) - vTransformed.y * ((configs::width / 2.f) / tanf(viewInfo.FOV * (double)M_PI / 360.f)) / vTransformed.z;

    return Screenlocation;
}

    pOut._22 = pM1._21 * pM2._12 + pM1._22 * pM2._22 + pM1._23 * pM2._32 + pM1._24 * pM2._42;
    pOut._23 = pM1._21 * pM2._13 + pM1._22 * pM2._23 + pM1._23 * pM2._33 + pM1._24 * pM2._43;

    pOut._41 = pM1._41 * pM2._11 + pM1._42 * pM2._21 + pM1._43 * pM2._31 + pM1._44 * pM2._41;

        m._32 = (yz2 - wx2) * scale.z;
        m._23 = (yz2 + wx2) * scale.y;

        double xy2 = rot.x * y2;
        double wz2 = rot.w * z2;
        m._21 = (xy2 - wz2) * scale.y;
        m._12 = (xy2 + wz2) * scale.x;

        m._13 = (xz2 - wy2) * scale.x;

        m._24 = 0.0f;

 class Vector3 {
public:
    Vector3() : x(0.0), y(0.0), z(0.0) {}
    Vector3(double _x, double _y, double _z) : x(_x), y(_y), z(_z) {}
    ~Vector3() {}

    double x;
    double y;
    double z;
    Vector3& operator+=(const Vector3& v) { x += v.x; y += v.y; z += v.z; return *this; }

    inline double Dot(Vector3 v) {
        return x * v.x + y * v.y + z * v.z;
    }

    inline double Distance(Vector3 v) {
        return sqrt(pow(v.x - x, 2.0) + pow(v.y - y, 2.0) + pow(v.z - z, 2.0));
    }

    Vector3 operator+(Vector3 v) {
        return Vector3(x + v.x, y + v.y, z + v.z);
    }

    Vector3 operator*(double factor) {
        return Vector3(x * factor, y * factor, z * factor);
    }

    Vector3 operator-(Vector3 v) {
        return Vector3(x - v.x, y - v.y, z - v.z);
    }

    inline double Length() {
        return sqrt((x * x) + (y * y) + (z * z));
    }
    inline double Length2D() {
        return sqrt((x * x) + (y * y));
    }

    Vector3 Clamp()
    {
        Vector3 clamped = { x, y, 0 };
        while (clamped.y < -180.0)
            clamped.y += 360.0;
        while (clamped.y > 180.0)
            clamped.y -= 360.0;
        while (clamped.x < -180.0)
            clamped.x += 360.0;
        while (clamped.x > 180.0)
            clamped.x -= 360.0;
        return clamped;
    }
    Vector3 ToRotator()
    {
        Vector3 rotator;
        rotator.x = -atan(z / Length2D()) * (180.0 / M_PI);
        rotator.y = atan(y / x) * (180.0 / M_PI);
        rotator.z = 0.0;
        if (x >= 0.0)
            rotator.y += 180.0;
        return rotator;
    }
};

struct Vector2 {
public:

    inline Vector2() : x(0), y(0) {}
    inline Vector2(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}

    inline double Distance(Vector2 v) {
        return sqrt(((v.x - x) * (v.x - x) + (v.y - y) * (v.y - y)));
    }

    inline Vector2 operator+(const Vector2& v) const {
        return Vector2(x + v.x, y + v.y);

    inline Vector2 operator-(const Vector2& v) const {
        return Vector2(x - v.x, y - v.y);

};

    {
        if (m_nCount > m_nMax)
            return false;
        if (!m_Data)

        return true;

    {
        return m_Data;

    {
        return process::read_valo<T>((void*)(m_Data + i * 8));
    }

    [[nodiscard]]
    std::vector<T> GetIter(int maxCount = 30) {
        if (m_nCount > maxCount)
            return {};

        std::vector<T> buffer(m_nCount);
        bool success = process::read_array_valo<T>(
            reinterpret_cast<void*>(m_Data),
            buffer.data(),
            static_cast<uint64_t>(m_nCount)
        );

        return buffer;
    }

protected:

    uint32_t m_nCount;

        m.WPlane.z = Translation.z;

        double x2 = Rotation.x + Rotation.x;
        double y2 = Rotation.y + Rotation.y;
        double z2 = Rotation.z + Rotation.z;

        double xx2 = Rotation.x * x2;
        double yy2 = Rotation.y * y2;
        double zz2 = Rotation.z * z2;
        m.XPlane.x = (1.0 - (yy2 + zz2)) * Scale3D.x;
        m.YPlane.y = (1.0 - (xx2 + zz2)) * Scale3D.y;
        m.ZPlane.z = (1.0 - (xx2 + yy2)) * Scale3D.z;

        double yz2 = Rotation.y * z2;
        double wx2 = Rotation.w * x2;
        m.ZPlane.y = (yz2 - wx2) * Scale3D.z;
        m.YPlane.z = (yz2 + wx2) * Scale3D.y;

        double xy2 = Rotation.x * y2;
        double wz2 = Rotation.w * z2;
        m.YPlane.x = (xy2 - wz2) * Scale3D.y;
        m.XPlane.y = (xy2 + wz2) * Scale3D.x;

        double xz2 = Rotation.x * z2;
        double wy2 = Rotation.w * y2;
        m.ZPlane.x = (xz2 + wy2) * Scale3D.z;
        m.XPlane.z = (xz2 - wy2) * Scale3D.x;

        m.XPlane.w = 0.0;
        m.YPlane.w = 0.0;
        m.ZPlane.w = 0.0;
        m.WPlane.w = 1.0;

        return m;

Vector3 getBonePosition(uintptr_t bone_array, FTransform componenttoworld, int index)
{
    FTransform bone = process::read_valo<FTransform>((void*)(bone_array + (index * 0x60)));
    FMatrix Matrix;
    Matrix = bone.ToMatrixWithScale() * componenttoworld.ToMatrixWithScale();

    return Vector3(Matrix.WPlane.x, Matrix.WPlane.y, Matrix.WPlane.z);
}

D3DMATRIX toMatrix(Vector3 Rotation, Vector3 origin = Vector3(0, 0, 0)) {

    double Pitch = (Rotation.x * M_PI / 180.0);
    double Yaw = (Rotation.y * M_PI / 180.0);
    double Roll = (Rotation.z * M_PI / 180.0);

    double SP = sin(Pitch);
    double CP = cos(Pitch);
    double SY = sin(Yaw);
    double CY = cos(Yaw);
    double SR = sin(Roll);
    double CR = cos(Roll);

    D3DMATRIX Matrix;
    Matrix._11 = CP * CY;
    Matrix._12 = CP * SY;
    Matrix._13 = SP;
    Matrix._14 = 0.0;

    Matrix._21 = SR * SP * CY - CR * SY;
    Matrix._22 = SR * SP * SY + CR * CY;
    Matrix._23 = -SR * CP;
    Matrix._24 = 0.0;

    Matrix._31 = -(CR * SP * CY + SR * SY);
    Matrix._32 = CY * SR - CR * SP * SY;
    Matrix._33 = CR * CP;
    Matrix._34 = 0.0;

    Matrix._41 = origin.x;
    Matrix._42 = origin.y;
    Matrix._43 = origin.z;
    Matrix._44 = 1.0;

    return Matrix;
}

    Vector2 Screenlocation = Vector2(0, 0);
    D3DMATRIX tempMatrix = toMatrix(viewInfo.Rotation, Vector3(0, 0, 0));

    Vector3 vAxisX = Vector3(tempMatrix.m[0][0], tempMatrix.m[0][1], tempMatrix.m[0][2]),
        vAxisY = Vector3(tempMatrix.m[1][0], tempMatrix.m[1][1], tempMatrix.m[1][2]),
        vAxisZ = Vector3(tempMatrix.m[2][0], tempMatrix.m[2][1], tempMatrix.m[2][2]);

    Vector3 vDelta = WorldLocation - viewInfo.Location;
    Vector3 vTransformed = Vector3(vDelta.Dot(vAxisY), vDelta.Dot(vAxisZ), vDelta.Dot(vAxisX));

    if (vTransformed.z < 1.0) vTransformed.z = 1.0;

    Screenlocation.x = (configs::width / 2.0) + vTransformed.x * ((configs::width / 2.0) / tan(viewInfo.FOV * M_PI / 360.0)) / vTransformed.z;
    Screenlocation.y = (configs::height / 2.0) - vTransformed.y * ((configs::width / 2.0) / tan(viewInfo.FOV * M_PI / 360.0)) / vTransformed.z;

    return Screenlocation;
}

inline D3DMATRIX MatrixMultiplication(D3DMATRIX pM1, D3DMATRIX pM2)
{
    D3DMATRIX pOut;
    pOut._11 = pM1._11 * pM2._11 + pM1._12 * pM2._21 + pM1._13 * pM2._31 + pM1._14 * pM2._41;
    pOut._12 = pM1._11 * pM2._12 + pM1._12 * pM2._22 + pM1._13 * pM2._32 + pM1._14 * pM2._42;
    pOut._13 = pM1._11 * pM2._13 + pM1._12 * pM2._23 + pM1._13 * pM2._33 + pM1._14 * pM2._43;
    pOut._14 = pM1._11 * pM2._14 + pM1._12 * pM2._24 + pM1._13 * pM2._34 + pM1._14 * pM2._44;
    pOut._21 = pM1._21 * pM2._11 + pM1._22 * pM2._21 + pM1._23 * pM2._31 + pM1._24 * pM2._41;
    pOut._22 = pM1._21 * pM2._12 + pM1._22 * pM2._22 + pM1._23 * pM2._32 + pM1._24 * pM2._42;
    pOut._23 = pM1._21 * pM2._13 + pM1._22 * pM2._23 + pM1._23 * pM2._33 + pM1._24 * pM2._43;
    pOut._24 = pM1._21 * pM2._14 + pM1._22 * pM2._24 + pM1._23 * pM2._34 + pM1._24 * pM2._44;
    pOut._31 = pM1._31 * pM2._11 + pM1._32 * pM2._21 + pM1._33 * pM2._31 + pM1._34 * pM2._41;
    pOut._32 = pM1._31 * pM2._12 + pM1._32 * pM2._22 + pM1._33 * pM2._32 + pM1._34 * pM2._42;
    pOut._33 = pM1._31 * pM2._13 + pM1._32 * pM2._23 + pM1._33 * pM2._33 + pM1._34 * pM2._43;
    pOut._34 = pM1._31 * pM2._14 + pM1._32 * pM2._24 + pM1._33 * pM2._34 + pM1._34 * pM2._44;
    pOut._41 = pM1._41 * pM2._11 + pM1._42 * pM2._21 + pM1._43 * pM2._31 + pM1._44 * pM2._41;
    pOut._42 = pM1._41 * pM2._12 + pM1._42 * pM2._22 + pM1._43 * pM2._32 + pM1._44 * pM2._42;
    pOut._43 = pM1._41 * pM2._13 + pM1._42 * pM2._23 + pM1._43 * pM2._33 + pM1._44 * pM2._43;
    pOut._44 = pM1._41 * pM2._14 + pM1._42 * pM2._24 + pM1._43 * pM2._34 + pM1._44 * pM2._44;

    return pOut;
}

    Vector3 vDelta = WorldLocation - viewInfo.Location;
    Vector3 vTransformed = Vector3(vDelta.Dot(vAxisY), vDelta.Dot(vAxisZ), vDelta.Dot(vAxisX));

auto IsVisible(DWORD_PTR mesh) -> bool
{
    if (!mesh)
        return false;
    try {

        double fLastSubmitTime = process::read_valo<double>((void*)(mesh + offsets::last_submit_time));
        double fLastRenderTimeOnScreen = process::read_valo<double>((void*)(mesh + offsets::last_render_time));

        if (isnan(fLastSubmitTime) || isnan(fLastRenderTimeOnScreen) ||
            isinf(fLastSubmitTime) || isinf(fLastRenderTimeOnScreen))
            return false;

        const double fVisionTick = 0.06f;
        bool bVisible = fLastRenderTimeOnScreen + fVisionTick >= fLastSubmitTime;
        return bVisible;
    }
    catch (...) {

        return false;
    }
}

        return false;

    try {
        double fLastSubmitTime = process::read_valo<double>((void*)(mesh + offsets::last_submit_time));
        double fLastRenderTimeOnScreen = process::read_valo<double>((void*)(mesh + offsets::last_render_time));

        if (isnan(fLastSubmitTime) || isnan(fLastRenderTimeOnScreen) ||
            isinf(fLastSubmitTime) || isinf(fLastRenderTimeOnScreen))
            return false;

        const double fVisionTick = 0.06f;
        bool bVisible = fLastRenderTimeOnScreen + fVisionTick >= fLastSubmitTime;
        return bVisible;
    }
    catch (...) {

        return false;
    }
}
```

### Post #4444313 — rample — 31st July 2025, 09:38 PM

> **ZhoneS:**
> Originally Posted by ZhoneS   Can you send your complete WorldToScreen & GetBoneMatrix funcs? mine is goofy

  Code:
```
Vector2 w2s(Vector3 WorldLocation)
{
    viewInfo = process::read_valo<FMinimalViewInfo>((void*)(player_camera_manager + offsets::camera_private + 0x10));

    Vector2 Screenlocation = Vector2(0, 0);
    D3DMATRIX tempMatrix = toMatrix(viewInfo.Rotation, Vector3(0, 0, 0));

    Vector3 vAxisX = Vector3(tempMatrix.m[0][0], tempMatrix.m[0][1], tempMatrix.m[0][2]),
        vAxisY = Vector3(tempMatrix.m[1][0], tempMatrix.m[1][1], tempMatrix.m[1][2]),
        vAxisZ = Vector3(tempMatrix.m[2][0], tempMatrix.m[2][1], tempMatrix.m[2][2]);

    Vector3 vDelta = WorldLocation - viewInfo.Location;
    Vector3 vTransformed = Vector3(vDelta.Dot(vAxisY), vDelta.Dot(vAxisZ), vDelta.Dot(vAxisX));

    if (vTransformed.z < 1.f) vTransformed.z = 1.f;

    Screenlocation.x = (configs::width / 2.f) + vTransformed.x * ((configs::width / 2.f) / tanf(viewInfo.FOV * (float)M_PI / 360.f)) / vTransformed.z;
    Screenlocation.y = (configs::height / 2.f) - vTransformed.y * ((configs::width / 2.f) / tanf(viewInfo.FOV * (float)M_PI / 360.f)) / vTransformed.z;

    return Screenlocation;
}
```
   Code:
```
Vector3 getBonePosition(uintptr_t bone_array, FTransform componenttoworld, int index)
{
    FTransform bone = process::read_valo<FTransform>((void*)(bone_array + (index * 0x60)));
    FMatrix Matrix;
    Matrix = bone.ToMatrixWithScale() * componenttoworld.ToMatrixWithScale();

    return Vector3(Matrix.WPlane.x, Matrix.WPlane.y, Matrix.WPlane.z);
}
```

auto IsVisible(DWORD_PTR mesh) -> bool
{
    if (!mesh)
        return false;

    try {
        double fLastSubmitTime = process::read_valo<double>((void*)(mesh + offsets::last_submit_time));
        double fLastRenderTimeOnScreen = process::read_valo<double>((void*)(mesh + offsets::last_render_time));

        if (isnan(fLastSubmitTime) || isnan(fLastRenderTimeOnScreen) ||
            isinf(fLastSubmitTime) || isinf(fLastRenderTimeOnScreen))
            return false;

        const double fVisionTick = 0.06f;
        bool bVisible = fLastRenderTimeOnScreen + fVisionTick >= fLastSubmitTime;
        return bVisible;
    }
    catch (...) {

        return false;
    }
}
```

### Post #4445208 — Space0001 — 2nd August 2025, 04:21 AM

Let me summarize the current situation

 Valorant has now been upgraded to UE5, which brings the following changes:
 1. Most `float` types have been changed to `double`, including mathematical structures
 2. UE5's physics engine no longer uses PhysX but has switched to Chaos
 3. Changes in decryption algorithms

 What remains unchanged:
 1. `UWorld`
 2. `GName`

 For external modifications, you only need to:
 - Change the `float` types in mathematical structures to `double`
 - Update the decryption algorithm and offsets

 For internal modifications, you'll need to:
 - Readapt function calls and hooks based on UE5's new functions
 - It's recommended to reference internal source code from other games for guidance

GObjectState: 0xB55E4C0

  Code:
```
__forceinline __int64 decrypt_uobject_array(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
{
	unsigned __int64 v5 = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DLL * (key ^ ((key ^ ((unsigned __int64)key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
	unsigned __int64 v6 = v5 % 7;
	unsigned __int64 v7 = HIDWORD(v5);
	unsigned int v8 = (unsigned int)v6 % 7;
	unsigned __int64 v9 = state[v6];

	if ((_DWORD)v6 == 7 * ((unsigned int)v6 / 7))
	{
		v9 = ~v7 ^ ((state[v6] >> ((unsigned __int8)(((int)v7 - 1) % 0x3F) + 1))
			| (v9 << (63 * (unsigned __int8)(((int)v7 - 1) / 0x3F) - ((unsigned __int8)v7 - 1) + 63)));
	}
	else if (v8 == 2)
	{
		v9 = ~(v9 - (unsigned int)(v7 + 2 * v6));
	}
	else if (v8 == 3)
	{
		unsigned int v10 = v7 + 2 * v6;
		unsigned __int64 rotated = (v9 << ((unsigned __int8)(v10 % 0x3F) + 1))
			| (v9 >> (63 * (unsigned __int8)(v10 / 0x3F) - ((unsigned __int8)v7 + 2 * (unsigned __int8)v6) + 63));
		v9 = (rotated >> 1) ^ ((rotated >> 1) ^ (2 * rotated)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAuLL;
	}
	else if (v8 == 4)
	{
		unsigned __int64 step1 = (v9 >> 1) ^ ((v9 >> 1) ^ (2 * v9)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAuLL;
		unsigned __int64 step2 = (step1 >> 2) ^ ((step1 >> 2) ^ (4 * step1)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCuLL;
		unsigned __int64 step3 = (step2 >> 4) ^ ((step2 >> 4) ^ (16 * step2)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0uLL;
		v9 = ~(unsigned __int64)(unsigned int)(v7 + v6)
			^ __ROR8__((step3 >> 8) ^ ((step3 >> 8) ^ (step3 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00uLL, 32);
	}
	else if (v8 == 5)
	{
		v9 = ~((unsigned int)(v7 + 2 * v6) + v9);
	}
	else if (v8 == 6)
	{
		unsigned __int64 xor_val = ~(unsigned __int64)(unsigned int)(v7 + 2 * v6) ^ v9;
		unsigned __int64 step1 = (xor_val >> 1) ^ ((xor_val >> 1) ^ (2 * xor_val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAuLL;
		unsigned __int64 step2 = (step1 >> 2) ^ ((step1 >> 2) ^ (4 * step1)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCuLL;
		unsigned __int64 step3 = (step2 >> 4) ^ ((step2 >> 4) ^ (16 * step2)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0uLL;
		v9 = __ROR8__((step3 >> 8) ^ ((step3 >> 8) ^ (step3 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00uLL, 32);
	}

	return v9 ^ key;
}
```

### Post #4446391 — xelbow — 3rd August 2025, 05:57 PM

> **ZhoneS:**
> Originally Posted by ZhoneS   Is anyone else experiencing crash issues with the external?
>  I'm able to inject the chair without any issues, and ESP displays correctly. However, the chair randomly crashes after a while, sometimes it lasts over 30 minutes, but more often it crashes within 5�10 minutes for no clear reason.
>  This crashes only affects the chair (not the game), and I'm only enabling 2D boxes.
>  Notably, this issue started appearing after the recent UE5 update, and it wasn't happening before.
>  Would appreciate any insight or suggestions, thank you!

Its likely because since the UE5 update you changed some of your mem reads to use FVector (double, double, double) as the size for the read however you did not change the underlying type that is being written to. For example if you used a Vector3 (float, float, float) and you are writing an FVector into that it will corrupt the heap but it wont immediately crash until something tries using that corrupted memory.

 Example of what you probably did

  Code:
```
Vec3
{
float x,y,z;
}
FVec
{
double x,y,z;
}

Vec3 SyncLocation;
mem.Read(addr, &SyncLocation, sizeof(FVec)); // this will corrupt memory
```
  Just enable address sanitizer and it will instantly show you where its happening

struct FVector
{
	FVector() : X(), Y(), Z() { }
	FVector(double X, double Y, double Z) : X(X), Y(Y), Z(Z) { }

	FVector operator + (const FVector& other) const { return { this->X + other.X, this->Y + other.Y, this->Z + other.Z }; }
	FVector operator - (const FVector& other) const { return { this->X - other.X, this->Y - other.Y, this->Z - other.Z }; }
	FVector operator * (double offset) const { return { this->X * offset, this->Y * offset, this->Z * offset }; }
	FVector operator / (double offset) const { return { this->X / offset, this->Y / offset, this->Z / offset }; }

	FVector& operator *= (const double other) { this->X *= other; this->Y *= other; this->Z *= other; return *this; }
	FVector& operator /= (const double other) { this->X /= other; this->Y /= other; this->Z /= other; return *this; }

	FVector& operator = (const FVector& other) { this->X = other.X; this->Y = other.Y; this->Z = other.Z; return *this; }
	FVector& operator += (const FVector& other) { this->X += other.X; this->Y += other.Y; this->Z += other.Z; return *this; }
	FVector& operator -= (const FVector& other) { this->X -= other.X; this->Y -= other.Y; this->Z -= other.Z; return *this; }
	FVector& operator *= (const FVector& other) { this->X *= other.X; this->Y *= other.Y; this->Z *= other.Z; return *this; }
	FVector& operator /= (const FVector& other) { this->X /= other.X; this->Y /= other.Y; this->Z /= other.Z; return *this; }

	operator bool() { return bool(this->X || this->Y || this->Z); }
	friend bool operator == (const FVector& a, const FVector& b) { return a.X == b.X && a.Y == b.Y && a.Z == b.Z; }
	friend bool operator != (const FVector& a, const FVector& b) { return !(a == b); }

	double Dot(const FVector& V) { return X * V.X + Y * V.Y + Z * V.Z; }
	double Distance(FVector V) { return double(sqrtf(powf(V.X - this->X, 2.0) + powf(V.Y - this->Y, 2.0) + powf(V.Z - this->Z, 2.0))); }

	double X, Y, Z;

struct FMinimalViewInfo
{
	FMinimalViewInfo() : Location(), Rotation(), FOV(FOV) { }
	FMinimalViewInfo(FVector Location, FRotator Rotation, float FOV) : Location(Location), Rotation(Rotation), FOV(FOV) { }

	FVector Location;
	FRotator Rotation;
	float FOV;
};

struct FLinearColor
{
	FLinearColor() : R(), G(), B(), A() { }
	FLinearColor(double R, double G, double B, double A) : R(R), G(G), B(B), A(A) { }

	double R, G, B, A;
};

struct FPlane : FVector
{
	FPlane() : W() { }
	FPlane(double W) : W(W) { }

	double W;
};

struct FMatrix
{
	FMatrix() : XPlane(), YPlane(), ZPlane(), WPlane() { }
	FMatrix(FPlane XPlane, FPlane YPlane, FPlane ZPlane, FPlane WPlane) : XPlane(XPlane), YPlane(YPlane), ZPlane(ZPlane), WPlane(WPlane) { }

	FMatrix MatrixMultiplication(FMatrix Other)
	{
		FMatrix Copy = {};

		Copy.WPlane.X = this->WPlane.X * Other.XPlane.X + this->WPlane.Y * Other.YPlane.X + this->WPlane.Z * Other.ZPlane.X + this->WPlane.W * Other.WPlane.X;
		Copy.WPlane.Y = this->WPlane.X * Other.XPlane.Y + this->WPlane.Y * Other.YPlane.Y + this->WPlane.Z * Other.ZPlane.Y + this->WPlane.W * Other.WPlane.Y;
		Copy.WPlane.Z = this->WPlane.X * Other.XPlane.Z + this->WPlane.Y * Other.YPlane.Z + this->WPlane.Z * Other.ZPlane.Z + this->WPlane.W * Other.WPlane.Z;
		Copy.WPlane.W = this->WPlane.X * Other.XPlane.W + this->WPlane.Y * Other.YPlane.W + this->WPlane.Z * Other.ZPlane.W + this->WPlane.W * Other.WPlane.W;

		return Copy;
	}

	static FMatrix RotatorToMatrix(FRotator Rotation)
	{
		FMatrix Copy = {};

		double Pitch = (Rotation.Pitch * 3.14159265358979323846 / 180);
		double Yaw = (Rotation.Yaw * 3.14159265358979323846 / 180);
		double Roll = (Rotation.Roll * 3.14159265358979323846 / 180);

		double SP = sin(Pitch);
		double CP = cos(Pitch);
		double SY = sin(Yaw);
		double CY = cos(Yaw);
		double SR = sin(Roll);
		double CR = cos(Roll);

		Copy.XPlane.X = CP * CY;
		Copy.XPlane.Y = CP * SY;
		Copy.XPlane.Z = SP;

		Copy.YPlane.X = SR * SP * CY - CR * SY;
		Copy.YPlane.Y = SR * SP * SY + CR * CY;
		Copy.YPlane.Z = -SR * CP;

		Copy.ZPlane.X = -(CR * SP * CY + SR * SY);
		Copy.ZPlane.Y = CY * SR - CR * SP * SY;
		Copy.ZPlane.Z = CR * CP;

		Copy.WPlane.W = 1.f;

		return Copy;
	}

	FPlane XPlane, YPlane, ZPlane, WPlane;
};

struct FTransform
{
	FTransform() : Rotation(), Translation(), Scale3D(), UnknownValue() { }
	FTransform(FPlane Rotation, FPlane Translation, FVector Scale3D, double UnknownValue) : Rotation(Rotation), Translation(Translation), Scale3D(Scale3D), UnknownValue(UnknownValue) { }

	FMatrix ToMatrix()
	{
		FMatrix Copy = {};

		double x2 = this->Rotation.X * 2;
		double y2 = this->Rotation.Y * 2;
		double z2 = this->Rotation.Z * 2;

		double xx2 = this->Rotation.X * x2;
		double yy2 = this->Rotation.Y * y2;
		double zz2 = this->Rotation.Z * z2;

		double yz2 = this->Rotation.Y * z2;
		double wx2 = this->Rotation.W * x2;

		double xy2 = this->Rotation.X * y2;
		double wz2 = this->Rotation.W * z2;

		double xz2 = this->Rotation.X * z2;
		double wy2 = this->Rotation.W * y2;

		Copy.XPlane.X = (1.0 - (yy2 + zz2)) * this->Scale3D.X;
		Copy.XPlane.Y = (xy2 + wz2) * this->Scale3D.X;
		Copy.XPlane.Z = (xz2 - wy2) * this->Scale3D.X;

		Copy.YPlane.X = (xy2 - wz2) * this->Scale3D.Y;
		Copy.YPlane.Y = (1.0 - (xx2 + zz2)) * this->Scale3D.Y;
		Copy.YPlane.Z = (yz2 + wx2) * this->Scale3D.Y;

		Copy.ZPlane.X = (xz2 + wy2) * this->Scale3D.Z;
		Copy.ZPlane.Y = (yz2 - wx2) * this->Scale3D.Z;
		Copy.ZPlane.Z = (1.0 - (xx2 + yy2)) * this->Scale3D.Z;

		Copy.WPlane.X = this->Translation.X;
		Copy.WPlane.Y = this->Translation.Y;
		Copy.WPlane.Z = this->Translation.Z;

		Copy.WPlane.W = 1.0;

		return Copy;
	}

	FPlane Rotation;
	FPlane Translation;
	FVector Scale3D;
	double UnknownValue;
};
```

 my external:

  Code:
```
bool uobject::is_a(const std::string& class_name) {
	if (!this) return false;

	uclass* current_class = memory->read_memory<uclass*>(reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(this) + 0x10);
	if (!current_class) return false;

	ustruct* current_struct = reinterpret_cast<ustruct*>(current_class);
	while (current_struct) {
		std::string current_class_name = current_struct->get_fname();
		if (current_class_name == class_name) {
			return true;
		}

		current_struct = memory->read_memory<ustruct*>(reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(current_struct) + 0x48);
	}

	return false;
}

class uobject {
public:
    void* vtable;
    uint32_t flags;
    int32_t index;
    class uclass* class_ptr;
    fname name;
    uint8_t pad_24[0x4];
    class uobject* outer;

    std::string get_fname();
    bool is_a(const std::string& class_name);
};

class ufield : public uobject {
public:
    class ufield* next;
};

class ustruct : public ufield {
public:
    uint8_t pad_38[0x10];
    class ustruct* super;
    class ufield* children;
    class ffield* child_properties;
    int32_t size;
    int32_t min_alignment;
    uint8_t pad_68[0x8];
};

class uclass : public ustruct {
public:
    uint8_t pad_b8[0x28];
    uint64_t cast_flags;
    uint8_t pad_e8[0x38];
    class uobject* default_object;
    uint8_t pad_128[0x8];
};
```

> **xelbow:**
> Originally Posted by xelbow   Its likely because since the UE5 update you changed some of your mem reads to use FVector (double, double, double) as the size for the read however you did not change the underlying type that is being written to. For example if you used a Vector3 (float, float, float) and you are writing an FVector into that it will corrupt the heap but it wont immediately crash until something tries using that corrupted memory.
>
>
>  Example of what you probably did
>
>   Code:
> ```
> Vec3
> {
> float x,y,z;
> }
> FVec
> {
> double x,y,z;
> }
>
> Vec3 SyncLocation;
> mem.Read(addr, &SyncLocation, sizeof(FVec)); // this will corrupt memory
> ```
>   Just enable address sanitizer and it will instantly show you where its happening

I let you compare :

  Code:
```
static bool w2s(Vector3 location, sdk::unreal::FMinimalViewInfo camera_cache, Vector3& screen_loc) {
	auto pov = camera_cache;
	Vector3 rotation = pov.rotation;
	Matrix4x4 temp_matrix = matrix(rotation);

	Vector3 v_axis_x = Vector3(temp_matrix.m[0][0], temp_matrix.m[0][1], temp_matrix.m[0][2]);
	Vector3 v_axis_y = Vector3(temp_matrix.m[1][0], temp_matrix.m[1][1], temp_matrix.m[1][2]);
	Vector3 v_axis_z = Vector3(temp_matrix.m[2][0], temp_matrix.m[2][1], temp_matrix.m[2][2]);

	Vector3 v_delta = location - pov.location;
	Vector3 v_transformed = Vector3(v_delta.dot(v_axis_y), v_delta.dot(v_axis_z), v_delta.dot(v_axis_x));
	if (v_transformed.z < 1.f)
		return false;

	screen_loc.x = (screen_size.x / 2) + v_transformed.x * ((screen_size.x / 2) / tanf(pov.fov * (double)3.14159265358979323846f / 360.f)) / v_transformed.z;
	screen_loc.y = (screen_size.y / 2) - v_transformed.y * ((screen_size.x / 2) / tanf(pov.fov * (double)3.14159265358979323846f / 360.f)) / v_transformed.z;

	if (screen_loc.x > screen_size.x ||
		screen_loc.y > screen_size.y ||
		screen_loc.y < 0 ||
		screen_loc.x < 0) return false;

	return true;
}
```

  Code:
```
auto flow_state_manager = ares_game_instance->get_game_flow_state_manager();
if (!flow_state_manager)
	return;

auto current_state = flow_state_manager->get_current_state();
if (!current_state)
	return;

auto old_flow_state = current_state->get_state_type();
current_state->set_state_type(egame_flow_state_type::main_menu);

current_equippable->clear_weapon_components();
current_equippable->apply_skin(skin_asset, chroma_asset, max_level, nullptr, -1);

current_state->set_state_type(old_flow_state);
```

### Post #4450456 — Reezli — 8th August 2025, 05:59 PM

> **DoubleZocker:**
> Originally Posted by DoubleZocker   I wanted to ask on what the ContentLibary namespace is and how you would get the skin model of the prefered skin to apply it
>  thanks

here:
  Code:
```
namespace ContentLibrary
{
	UObject* ContentLibrary()
	{
		return UObject::StaticFindObject(nullptr, nullptr, L"ShooterGame.Default__ContentLibrary", false);
	}

	void ApplySkin(AAresEquippable* Equippable, UObject* SkinAsset, UObject* ChromaAsset, std::int32_t Level, UObject* CharmData, std::int32_t BuddieLevel)
	{
		UObject* Function = UObject::StaticFindObject(nullptr, nullptr, L"ShooterGame.ContentLibrary.ApplySkin", false);
		struct {
			AAresEquippable* eqp;
			UObject* skinasset;
			UObject* chromaasset;
			std::int32_t level;
			UObject* charmdata;
			std::int32_t buddielevel;
		}Args;
		Args.eqp = Equippable;
		Args.skinasset = SkinAsset;
		Args.chromaasset = ChromaAsset;
		Args.level = Level;
		Args.charmdata = CharmData;
		Args.buddielevel = BuddieLevel;
		Function->ProcessEvent(ContentLibrary(), Function, &Args);
	}
	void ClearWeaponComponents(AAresEquippable* Equippable)
	{
		UObject* Function = UObject::StaticFindObject(nullptr, nullptr, L"ShooterGame.ContentLibrary.ClearWeaponComponents", false);
		struct {
			AAresEquippable* Equippable;
		}Args;
		Args.Equippable = Equippable;
		Function->ProcessEvent(ContentLibrary(), Function, &Args);
	}
}
```

	{

		if (!cachedNameKey)
			cachedNameKey = getfnamekey(Bypass::BaseAddres);

		UINT chunkOffset = key >> 16;
		USHORT nameOffset = key & 0xFFFF;

		std::uintptr_t chunkAddr = Bypass::BaseAddres + Offsets::FNamePool + ((chunkOffset + 2) * 8);
		std::uint64_t namePoolChunk = ReadMemoryAddy<std::uint64_t>(chunkAddr);

		for (std::uint16_t i = 0; i < nameEntry.Header.Len; i++)

			newIdName.id = id;

			fnamesids.push_back(newIdName);

			return finalname;
		}
	}

	inline fvector bone_matrix(int index, uintptr_t array, uintptr_t mesh)
	{
		ftransform comp_to_world = km::RPM<ftransform>(mesh + offsets::component_to_world);
		ftransform bone = km::RPM<ftransform>(array + (index * 0x60));
		D3DMATRIX Matrix;
		Matrix = MatrixMultiplication(bone.ToMatrixWithScale(), comp_to_world.ToMatrixWithScale());

		return fvector(Matrix._42, Matrix._43, Matrix._44);
	}

	inline FVector2D w2s(fvector world_location, uintptr_t camera_manager) {
		auto viewInfo = km::RPM<FMinimalViewInfo>(camera_manager + offsets::camera_private + 0x10);

		FVector2D Screenlocation = FVector2D(0, 0);
		D3DMATRIX tempMatrix = matrix(viewInfo.Rotation, fvector(0, 0, 0));

		fvector vAxisX = fvector(tempMatrix.m[0][0], tempMatrix.m[0][1], tempMatrix.m[0][2]),
			vAxisY = fvector(tempMatrix.m[1][0], tempMatrix.m[1][1], tempMatrix.m[1][2]),
			vAxisZ = fvector(tempMatrix.m[2][0], tempMatrix.m[2][1], tempMatrix.m[2][2]);

		fvector vDelta = world_location - viewInfo.Location;
		fvector vTransformed = fvector(vDelta.Dot(vAxisY), vDelta.Dot(vAxisZ), vDelta.Dot(vAxisX));

		if (vTransformed.z < 1.f) vTransformed.z = 1.f;

		Screenlocation.x = (center_x / 2.f) + vTransformed.x * ((center_x / 2.f) / tanf(viewInfo.FOV * (float)M_PI / 360.f)) / vTransformed.z;
		Screenlocation.y = (center_y / 2.f) - vTransformed.y * ((center_y / 2.f) / tanf(viewInfo.FOV * (float)M_PI / 360.f)) / vTransformed.z;

		return Screenlocation;
	}

 xor key decrypt
  Code:
```
uint64_t Utils::DecryptXORKeys(uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state) {
	uint64_t mixed = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * static_cast<uint64_t>(key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
	uint32_t index = mixed % 7;
	uint32_t high = mixed >> 32;
	uint64_t v = state[index];

	uint64_t sum = static_cast<uint64_t>(index) + high;
	unsigned int mod = sum % 63;
	unsigned int div = sum / 63;
	unsigned int low = static_cast<unsigned int>(sum % 256);
	unsigned int shiftR = mod + 1;
	unsigned int shiftL = 63 * div - low + 63;

	switch (index) {
	case 0:
		v = ~(v - (high - 1));
		break;
	case 1:
		v ^= static_cast<uint32_t>(index + high) ^ static_cast<uint32_t>(high + 2 * index);
		break;
	case 2: {
		uint64_t v9 = ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (v << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL) >> 2;
		uint64_t v10 = v9 ^ (v9 ^ (4ULL * ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (v << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL))) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
		uint64_t v11 = v10 >> 4;
		uint64_t temp12 = ((v11 ^ (v11 ^ (v10 << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL) >> 8) ^
			(((v11 ^ (v11 ^ (v10 << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL) >> 8) ^
				((v11 ^ (v11 ^ (v10 << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL) << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
		uint64_t swapped = (temp12 << 32) | (temp12 >> 32);
		v = ROR64(swapped, shiftR);
		break;
	}
	case 3: {
		uint64_t v29 = ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (v << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL) >> 2;
		uint64_t v30 = v29 ^ (v29 ^ (4ULL * ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (v << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL))) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
		uint64_t v31 = v30 >> 4;
		uint64_t temp32 = ((v31 ^ (v31 ^ (v30 << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL) >> 8) ^
			(((v31 ^ (v31 ^ (v30 << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL) >> 8) ^
				((v31 ^ (v31 ^ (v30 << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL) << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
		uint64_t swapped = (temp32 << 32) | (temp32 >> 32);
		v = ROL64(swapped, shiftR);
		break;
	}
	case 4:
		v += static_cast<uint64_t>(high + 2 * index) + static_cast<uint64_t>(index + high);
		break;
	case 5:
		v = (~v << shiftL) | (~v >> shiftR);
		break;
	case 6: {
		uint64_t v13 = ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (v << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL) >> 2;
		uint64_t v14 = v13 ^ (v13 ^ (4ULL * ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (v << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL))) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
		uint64_t v15 = (v14 >> 4) ^ ((v14 >> 4) ^ (v14 << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
		uint64_t temp = (v15 >> 8) ^ ((v15 >> 8) ^ (v15 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
		uint64_t swapped = (temp << 32) | (temp >> 32);
		v = swapped - static_cast<uint32_t>(index + high);
		break;
	}
	}

	uint64_t result = v ^ key;

	return result;

}
```

Vector2 w2s(Vector3 WorldLocation)
{

    viewInfo = driver::RPM<FMinimalViewInfo>(player_camera_manager + offsets::camera_private + 0x10);

    D3DMATRIX tempMatrix = toMatrix(viewInfo.Rotation);

    Vector3 vAxisX = Vector3(tempMatrix._11, tempMatrix._12, tempMatrix._13);
    Vector3 vAxisY = Vector3(tempMatrix._21, tempMatrix._22, tempMatrix._23);
    Vector3 vAxisZ = Vector3(tempMatrix._31, tempMatrix._32, tempMatrix._33);

    Vector3 vDelta = WorldLocation - viewInfo.Location;
    Vector3 vTransformed = Vector3(vDelta.Dot(vAxisY), vDelta.Dot(vAxisZ), vDelta.Dot(vAxisX));

    if (vTransformed.z < 1.f) vTransformed.z = 1.f;

    float fov = viewInfo.FOV;
    float aspectRatio = 16.f / 9.f;

    float screenAspectRatio = (float)width / (float)height;
    float renderWidth = width;
    float renderHeight = height;
    float xOffset = 0.f;
    float yOffset = 0.f;

    //letterboxx handling
    if (screenAspectRatio > aspectRatio)
    {
        renderWidth = height * aspectRatio;
        xOffset = (width - renderWidth) / 2.f;
    }

    else if (screenAspectRatio < aspectRatio)
    {
        renderHeight = width / aspectRatio;
        yOffset = (height - renderHeight) / 2.f;
    }

    float fovFactor = renderWidth / (2.f * tanf(fov * (float)M_PI / 360.f));

    float screenX = xOffset + renderWidth / 2.f + vTransformed.x * fovFactor / vTransformed.z;
    float screenY = yOffset + renderHeight / 2.f - vTransformed.y * fovFactor / vTransformed.z;

    return Vector2(screenX, screenY);
}
```

	// rotate left
	template<class T> T __ROL__(T value, int count)
	{
		const uint nbits = sizeof(T) * 8;

		if (count > 0)
		{
			count %= nbits;
			T high = value >> (nbits - count);
			if (T(-1) < 0) // signed value
				high &= ~((T(-1) << count));
			value <<= count;
			value |= high;
		}
		else

			T low = value << (nbits - count);
			value >>= count;
			value |= low;
		}
		return value;
	}

	inline uint64 __ROL8__(uint64 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint64)value, count); }

		unsigned __int64 v30; // r8

		unsigned __int64 v32; // rdx
		unsigned __int64 v33; // rcx

		v19 = 2685821657736338717i64
			* ((unsigned int)key ^ (unsigned int)(key << 25) ^ (((unsigned int)key ^ ((unsigned __int64)(unsigned int)key >> 15)) >> 12))

```
typedef struct ShadowRegionsDataStructure
{
    uintptr_t OriginalPML4_t;
    uintptr_t ClonedPML4_t;
    uintptr_t GameCr3;
    uintptr_t ClonedCr3;
    uintptr_t FreeIndex;
} ShadowRegionsDataStructure;

uint64_t find_RAX()
{
    int cpuInfo[4] = { 0 };
    __cpuid(cpuInfo, 1);
    return (uint64_t)cpuInfo[0];
}

uintptr_t decrypt_cloned_cr3(uintptr_t vgkbase) {
    uint64_t _RAX = find_RAX();
    BYTE byte_1400807D0 = driver::read_kernel<BYTE>(vgkbase + 0x827D0);
    uintptr_t key = driver::read_kernel<uintptr_t>(vgkbase + 0x82720);

    uint64_t mask = byte_1400807D0 & 0x73;

    uint64_t v11 =
        (int)_RAX *
        (
            0x7D90DC33C620C593ULL * key * (0x13D0F34E00000000ULL * key + 0x483C4F8900000000ULL) +
            0xFD90DC33C620C592ULL * ~(key * (0x13D0F34E00000000ULL * key + 0x483C4F8900000000ULL)) +
            (
                key * (
                    0x31C31A1E80000000ULL * key +
                    0x31C31A1E80000000ULL +
                    0x55494E5B80000000ULL * (int)_RAX +
                    0xC83B18136241A38DULL * ~(int)_RAX +
                    0x72F1C9B7E241A38DULL *
                    (
                        ((int)_RAX | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
                        (0x3F71D992FBB2CCEAULL - ((int)_RAX & 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL))
                        )
                    ) + 0x71C31A1E80000000ULL
                ) * (
                    0x99BF7D2380CF6EC3ULL * (int)_RAX +
                    ((uint64_t)(int)_RAX << 63) +
                    0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ULL +
                    0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ULL * ~(int)_RAX
                    ) +
            0x2183995CC620C592ULL
            );

    uint64_t expr =
        0x49B74B6480000000ULL * key +
        0xC2D8B464B4418C6CULL * ~mask +
        0x66B8CDC1FFFFFFFFULL * mask +
        0x5C1FE6A2B4418C6DULL * ((mask & key) - (key | ~mask));

    uint64_t logic =
        -3 * ~key +
        (mask ^ key) +
        -2 * (mask ^ (mask | key)) +
        2 * (((byte_1400807D0 & 0x10 | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) ^ 0xC08E266D044D3314ULL) + (~key | (mask ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL))) -
        (mask ^ ~key ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
        0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL;

    uintptr_t DecryptedCR3 =
        0x137FEEF6AB38CFB4ULL * (expr * logic) +
        ((~(expr * logic) ^ ~v11) << 63) +
        0x6C80110954C7304DULL *
        (
            ((int)_RAX & (expr * logic)) -
            (~(int)_RAX & ~(expr * logic)) -
            (int)_RAX
            ) -
        0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL * v11 -
        0x4F167C5CD4C7304EULL;

    return DecryptedCR3;
}

uintptr_t find_pml4_base(uintptr_t vgk_base)
{
    ShadowRegionsDataStructure Data = driver::read_kernel<ShadowRegionsDataStructure>(vgk_base + 0x82708);
    uintptr_t DecClonedCr3 = decrypt_cloned_cr3(vgk_base);
    if (!DecClonedCr3) return 0;
    driver::cr3_context = DecClonedCr3;
    uintptr_t source = Data.FreeIndex << 39;
    return source;
}

uintptr_t get_world(uintptr_t vgk_base)
{
    auto pml4_base = find_pml4_base(vgk_base);
    if (pml4_base == 0)
    {
        return 0;
    }

    for (int i = 0x0; i < 0x500; i += 0x8)
    {
        uintptr_t address_to_read = pml4_base + i;
        auto potential_uworld = driver::read<uintptr_t>(address_to_read);

        if (potential_uworld != 0)
        {
            uintptr_t level_address = potential_uworld + offsets::persistent_level;
            auto level = driver::read<uintptr_t>(level_address);

            if (level != 0)
            {
                uintptr_t owning_world_address = level + offsets::uworld;
                auto owning_world = driver::read<uintptr_t>(owning_world_address);

                if (owning_world == potential_uworld)
                {
                    return potential_uworld;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

void cache_game()
{
    //uintptr_t game_base = driver::get_process_base_address();
    uintptr_t vgk_base = driver::get_kernel_module_base(xorstr_(L"vgk.sys"));

    while (true)
    {
        //uintptr_t world_ptr = driver::read<uintptr_t>(driver::read<uintptr_t>(game_base + offsets::uworld_state));
        uintptr_t world_ptr = get_world(vgk_base);
        printf("world_ptr: 0x%llx\n", world_ptr);
        uintptr_t game_instance = driver::read<uintptr_t>(world_ptr + offsets::game_instance);
        printf("game_instance: 0x%llx\n", game_instance);
        uintptr_t game_state = driver::read<uintptr_t>(world_ptr + offsets::game_state);
        printf("game_state: 0x%llx\n", game_state);
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(1));
    }
}

    count &= mask;

    count &= mask;

uint64_t DecryptXORKeys(uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state) {
    uint64_t mixed = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * static_cast<uint64_t>(key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
    uint32_t index = mixed % 7;
    uint32_t high = mixed >> 32;
    uint64_t v = state[index];

    uint64_t sum = static_cast<uint64_t>(index) + high;
    unsigned int mod = sum % 63;
    unsigned int div = sum / 63;
    unsigned int low = static_cast<unsigned int>(sum % 256);
    unsigned int shiftR = mod + 1;
    unsigned int shiftL = 63 * div - low + 63;

    switch (index) {
    case 0:
        v = ~(v - (high - 1));
        break;
    case 1:
        v ^= static_cast<uint32_t>(index + high) ^ static_cast<uint32_t>(high + 2 * index);
        break;

        uint64_t v10 = v9 ^ (v9 ^ (4ULL * ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (v << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL))) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
        uint64_t v11 = v10 >> 4;
        uint64_t temp12 = ((v11 ^ (v11 ^ (v10 << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL) >> 8) ^
            (((v11 ^ (v11 ^ (v10 << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL) >> 8) ^
                ((v11 ^ (v11 ^ (v10 << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL) << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;

        uint64_t v30 = v29 ^ (v29 ^ (4ULL * ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (v << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL))) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
        uint64_t v31 = v30 >> 4;
        uint64_t temp32 = ((v31 ^ (v31 ^ (v30 << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL) >> 8) ^
            (((v31 ^ (v31 ^ (v30 << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL) >> 8) ^
                ((v31 ^ (v31 ^ (v30 << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL) << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;

        v = ROL64(swapped, shiftR);

        v += static_cast<uint64_t>(high + 2 * index) + static_cast<uint64_t>(index + high);
