        uint64_t swapped = (temp << 32) | (temp >> 32);
        v = swapped - static_cast<uint32_t>(index + high);
        break;
    }
    }

    uint64_t result = v ^ key;

    return result;

}

std::string get_fname(int key)
{
    UINT chunkOffset = (UINT)(key >> 16);
    USHORT nameOffset = (USHORT)key;
    uint64_t poolAddress = driver::base_address + offsets::fname_pool + ((chunkOffset + 2) * 8);
    uint64_t namePoolChunk = driver::read<uint64_t>(poolAddress);
    uint64_t entryOffset = namePoolChunk + (4 * nameOffset);
    FNameEntry nameEntry = driver::read<FNameEntry>(entryOffset);

    std::string name(nameEntry.AnsiName);

    uintptr_t nameKey = 0;
    if (pml4_base != 0)
    {
        nameKey = driver::read<uintptr_t>(pml4_base + 0x0);
    }
    else
    {
        uint64_t poolState = driver::read<uintptr_t>(driver::base_address + offsets::fname_pool_state);
        uint32_t poolStateKey = driver::read<uint32_t>(driver::base_address + offsets::fname_pool_key);
        nameKey = DecryptXORKeys(poolStateKey, &poolState);
    }

    if (name.size() < nameEntry.Header.Len)
    {
        return name;
    }

    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < nameEntry.Header.Len; i++)
    {
        BYTE b = i & 3;
        name[i] ^= nameEntry.Header.Len ^ *((LPBYTE)&nameKey + b);
    }

    return name;
}

Code:
```
[+] [RVA] [UWorld] [0xb5f6f60]
[+] [RVA] [GObjects] [0xb323990]
[+] [RVA] [FNamePool] [0xb765780]
[+] [RVA] [FNameState] [0xb942640]
[+] [RVA] [ProcessEvent] [0x194bdf0]
[+] [RVA] [StaticFindObject] [0x1975e60]
[+] [RVA] [TriggerVEH] [0x1566270]
```
  new decrypt
  Code:
```
uint64_t Utils::DecryptXORKeys(uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state) {
	uint64_t hash = static_cast<uint64_t>(key) ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (static_cast<uint64_t>(key) << 25);
	uint64_t mixed = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * hash;
	uint32_t index = mixed % 7;
	uint64_t high = mixed >> 32;
	uint64_t v = state[index];

	uint8_t byte_sum, r;
	uint32_t shiftR, shiftL;

	switch (index) {
	case 0:
		v += high - static_cast<uint32_t>(high - 1);
		break;
	case 1:
		v = ~v ^ static_cast<uint32_t>(high + 2 * index);
		break;
	case 2:
		byte_sum = static_cast<uint8_t>(high + 2 * index);
		r = byte_sum % 63;
		shiftL = 63 - r;
		v = std::rotl(v, shiftL) - static_cast<uint32_t>(high + index);
		break;
	case 3:
		byte_sum = static_cast<uint8_t>(high + 2 * index);
		r = byte_sum % 63;
		shiftL = 63 - r;
		{
			uint64_t v17 = std::rotl(v, shiftL);
			v = (v17 >> 1) ^ ((v17 >> 1) ^ (v17 << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
		}
		break;
	case 4:
		byte_sum = static_cast<uint8_t>(high + index);
		r = byte_sum % 63;
		shiftL = 63 - r;
		v = std::rotl(~v, shiftL);
		break;
	case 5:
	{
		uint64_t temp1 = (v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (v << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
		uint64_t v18 = temp1 >> 2;
		uint64_t temp2 = v18 ^ (v18 ^ (temp1 << 2)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
		uint64_t v19 = temp2;
		uint64_t temp3 = (v19 >> 4) ^ ((v19 >> 4) ^ (v19 << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
		uint64_t v20 = temp3;
		uint64_t temp4 = (v20 >> 8) ^ ((v20 >> 8) ^ (v20 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
		v = std::rotr(temp4, 32) - static_cast<uint32_t>(high + index);
	}
	break;
	case 6:
		byte_sum = static_cast<uint8_t>(high + 2 * index);
		r = byte_sum % 63;
		shiftL = 63 - r;
		uint64_t temp = std::rotl(v, shiftL);
		byte_sum = static_cast<uint8_t>(high + index);
		r = byte_sum % 63;
		shiftL = 63 - r;
		v = std::rotl(temp, shiftL);
		break;
	}

	uint64_t result = v ^ key;
	return result;
}
```

```
__forceinline __int64 decrypt_xor_keys(uint32_t StateKey, uintptr_t* State)
{
	uint64_t mixed = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * static_cast<uint64_t>(StateKey ^ ((StateKey ^ (StateKey >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (StateKey << 25));
	uint32_t index = mixed % 7;
	uint32_t high = mixed >> 32;
	uint64_t v = State[index];

	switch (index % 7) {
	case 0:
		// v += high - (unsigned int)(high - 1);
		v += high - (high - 1);
		break;

	case 1:
		// v = ~(*((_QWORD *)&FNameState + index) ^ ~(unsigned __int64)(unsigned int)(high + 2 * index));
		v = ~(v ^ ~static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<uint32_t>(high + 2 * index)));
		break;

	case 2: {
		// Complex rotation with modulo calculation
		uint32_t shift_val = high + 2 * index;
		uint32_t mod_val = static_cast<uint32_t>(((static_cast<uint64_t>(shift_val) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32) +
			((shift_val - ((static_cast<uint64_t>(shift_val) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32)) >> 1)) >> 5;
		uint32_t shift_amount = 63 * mod_val;
		uint32_t left_shift = shift_amount - shift_val + 63;
		uint32_t right_shift = shift_val - shift_amount + 1;

		v = ((v << left_shift) | (v >> right_shift)) - static_cast<uint32_t>(high + index);
		break;
	}

	case 3: {
		// Bit reversal pattern with rotation
		uint32_t shift_val = high + 2 * index;
		uint32_t mod_val = static_cast<uint32_t>(((static_cast<uint64_t>(shift_val) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32) +
			((shift_val - ((static_cast<uint64_t>(shift_val) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32)) >> 1)) >> 5;

		uint64_t rotated = (v << (63 * mod_val - shift_val + 63)) | (v >> (shift_val - 63 * mod_val + 1));
		v = (rotated >> 1) ^ ((rotated >> 1) ^ (2 * rotated)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
		break;
	}

	case 4: {
		// Complement with rotation
		uint32_t sum_val = high + index;
		uint32_t mod_val = static_cast<uint32_t>(((static_cast<uint64_t>(sum_val) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32) +
			((sum_val - ((static_cast<uint64_t>(sum_val) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32)) >> 1)) >> 5;

		uint32_t left_shift = sum_val - 63 * mod_val + 1;
		uint32_t right_shift = 63 * mod_val - sum_val + 63;

		v = (~v << left_shift) | (~v >> right_shift);
		break;
	}

	case 5: {
		// Bit reversal with multiple stages
		uint64_t stage1 = ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (2 * v)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL) >> 2;
		uint64_t stage2 = stage1 ^ (stage1 ^ (4 * ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (2 * v)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL))) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
		uint64_t stage3 = (stage2 >> 4) ^ ((stage2 >> 4) ^ (16 * stage2)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
		v = __ROR8__((stage3 >> 8) ^ ((stage3 >> 8) ^ (stage3 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL, 32) - static_cast<uint32_t>(high + index);
		break;
	}

	case 6: {
		// Double rotation with modulo calculations
		uint32_t shift_val1 = high + 2 * index;
		uint32_t mod_val1 = static_cast<uint32_t>(((static_cast<uint64_t>(shift_val1) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32) +
			((shift_val1 - ((static_cast<uint64_t>(shift_val1) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32)) >> 1)) >> 5;

		// First rotation
		uint64_t first_rot = (v << (63 * mod_val1 - shift_val1 + 63)) | (v >> (shift_val1 - 63 * mod_val1 + 1));

		// Second rotation
		uint32_t shift_val2 = high + index;
		uint32_t mod_val2 = static_cast<uint32_t>(((static_cast<uint64_t>(shift_val2) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32) +
			((shift_val2 - ((static_cast<uint64_t>(shift_val2) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32)) >> 1)) >> 5;

		v = (first_rot << (shift_val2 - 63 * mod_val2 + 1)) | (first_rot >> (63 * mod_val2 - shift_val2 + 63));
		break;
	}
	}

	return v ^ StateKey;
}

> 		uint64_t rotated = (v << (63 * mod_val - shift_val + 63)) | (v >> (shift_val - 63 * mod_val + 1));
> 		v = (rotated >> 1) ^ ((rotated >> 1) ^ (2 * rotated)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
> 		break;
> 	}
>
> 	case 4: {
> 		// Complement with rotation
> 		uint32_t sum_val = high + index;
> 		uint32_t mod_val = static_cast<uint32_t>(((static_cast<uint64_t>(sum_val) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32) +
> 			((sum_val - ((static_cast<uint64_t>(sum_val) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32)) >> 1)) >> 5;
>
> 		uint32_t left_shift = sum_val - 63 * mod_val + 1;
> 		uint32_t right_shift = 63 * mod_val - sum_val + 63;
>
> 		v = (~v << left_shift) | (~v >> right_shift);
> 		break;
> 	}
>
> 	case 5: {
> 		// Bit reversal with multiple stages
> 		uint64_t stage1 = ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (2 * v)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL) >> 2;
> 		uint64_t stage2 = stage1 ^ (stage1 ^ (4 * ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (2 * v)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL))) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
> 		uint64_t stage3 = (stage2 >> 4) ^ ((stage2 >> 4) ^ (16 * stage2)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
> 		v = __ROR8__((stage3 >> 8) ^ ((stage3 >> 8) ^ (stage3 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL, 32) - static_cast<uint32_t>(high + index);
> 		break;
> 	}
>
> 	case 6: {
> 		// Double rotation with modulo calculations
> 		uint32_t shift_val1 = high + 2 * index;
> 		uint32_t mod_val1 = static_cast<uint32_t>(((static_cast<uint64_t>(shift_val1) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32) +
> 			((shift_val1 - ((static_cast<uint64_t>(shift_val1) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32)) >> 1)) >> 5;
>
> 		// First rotation
> 		uint64_t first_rot = (v << (63 * mod_val1 - shift_val1 + 63)) | (v >> (shift_val1 - 63 * mod_val1 + 1));
>
> 		// Second rotation
> 		uint32_t shift_val2 = high + index;
> 		uint32_t mod_val2 = static_cast<uint32_t>(((static_cast<uint64_t>(shift_val2) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32) +
> 			((shift_val2 - ((static_cast<uint64_t>(shift_val2) * 0x410410410410411ULL) >> 32)) >> 1)) >> 5;
>
> 		v = (first_rot << (shift_val2 - 63 * mod_val2 + 1)) | (first_rot >> (63 * mod_val2 - shift_val2 + 63));
> 		break;
> 	}
> 	}
>
> 	return v ^ StateKey;
> }
> ```

        0x5C1FE6A2B4418C6DULL * ((v5 & key) - (key | ~v5));

    uint64_t logic =
        -3 * ~key +
        (v5 ^ key) +
        -2 * (v5 ^ (v5 | key)) +
        2 * (((byte_1400817C0 & 0x10 | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) ^ 0xC08E266D044D3314ULL) + (~key | (v5 ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL))) -
        (v5 ^ ~key ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
        0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL;

    uint64_t DecryptedCR3 =
        0x137FEEF6AB38CFB4ULL * (expr * logic) +
        ((~(expr * logic) ^ ~v12) << 63) +
        0x6C80110954C7304DULL *
        (
            ((int)_RAX & (expr * logic)) -
            (~(int)_RAX & ~(expr * logic)) -
            (int)_RAX
            ) -
        0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL *
        v12 -
        0x4F167C5CD4C7304EULL;

    return DecryptedCR3;
}

uintptr_t zels::find_pml4_base()
{
    ShadowRegionsDataStructure Data = readKernel<ShadowRegionsDataStructure>((uintptr_t)zels::GetVgkBaseAddress() + 0x82708);
    uintptr_t DecClonedCr3 = zels::decryptedClonedCR3();
    if (!DecClonedCr3) return 0;
    zels::CustomCr3 = DecClonedCr3;
    uintptr_t source = Data.FreeIndex << 39;
    return source;
}

  CPP:
```
inline uint64_t find_RAX()
{
    int cpuInfo[4] = { 0 };
    __cpuid(cpuInfo, 1);
    return (uint64_t)cpuInfo[0];
}

inline uintptr_t decrypted_cloned_cr3(bool hvci) {
    uint64_t _RAX = find_RAX(); // EAX

    BYTE byte_1400817C0;
    uint64_t key;

    if (hvci) {
        byte_1400817C0 = km::RPM<uint32_t>(km::vgk + 0x839C0); // 1.17.12.4 vgk
        key = km::RPM<uint64_t>(km::vgk + 0x83910);
    }
    else {
        byte_1400817C0 = km::RKA<uint32_t>(km::vgk + 0x839C0); // 1.17.12.4 vgk
        key = km::RKA<uint64_t>(km::vgk + 0x83910);
    }

    uint64_t v5 = byte_1400817C0 & 0x73;

    uint64_t v12 =
        (int)_RAX *
        (
            0x7D90DC33C620C593ULL * key * (0x13D0F34E00000000ULL * key + 0x483C4F8900000000ULL) +
            0xFD90DC33C620C592ULL * ~(key * (0x13D0F34E00000000ULL * key + 0x483C4F8900000000ULL)) +
            (
                key * (
                    0x31C31A1E80000000ULL * key +
                    0x31C31A1E80000000ULL +
                    0x55494E5B80000000ULL * (int)_RAX +
                    0xC83B18136241A38DULL * ~(int)_RAX +
                    0x72F1C9B7E241A38DULL *
                    (
                        ((int)_RAX | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
                        (0x3F71D992FBB2CCEAULL - ((int)_RAX & 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL))
                        )
                    ) + 0x71C31A1E80000000ULL
                )
            * (
                0x99BF7D2380CF6EC3ULL * (int)_RAX +
                ((uint64_t)(int)_RAX << 63) +
                0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ULL +
                0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ULL * ~(int)_RAX
                ) +
            0x2183995CC620C592ULL
            );

    uint64_t expr =
        0x49B74B6480000000ULL * key +
        0xC2D8B464B4418C6CULL * ~v5 +
        0x66B8CDC1FFFFFFFFULL * v5 +
        0x5C1FE6A2B4418C6DULL * ((v5 & key) - (key | ~v5));

    uint64_t logic =
        -3 * ~key +
        (v5 ^ key) +
        -2 * (v5 ^ (v5 | key)) +
        2 * (((byte_1400817C0 & 0x10 | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) ^ 0xC08E266D044D3314ULL) + (~key | (v5 ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL))) -
        (v5 ^ ~key ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
        0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL;

    uint64_t DecryptedCR3 =
        0x137FEEF6AB38CFB4ULL * (expr * logic) +
        ((~(expr * logic) ^ ~v12) << 63) +
        0x6C80110954C7304DULL *
        (
            ((int)_RAX & (expr * logic)) -
            (~(int)_RAX & ~(expr * logic)) -
            (int)_RAX
            ) -
        0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL *
        v12 -
        0x4F167C5CD4C7304EULL;

    return DecryptedCR3;
}

inline uintptr_t find_pml4_base(bool hvci)
{
    ShadowRegionsDataStructure Data;

    if (hvci)
    {
        km::cr3_context = km::readcr3(); //Here you set cr3 as ntoskrnl's cr3 to get ShadowRegions
        Data = km::RPM<ShadowRegionsDataStructure>(km::vgk + 0x838F8);

        uintptr_t DecryptedClonedCR3 = decrypted_cloned_cr3(hvci);
        if (!DecryptedClonedCR3) return 0;

        km::cr3_context = DecryptedClonedCR3;
    }
    else
    {
        Data = km::RKA<ShadowRegionsDataStructure>(km::vgk + 0x838F8);

        uintptr_t DecClonedCr3 = decrypted_cloned_cr3(hvci);
        if (!DecClonedCr3) return 0;

        km::cr3_context = DecClonedCr3;
    }

    uintptr_t source = Data.FreeIndex << 39;
    return source;
}

uintptr_t BruteForceUworld(uintptr_t pml4_base) {
	constexpr uintptr_t initial_offset = 0x1C0;
	constexpr uintptr_t max_offset = 0x500;
	constexpr uintptr_t increment = 0x8;

	uintptr_t uworld_offset = km::RPM<uintptr_t>(pml4_base + initial_offset);
	bool found = false;

	for (uintptr_t i = increment; i < max_offset; i += increment) {
		uintptr_t potential_uworld = km::RPM<uintptr_t>(pml4_base + i);
		if (potential_uworld == 0) {
			continue; // Skip null pointers
		}

		uintptr_t level = km::RPM<uintptr_t>(potential_uworld + 0x38);
		if (level == 0) {
			continue; // Skip invalid levels
		}

		uintptr_t owning_world = km::RPM<uintptr_t>(level + 0xC0);
		if (owning_world == potential_uworld) {

			world = potential_uworld;

			printf("[✓] Found Uworld!\n");
			printf("    Offset: 0x%X\n", i);
			printf("    WorldPtr: 0x%llx\n", potential_uworld);
			printf("    ULevel: 0x%llx\n", level);
			printf("    OwningWorld: 0x%llx\n", owning_world);

			found = true;
			break;
		}
	}

	if (!found) {
		printf("[!] Uworld not found within the searched range.\n");
	}

	return found ? world : 0;
}

void cache()
{
printf("PML4BASE : 0x%p\n", pml4_base);
BruteForceUworld(pml4_base);

while (true)
{
	game_instance = km::RPM<uintptr_t>(world + offsets::game_instance);
	persistent_level = km::RPM<uintptr_t>(world + offsets::persistent_level);
}
}

constexpr ULONG read_code = CTL_CODE(FILE_DEVICE_UNKNOWN, 0x776, METHOD_BUFFERED, FILE_SPECIAL_ACCESS);

namespace driver
{
    HANDLE m_driver_handle = nullptr;

    struct info_t
    {
        HANDLE target_pid = 0;
        void* cr3_context = 0x0;
        void* target_address = 0x0;
        void* buffer_address = 0x0;
        SIZE_T size = 0;
        SIZE_T return_size = 0;
    };

    uintptr_t cr3_context = 0;
    uintptr_t vgk = 0;
    uintptr_t base = 0;
    uintptr_t process_id = 0;
    bool hvci_enabled = false;

    void initialize_driver(LPCSTR file_name)
    {
        m_driver_handle = CreateFileA(file_name, GENERIC_READ, 0, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
    }

    void attach_to_process(DWORD process_id) {
        info_t io_info;

        io_info.target_pid = (HANDLE)process_id;

        DeviceIoControl(m_driver_handle, init_code, &io_info, sizeof(io_info), &io_info, sizeof(io_info), nullptr, nullptr);
    }

    void RPMRAW(uintptr_t address, uintptr_t buffer, size_t size) {
        info_t io_info;
        io_info.cr3_context = (void*)cr3_context;
        io_info.target_address = (void*)address;
        io_info.buffer_address = (void*)buffer;
        io_info.size = size;

        DeviceIoControl(m_driver_handle, read_code, &io_info, sizeof(io_info), &io_info, sizeof(io_info), nullptr, nullptr);
    }

    template<typename T>
    void RPMARRAY(uintptr_t address, T* array, size_t len)
    {
        RPMRAW(address, (uintptr_t)array, sizeof(T) * len);
    }

    template<typename T> T RPM(uintptr_t address) {
        info_t io_info;
        T read_data{};

        io_info.cr3_context = (void*)cr3_context;
        io_info.target_address = (void*)address;
        io_info.buffer_address = (void*)&read_data;
        io_info.size = sizeof(T);

        DeviceIoControl(m_driver_handle, read_code, &io_info, sizeof(io_info), &io_info, sizeof(io_info), nullptr, nullptr);

        return read_data;
    }

    template<typename T> T RKA(uintptr_t address, size_t additional_size = 0) {
        info_t io_info;
        T read_data{};

        io_info.target_address = (void*)address;
        io_info.buffer_address = (void*)&read_data;
        io_info.size = sizeof(T) + additional_size;

        DeviceIoControl(m_driver_handle, read_kernel_code, &io_info, sizeof(io_info), &io_info, sizeof(io_info), nullptr, nullptr);

        return read_data;
    }

}

namespace utils
{
    DWORD get_process_id(LPCTSTR process_name)
    {
        PROCESSENTRY32 pt{};
        HANDLE hsnap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
        pt.dwSize = sizeof(PROCESSENTRY32);
        if (Process32First(hsnap, &pt)) {
            do {
                if (!lstrcmpi(pt.szExeFile, process_name)) {
                    CloseHandle(hsnap);
                    return pt.th32ProcessID;
                }
            } while (Process32Next(hsnap, &pt));
        }
        CloseHandle(hsnap);
        return 0;
    }

    uintptr_t get_process_base_id(DWORD processID)
    {
        DWORD_PTR   baseAddress = 0;
        HANDLE      processHandle = OpenProcess(PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, FALSE, processID);
        HMODULE* moduleArray;
        LPBYTE      moduleArrayBytes;
        DWORD       bytesRequired;

        if (processHandle)
        {
            if (EnumProcessModules(processHandle, NULL, 0, &bytesRequired))
            {
                if (bytesRequired)
                {
                    moduleArrayBytes = (LPBYTE)LocalAlloc(LPTR, bytesRequired);

                    if (moduleArrayBytes)
                    {
                        unsigned int moduleCount;

                        moduleCount = bytesRequired / sizeof(HMODULE);
                        moduleArray = (HMODULE*)moduleArrayBytes;

                        if (EnumProcessModules(processHandle, moduleArray, bytesRequired, &bytesRequired))
                        {
                            baseAddress = (DWORD_PTR)moduleArray[0];
                        }

                        LocalFree(moduleArrayBytes);
                    }
                }
            }

            CloseHandle(processHandle);
        }

        return baseAddress;
    }

    typedef struct _SYSTEM_MODULE {
        PVOID  Reserved1;
        PVOID  Reserved2;
        PVOID  ImageBase;
        ULONG  ImageSize;
        ULONG  Flags;
        USHORT Index;
        USHORT Unknown;
        USHORT LoadCount;
        USHORT ModuleNameOffset;
        CHAR   ImageName[256];
    } SYSTEM_MODULE, * PSYSTEM_MODULE;

    typedef struct _SYSTEM_MODULE_INFORMATION {
        ULONG NumberOfModules;
        SYSTEM_MODULE Modules[1];
    } SYSTEM_MODULE_INFORMATION, * PSYSTEM_MODULE_INFORMATION;

    uintptr_t GetDriverModuleBase(const char* driver) {
        ULONG size = 0;
        NTSTATUS status = NtQuerySystemInformation((SYSTEM_INFORMATION_CLASS)0x0B, nullptr, 0, &size);

        if (status != 0xC0000004) {
            return 0;
        }

        std::vector<BYTE> buffer(size);
        PSYSTEM_MODULE_INFORMATION moduleInfo = reinterpret_cast<PSYSTEM_MODULE_INFORMATION>(buffer.data());

        status = NtQuerySystemInformation((SYSTEM_INFORMATION_CLASS)0x0B, moduleInfo, size, &size);
        if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
            return 0;
        }

        for (ULONG i = 0; i < moduleInfo->NumberOfModules; i++) {
            SYSTEM_MODULE& mod = moduleInfo->Modules[i];
            const char* moduleName = strrchr(mod.ImageName, '\\');
            if (moduleName) moduleName++; else moduleName = mod.ImageName;
            if (_stricmp(moduleName, driver) == 0) {
                return (uintptr_t)mod.ImageBase;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

            (v5 ^ key) +
            -2 * (v5 ^ (v5 | key)) +
            2 * (((byte_1400817C0 & 0x10 | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) ^ 0xC08E266D044D3314ULL) + (~key | (v5 ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL))) -
            (v5 ^ ~key ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
            0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL;

        uint64_t DecryptedCR3 =
            0x137FEEF6AB38CFB4ULL * (expr * logic) +
            ((~(expr * logic) ^ ~v12) << 63) +
            0x6C80110954C7304DULL *
            (
                ((int)_RAX & (expr * logic)) -
                (~(int)_RAX & ~(expr * logic)) -
                (int)_RAX
                ) -
            0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL *
            v12 -
            0x4F167C5CD4C7304EULL;

        return DecryptedCR3;
    }

    uintptr_t find_pml4_base()
    {
        ShadowRegionsDataStructure Data = driver::RKA<ShadowRegionsDataStructure>(driver::vgk + 0x838F8);
        uintptr_t DecClonedCr3 = decryptedClonedCR3();
        if (!DecClonedCr3) return 0;
        driver::cr3_context = DecClonedCr3;
        uintptr_t source = Data.FreeIndex << 39;
        return source;
    }
}

uintptr_t pml4base = 0;
uintptr_t uworld = 0;

void get_world()
{
    auto pml4_base = utils::find_pml4_base();
    //printf("GetPML4Base: %p\n", (void*)pml4_base);

    uintptr_t UWOLRD_1 = request->read<uintptr_t>(pml4_base + 0x1C0);

    uintptr_t uworld_offset = 0;

    for (int i = 0x0; i < 0x500; i += 0x8)
    {
        uintptr_t address_to_read = pml4_base + i;
        //printf("[*] Trying to read at address: %p\n", (void*)address_to_read);

        auto potential_uworld = driver::RPM<uintptr_t>(address_to_read);

        //printf("[+] tested potential_uworld Pointer: 0x%llx\n", potential_uworld);

        if (potential_uworld != 0)
        {
            uintptr_t level_address = potential_uworld + offsets::persistent_level;
            //printf("[*] Trying to read level at address: %p\n", (void*)level_address);

            auto level = driver::RPM<uintptr_t>(level_address);
            if (level != 0)
            {
                uintptr_t owning_world_address = level + offsets::uworld_pointer;
                //printf("[*] Trying to read owning_world at address: %p\n", (void*)owning_world_address);

                auto owning_world = driver::RPM<uintptr_t>(owning_world_address);

                //printf("[*] Offset: 0x%X\n", i);
                //printf("    WorldPtr = 0x%llx\n", potential_uworld);
                //printf("    ULevel = 0x%llx\n", level);
                //printf("    OwningWorld = 0x%llx\n", owning_world);

                if (owning_world == potential_uworld)
                {
                    uworld = potential_uworld;

                    //printf("[+] Found UWorld Offset: 0x%X\n", i);
                    uworld_offset = i;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (uworld_offset == 0)
    {
        //printf("[-] Failed to find UWorld offset!\n");
    }
}

void cache_game()
{
    auto last_update = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    int iteration_count = 0;

    while (true)
    {
        //system("cls");
        auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto time_t = std::chrono::system_clock::to_time_t(std::chrono::system_clock::now());

        if (driver::hvci_enabled) {
            //printf("Base Address: 0x%llx\n", driver::base);
        }
        else {
            //printf("VGK Address: 0x%llx\n", driver::vgk);
        }

        if (driver::hvci_enabled) {
            constexpr uint64_t uworldState = 0x9EF4050;
            uworld = request->read<uintptr_t>(driver::base + uworldState);
        }
        else {
            auto elapsed = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::seconds>(now - last_update).count();

            if (!uworld || elapsed > 15) {
                get_world();
                last_update = now;
            }
        }
        //printf("UWorld: 0x%llx\n", uworld);
        return;
        std::cout << std::flush;
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1000));
    }
}

auto main() -> int
{
    driver::initialize_driver("\\\\.\\GamerDoc");

    while (!driver::process_id)
    {
        driver::process_id = utils::get_process_id(L"VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe");
        Sleep(1000);
    }

    driver::attach_to_process(driver::process_id);

    while (!driver::vgk)
    {
        driver::vgk = utils::GetDriverModuleBase("vgk.sys");
        Sleep(1000);
    }

    //cache_game();
    std::thread cache_thread(cache_game);

    while (true)
    {
        std::cout << "UWorld: 0x" << std::hex << uworld << std::endl;

        uintptr_t game_instance = driver::RPM<uintptr_t>(uworld + offsets::game_instance);
        std::cout << "game_instance: 0x" << std::hex << game_instance << std::endl;

        uintptr_t game_state = driver::RPM<uintptr_t>(uworld + offsets::gamestate);
        std::cout << "game_state: 0x" << std::hex << game_state << std::endl;
        uintptr_t level = driver::RPM<uintptr_t>(uworld + offsets::persistent_level);
        std::cout << "level: 0x" << std::hex << level << std::endl;

        // Local player
        uintptr_t local_player_array = driver::RPM<uintptr_t>(game_instance + offsets::localplayers_array);
        std::cout << "local_player_array: 0x" << std::hex << local_player_array << std::endl;
        uintptr_t local_player = driver::RPM<uintptr_t>(local_player_array);

        uintptr_t player_controller = driver::RPM<uintptr_t>(local_player + offsets::player_controller);
        std::cout << "player_controller: 0x" << std::hex << player_controller << std::endl;
        uintptr_t local_pawn = driver::RPM<uintptr_t>(player_controller + offsets::acknowledge_pawn);

        uintptr_t localmesh = driver::RPM<uintptr_t>(player_state + offsets::mesh);

    }

                ) * (

                    ((uint64_t)(int)_RAX << 63) +
                    0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ULL +
                    0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ULL * ~(int)_RAX
                    ) +
            0x2183995CC620C592ULL
            );

    uint64_t expr =
        0x49B74B6480000000ULL * key +
        0xC2D8B464B4418C6CULL * ~mask +
        0x66B8CDC1FFFFFFFFULL * mask +
        0x5C1FE6A2B4418C6DULL * ((mask & key) - (key | ~mask));

    uint64_t logic =
        -3 * ~key +
        (mask ^ key) +
        -2 * (mask ^ (mask | key)) +
        2 * (((byte_1400807D0 & 0x10 | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) ^ 0xC08E266D044D3314ULL) + (~key | (mask ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL))) -
        (mask ^ ~key ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
        0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL;

        0x137FEEF6AB38CFB4ULL * (expr * logic) +

inline   uintptr_t find_pml4_base()
{

### Post #4478431 — Swarley12 — 17th September 2025, 05:22 AM

How??

 My actual code :

  Code:
```
		try {
			UINT chunkOffset = (UINT)((int)(key) >> 16);
			USHORT nameOffset = (USHORT)key;

			DWORD64 offsets_fnamepool = 0xB6E8C40; //sig to containing function: (+0x77) E8 ? ? ? ? 84 C0 74 62 F2 0F 10 43 0C

			uint64_t namePoolChunk = driver::readv<uint64_t>(BaseGame + offsets_fnamepool + ((chunkOffset + 2) * 8));
			uint64_t entryOffset = namePoolChunk + (ULONG)(4 * nameOffset);
			FNameEntry nameEntry = driver::readv<FNameEntry>(entryOffset);

			size_t nameLength = (size_t)nameEntry.Header.Len;
			if (nameLength >= bufferSize) {
				nameLength = bufferSize - 1;
			}

			memcpy(buffer, nameEntry.AnsiName, nameLength);
			buffer[nameLength] = '\0';
			DWORD64 nameKey = Decryption::decryptFName(GameBase);
			for (size_t i = 0; i < nameLength; i++) {
				BYTE b = i & 3;
				buffer[i] ^= nameEntry.Header.Len ^ *((LPBYTE)&nameKey + b);
			}
		}
		catch (const std::exception&) {
			if (bufferSize > 0) {
				buffer[0] = '\0';
			}
			return NULL;
		}
		return buffer;
```

   Code:
```
while (g_state.running) {
    try {
        if (g_state.hvci_enabled) {
            constexpr uint64_t uworldState = 0xB86C238;
            g_state.uworld = driver.readv2<uintptr_t>(g_state.process_base + uworldState);

        }
        else {
            auto pml4_base = utils::find_pml4_base();
            if (pml4_base) {
                for (int i = 0x0; i < 0x1000; i += 0x8) {
                    uintptr_t address_to_read = pml4_base + i;
                    auto potential_uworld = driver.readv<uintptr_t>(address_to_read);

                    if (potential_uworld != 0) {
                        uintptr_t level_address = potential_uworld + offsets::persistent_level;
                        auto level = driver.readv<uintptr_t>(level_address);
                        if (level != 0) {
                            uintptr_t owning_world_address = level + offsets::uworld;
                            auto owning_world = driver.readv<uintptr_t>(owning_world_address);

                            if (owning_world == potential_uworld) {
                                g_state.uworld = potential_uworld;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (g_state.uworld != 0) {
            uintptr_t game_instance = driver.readv<uintptr_t>(g_state.uworld + offsets::owning_game_instance);
            if (game_instance) {
                uintptr_t local_players = driver.readv<uintptr_t>(game_instance + offsets::local_players);
                uintptr_t local_player = driver.readv<uintptr_t>(local_players);
                uintptr_t player_controller = driver.readv<uintptr_t>(local_player + offsets::player_controller);
                g_state.camera_manager = driver.readv<uintptr_t>(player_controller + offsets::player_camera_manager);
            }
        }
    }
    catch (...) {}

    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1000));
}
```

static uint64_t decrypt_gengine(const ptr_encryption_context_t& ctx) noexcept {
	const uint64_t mixed = _mix64(ctx.key);
	const uint32_t idx = static_cast<uint32_t>(mixed % 7ULL);
	const uint32_t hi = static_cast<uint32_t>(mixed >> 32);

	uint64_t v = ctx.state[idx];
	switch (idx) {
	case 0:
		v = ~_rotr64(v, static_cast<uint8_t>((hi - 1) % 63u) + 1u);
		break;
	case 1:
		v = _perm64(v - (static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + 2 * idx), 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 32);
		break;
	case 2:
		v = _rotl64(~v, static_cast<uint8_t>((static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + idx) % 63u) + 1u);
		break;
	case 3:
		v = _rotl64(_perm64(v, 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 32), static_cast<uint8_t>((static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + idx) % 63u) + 1u);
		break;
	case 4:
		v = _rotr64(~v, static_cast<uint8_t>((static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + idx) % 63u) + 1u);
		break;
	case 5:
		break;
	case 6:
		v = _rotl64(
			_rotl64(v, static_cast<uint8_t>((static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + 2 * idx) % 63u) + 1u),
			static_cast<uint8_t>((static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + idx) % 63u) + 1u
		);
		break;
	}
	return v ^ static_cast<uint64_t>(ctx.key);
}

static uint64_t decrypt_gobjects(const ptr_encryption_context_t& ctx) noexcept {
	const uint64_t mixed = _mix64(ctx.key);
	const uint32_t idx = static_cast<uint32_t>(mixed % 7ULL);
	const uint32_t hi = static_cast<uint32_t>(mixed >> 32);

	uint64_t v = ctx.state[idx];
	switch (idx) {
	case 0:
		break;
	case 1:
		v = _perm64(~v, 1);
		break;
	case 2:
		v = _rotl64(_perm64(v, 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 32), static_cast<uint8_t>((static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + idx) % 63u) + 1u);
		break;
	case 3:
		v = _rotr64(_perm64(v, 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 32), static_cast<uint8_t>((static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + idx) % 63u) + 1u);
		break;
	case 4:
		break;
	case 5:
		v = _rotl64(v - (static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + 2 * idx), static_cast<uint8_t>((static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + idx) % 63u) + 1u);
		break;
	case 6:
		v -= idx;
		break;
	}
	return v ^ static_cast<uint64_t>(ctx.key);
}

static uint64_t decrypt_fname_key(const ptr_encryption_context_t& ctx) noexcept {
	const uint64_t mixed = _mix64(ctx.key);
	const uint32_t idx = static_cast<uint32_t>(mixed % 7ULL);
	const uint32_t hi = static_cast<uint32_t>(mixed >> 32);

	uint64_t v = ctx.state[idx];
	switch (idx) {
	case 0:
		v ^= static_cast<uint64_t>(hi - 1);
		break;
	case 1:
		v = ~(static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + idx) ^ _perm64(v, 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 32);
		break;
	case 2:
		v = _rotl64(v, static_cast<uint8_t>((static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + 2 * idx) % 63u) + 1u) - (static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + idx);
		break;
	case 3:
		v = ~_perm64(v, 1);
		break;
	case 4:
		v = ~(static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + idx) ^ _perm64(v, 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 32);
		break;
	case 5:
		v = _perm64(v, 1) - (static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + idx);
		break;
	case 6:
		v = (static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + idx) + _perm64(v, 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 32);
		break;
	}
	return v ^ static_cast<uint64_t>(ctx.key);
}
```

### Post #4488579 — mohameds00a6 — 1st October 2025, 10:33 PM

uintptr_t MemoryAlloc = 0x7D9BD40;
 uintptr_t MemoryFree = 0x7D9BDC0;

  Code:
```
//MemAlloc
unsigned __int64 __fastcall MemoryAlloc(__int64 a1, int a2)
{
    HANDLE ProcessHeap; // rax
    unsigned __int64 result; // rax
    unsigned __int64 v6; // rdx

    ProcessHeap = GetProcessHeap();
    result = (unsigned __int64)HeapAlloc(ProcessHeap, 0, a2 - 1 + a1 + 8);
    v6 = result;
    if (result)
    {
        result = -(int)a2 & (result + a2 - 1 + 8);
        *(DWORD*)(result - 8) = v6;
    }
    return result;
}

//MemoryFree
BOOL __fastcall MemoryFree(__int64 a1)
{
    HANDLE ProcessHeap; // rax

    ProcessHeap = GetProcessHeap();
    return HeapFree(ProcessHeap, 0, *(LPVOID*)(a1 - 8));
}
```

### Post #4489518 — AncoraTu — 3rd October 2025, 10:02 AM

I heard various people asking for how to get agent names. Here's How I do it very simply using GUIDs.

 add FGuid structure:
  Code:
```
struct FGuid {
    int32_t A, B, C, D;
    bool operator==(const FGuid& other) const {
        return A == other.A && B == other.B && C == other.C && D == other.D;
    }
};
```
  add agent mapping using ids from valorant API
  Code:
```
static std::unordered_map<FGuid, std::string, FGuidHash> agentGuidToName = {
    {MakeGuid(0xadd6443a, 0x41bde414, 0xf6ade58d, 0x267f4e95), "Jett"},
    {MakeGuid(0xa3bfb853, 0x43b27238, 0xa4f1ad90, 0xe9e46bcc), "Reyna"},
    // ... all 27 agents
};
```
  Then U need to read it from PlayerState using desidered_class offset
  Code:
```
FGuid agentGuid = km::RPM<FGuid>(pState + 0xAE8); // desired_class offset
auto it = agentGuidToName.find(agentGuid);
std::string agentName = (it != agentGuidToName.end()) ? it->second : "Unknown";
```

      typedef struct ShadowRegionsDataStructure
    {

        uintptr_t ClonedPML4_t;
        uintptr_t GameCr3;
        uintptr_t ClonedCr3;
        uintptr_t FreeIndex;
    } ShadowRegionsDataStructure;

    inline   uint64_t find_RAX()
    {
        int cpuInfo[4] = { 0 };
        __cpuid(cpuInfo, 1);
        return (uint64_t)cpuInfo[0];
    }

    inline  uintptr_t decryptedClonedCR3(uintptr_t vgkbase) {
        uint64_t _RAX = find_RAX();
        BYTE byte_1400807D0 = km::RKA<BYTE>(km::vgk + 0x839C0);
        uintptr_t key = km::RKA<uintptr_t>(km::vgk + 0x83910);

        uint64_t mask = byte_1400807D0 & 0x73;

        uint64_t v11 =
            (int)_RAX *
            (
                0x7D90DC33C620C593ULL * key * (0x13D0F34E00000000ULL * key + 0x483C4F8900000000ULL) +
                0xFD90DC33C620C592ULL * ~(key * (0x13D0F34E00000000ULL * key + 0x483C4F8900000000ULL)) +
                (
                    key * (
                        0x31C31A1E80000000ULL * key +
                        0x31C31A1E80000000ULL +
                        0x55494E5B80000000ULL * (int)_RAX +
                        0xC83B18136241A38DULL * ~(int)_RAX +
                        0x72F1C9B7E241A38DULL *
                        (
                            ((int)_RAX | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
                            (0x3F71D992FBB2CCEAULL - ((int)_RAX & 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL))
                            )
                        ) + 0x71C31A1E80000000ULL
                    ) * (
                        0x99BF7D2380CF6EC3ULL * (int)_RAX +
                        ((uint64_t)(int)_RAX << 63) +
                        0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ULL +
                        0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ULL * ~(int)_RAX
                        ) +
                0x2183995CC620C592ULL
                );

        uint64_t expr =
            0x49B74B6480000000ULL * key +
            0xC2D8B464B4418C6CULL * ~mask +
            0x66B8CDC1FFFFFFFFULL * mask +
            0x5C1FE6A2B4418C6DULL * ((mask & key) - (key | ~mask));

        uint64_t logic =
            -3 * ~key +
            (mask ^ key) +
            -2 * (mask ^ (mask | key)) +
            2 * (((byte_1400807D0 & 0x10 | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) ^ 0xC08E266D044D3314ULL) + (~key | (mask ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL))) -
            (mask ^ ~key ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
            0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL;

        uintptr_t DecryptedCR3 =
            0x137FEEF6AB38CFB4ULL * (expr * logic) +
            ((~(expr * logic) ^ ~v11) << 63) +
            0x6C80110954C7304DULL *
            (
                ((int)_RAX & (expr * logic)) -
                (~(int)_RAX & ~(expr * logic)) -
                (int)_RAX
                ) -
            0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL * v11 -
            0x4F167C5CD4C7304EULL;

        return DecryptedCR3;
    }

    inline   uintptr_t find_pml4_base()
    {
        ShadowRegionsDataStructure Data = km::RKA<ShadowRegionsDataStructure>(km::vgk + 0x82708);
        uintptr_t DecClonedCr3 = decryptedClonedCR3(km::vgk);
        if (!DecClonedCr3) return 0;
        km::cr3_context = DecClonedCr3;
        uintptr_t source = Data.FreeIndex << 39;
        return source;
    }
}

### Post #4490475 — gian5921 — 4th October 2025, 07:05 PM

> **Cenky:**
> Originally Posted by Cenky   can any1 show me how to do ext chams

  Code:
```
auto Bridge ( ) -> void
{
	for ( ;; )
	{
		std::vector<EntityList> LocalEnemyCollection = EnemyCollection;

		for ( auto Iteration = 0; Iteration < LocalEnemyCollection.size ( ); Iteration++ )
		{
			EntityList Enemy = LocalEnemyCollection [Iteration];

			auto Dormant = Read<bool> ( Enemy.Actor + Offsets::Dormant );
			auto DamageHandler = Read<std::uintptr_t> ( Enemy.Actor + Offsets::DamageHandler );
			auto Health = Read<float> ( DamageHandler + Offsets::Health );

			auto PlayerState = Read<std::uintptr_t> ( Enemy.Actor + Offsets::PlayerState );
			auto TeamComponent = Read<std::uintptr_t> ( PlayerState + Offsets::TeamComponent );
			auto TeamId = Read<std::int32_t> ( TeamComponent + Offsets::TeamID );

			if ( Enemy.Actor == LocalPawn || !Enemy.MeshComponent || Health <= 0 || !Dormant )
				continue;

			if (Read<std::uint64_t>( std::uint64_t( Enemy.MeshComponent ) + Offsets::OutlineMode ) != 1)
				Write<std::uint64_t>( std::uint64_t( Enemy.MeshComponent ) + Offsets::OutlineMode, 1 );

			TArray<std::uint64_t> AttachChildren = Read<TArray<std::uint64_t>> ( std::uint64_t ( Enemy.MeshComponent ) + Offsets::AttachChildren );
			for ( auto Iteration = 0; Iteration < AttachChildren.Length ( ); Iteration++ )
			{
				if ( std::uint64_t CurrentMesh = AttachChildren.GetById ( Iteration ) )
				{
					if ( !CurrentMesh )
						continue;

					if ( Read<std::uint64_t> ( std::uint64_t ( CurrentMesh ) + Offsets::OutlineMode ) == 3 )
						Write<std::uint64_t> ( std::uint64_t ( CurrentMesh ) + Offsets::OutlineMode, 1 );

					// Blue Neon \\

					Write<FLinearColor> ( reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>( ImageBase ) + Offsets::OutlineAlly, { 5.093f, 5.019f, 20.066f, 4.55f } );
					Write<FLinearColor> ( reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>( ImageBase ) + Offsets::OutlineEnemy, { 5.093f, 5.019f, 20.066f, 4.55f } );

					// Red \\

					/*Write<FLinearColor> ( reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>( ImageBase ) + Offsets::OutlineAlly, { 1.000f, 0.001f, 0.001f, 50.55f } );
					Write<FLinearColor> ( reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>( ImageBase ) + Offsets::OutlineEnemy, { 1.000f, 0.001f, 0.001f, 50.55f } );*/
				};
			};

			Write<float> ( Enemy.Actor + Offsets::FresnelIntensity, 100.f );
		};
	};
};
```
  Take a look at my code!
 This code is last updated 2022, so updates may differ today.

### Post #4490928 — JokerThai — 5th October 2025, 02:05 PM

Code:
```
__forceinline uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state) {
    const uint64_t magic = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1D;

    uint64_t v5 = magic * (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
    uint64_t v6 = v5 % 7;
    uint64_t v7 = HIDWORD(v5);
    uint32_t v8 = (uint32_t)v6 % 7;
    uint64_t v9 = state[v6];

    switch (v8) {
    case 0:
        v9 = v7 + ((v9 >> 1) ^ ((v9 >> 1) ^ (2 * v9)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA);
        break;

    case 1:
        v9 = (~v9 << (((v7 + v6) % 0x3F) + 1)) |
            (~v9 >> (63 * ((v7 + v6) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)v7 + (uint8_t)v6) + 63));
        break;

    case 2:
        v9 = ~((v9 << (((v7 + 2 * v6) % 0x3F) + 1)) |
            (v9 >> (63 * ((v7 + 2 * v6) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)v7 + 2 * (uint8_t)v6) + 63)));
        break;

    case 3: {
        uint64_t temp = ~v9;
        uint64_t step1 = (temp >> 1) ^ ((temp >> 1) ^ (2 * temp)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA;
        uint64_t step2 = (step1 >> 2) ^ ((step1 >> 2) ^ (4 * step1)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC;
        uint64_t step3 = (step2 >> 4) ^ ((step2 >> 4) ^ (16 * step2)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0;
        uint64_t step4 = (step3 >> 8) ^ ((step3 >> 8) ^ (step3 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00;
        v9 = __ROR8__(step4, 32);
        break;
    }

    case 4:
        v9 = ~(uint64_t)(v7 + v6) ^
            ((v9 >> (63 * ((v7 + 2 * v6) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)v7 + 2 * (uint8_t)v6) + 63)) |
                (v9 << (((v7 + 2 * v6) % 0x3F) + 1)));
        break;

    case 6:
        v9 = ~(v9 - (uint32_t)(v7 + v6));
        break;

    default:
        break;
    }

    return v9 ^ key;
}
```

> 		0x66B8CDC1FFFFFFFFULL * v5 +

Hi, I might be in a different situation since I'm operating from usermode with limited access. However, the problem seems to be your address calculation.
 You can't add a RVA directly to pml4_base. A RVA is an offset from the module's virtual base address (0x7FF...), not a physical one.
 You need to translate your target virtual address (virtual_base + RVA) into a physical address by walking the page tables starting from pml4_base. Your current code seems to be skipping this crucial translation step.
 Hope that helps.

  inline  uintptr_t get_process_base_id(DWORD processID)
    {
        DWORD_PTR   baseAddress = 0;
        HANDLE      processHandle = OpenProcess(PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, FALSE, processID);
        HMODULE* moduleArray;
        LPBYTE      moduleArrayBytes;
        DWORD       bytesRequired;

        if (processHandle)
        {
            if (EnumProcessModules(processHandle, NULL, 0, &bytesRequired))
            {
                if (bytesRequired)
                {
                    moduleArrayBytes = (LPBYTE)LocalAlloc(LPTR, bytesRequired);

                    if (moduleArrayBytes)
                    {
                        unsigned int moduleCount;

                        moduleCount = bytesRequired / sizeof(HMODULE);
                        moduleArray = (HMODULE*)moduleArrayBytes;

                        if (EnumProcessModules(processHandle, moduleArray, bytesRequired, &bytesRequired))
                        {
                            baseAddress = (DWORD_PTR)moduleArray[0];
                        }

                        LocalFree(moduleArrayBytes);
                    }
                }
            }

            CloseHandle(processHandle);
        }

        return baseAddress;

    inline uintptr_t GetDriverModuleBase(const char* driver) {
        ULONG size = 0;
        NTSTATUS status = NtQuerySystemInformation((SYSTEM_INFORMATION_CLASS)0x0B, nullptr, 0, &size);
        if (status != STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH && !NT_SUCCESS(status)) return 0;

        std::vector<BYTE> buffer(size);
        PSYSTEM_MODULE_INFORMATION moduleInfo = reinterpret_cast<PSYSTEM_MODULE_INFORMATION>(buffer.data());
        status = NtQuerySystemInformation((SYSTEM_INFORMATION_CLASS)0x0B, moduleInfo, size, &size);
        if (status == STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH) {
            // サイズが増えた場合は再確保して再取得
            buffer.resize(size);
            moduleInfo = reinterpret_cast<PSYSTEM_MODULE_INFORMATION>(buffer.data());
            status = NtQuerySystemInformation((SYSTEM_INFORMATION_CLASS)0x0B, moduleInfo, size, &size);
        }
        if (!NT_SUCCESS(status) || moduleInfo == nullptr) return 0;

        for (ULONG i = 0; i < moduleInfo->NumberOfModules; ++i) {
            SYSTEM_MODULE& mod = moduleInfo->Modules[i];
            const char* image = mod.ImageName;
            const char* moduleName = strrchr(image, '\\');
            if (!moduleName) moduleName = strrchr(image, '/');
            if (moduleName) ++moduleName; else moduleName = image;

            if (_stricmp(moduleName, driver) == 0) {
                return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mod.ImageBase);
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

                + (key *

                        + 0x72F1C9B7E241A38DULL *

                    + 0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ULL * v11
                    + 0xE64082DC7F30913EULL * (~key & ~v5)
                    + ((key + (v5 | (int)_RAX) + (v5 & (key ^ (int)_RAX))) << 63))
                + 0x2183995CC620C592ULL);

            0xC2D8B464B4418C6CULL * ~v5 +
            0x66B8CDC1FFFFFFFFULL * v5 +
            0x5C1FE6A2B4418C6DULL * ((v5 & key) - (key | ~v5));

            (v5 ^ key) +
            -2 * (v5 ^ (v5 | key)) +
            2 * (((byte_140084CD0 & 0x10 | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) ^ 0xC08E266D044D3314ULL) + (~key | v5 ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL)) -

            0x4F167C5CD4C7304EULL;

#define MOUSE_LEFT_BUTTON_UP     0x0002
#define MOUSE_RIGHT_BUTTON_DOWN  0x0004
#define MOUSE_RIGHT_BUTTON_UP    0x0008
#define MOUSE_MIDDLE_BUTTON_DOWN 0x0010
#define MOUSE_MIDDLE_BUTTON_UP   0x0020
#define code_rw CTL_CODE(FILE_DEVICE_UNKNOWN, 0x2512, METHOD_BUFFERED, FILE_SPECIAL_ACCESS)
#define code_ba CTL_CODE(FILE_DEVICE_UNKNOWN, 0x5552, METHOD_BUFFERED, FILE_SPECIAL_ACCESS)
#define code_get_guarded_region CTL_CODE(FILE_DEVICE_UNKNOWN, 0x535451, METHOD_BUFFERED, FILE_SPECIAL_ACCESS)
#define code_GetDirBase CTL_CODE(FILE_DEVICE_UNKNOWN, 0x775, METHOD_BUFFERED, FILE_SPECIAL_ACCESS)
#define MOUSE_REQUEST CTL_CODE(FILE_DEVICE_UNKNOWN, 0x1121, METHOD_BUFFERED, FILE_SPECIAL_ACCESS)
#define code_rw_batch                                                \
 CTL_CODE(FILE_DEVICE_UNKNOWN, 0x2519, METHOD_BUFFERED, \
 FILE_SPECIAL_ACCESS)
#define code_security 0x1145192
typedef struct _KMOUSE_REQUEST {
	long x;
	long y;
	unsigned char button_flags;
} KMOUSE_REQUEST, * PKMOUSE_REQUEST;

typedef struct _rw {

	INT32 process_id;
	ULONGLONG address;
	ULONGLONG buffer;
	ULONGLONG size;
	BOOLEAN write;
	uintptr_t cr3;
} rw, * prw;
typedef struct _ba {
	ULONGLONG process_id;
	ULONGLONG* address;
} ba, * pba;
typedef struct _ga {
	ULONGLONG* address;
} ga, * pga;
typedef struct _MEMORY_OPERATION_DATA {
	uint32_t pid;
	ULONGLONG* cr3;
} MEMORY_OPERATION_DATA, * PMEMORY_OPERATION_DATA;

namespace km {
	inline uintptr_t baseadd = 0;;
	inline HANDLE driver_handle = nullptr;
	inline ULONGLONG process_id = 0;
	inline std::mutex driver_mutex;
	inline uintptr_t vgk = 0;
	inline uintptr_t cr3_context = 0;
	inline bool find_driver() {
		try {
			WCHAR symlinkBuf[] = L"\\\\.\\ChromeUpdatorv22";
			driver_handle = CreateFileW(symlinkBuf,
				GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE,
				FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE,
				NULL, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, NULL);
			if (!driver_handle || driver_handle == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
			}
			return true;
		}
		catch (const std::exception& e) {
			std::cerr << "find_driver error: " << e.what() << std::endl;
			return false;
		}
	}
	inline bool read_physical(PVOID address, PVOID buffer, DWORD size) {
		_rw arguments = { 0 };
		arguments.address = (ULONGLONG)address;
		arguments.buffer = (ULONGLONG)buffer;
		arguments.size = size;
		arguments.process_id = (ULONGLONG)process_id;
		arguments.write = FALSE;
		arguments.cr3 = km::cr3_context;
		if (!DeviceIoControl(driver_handle, code_rw,
			&arguments, sizeof(arguments),
			nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr)) {
			ZeroMemory(buffer, size);
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}
	template<typename T>
	inline T inline read_physical_additional(uintptr_t address, size_t additional_size = 0)
	{
		T read_data{};
		_rw arguments = { 0 };
		arguments.address = (ULONGLONG)address;
		arguments.buffer = (ULONGLONG)&read_data;
		arguments.size = sizeof(T) + additional_size;
		arguments.process_id = (ULONGLONG)process_id;
		arguments.write = FALSE;
		arguments.cr3 = FALSE;

		if (!DeviceIoControl(driver_handle, code_rw,
			&arguments, sizeof(arguments),
			nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr))
		{

			ZeroMemory(&read_data, sizeof(T) + additional_size);
		}

		return read_data;
	}

	inline bool write_physical(PVOID address, PVOID buffer, DWORD size) {
		if (!address || !buffer || size == 0) {
			throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid parameters");
		}
		_rw arguments = { 0 };
		arguments.address = (ULONGLONG)address;
		arguments.buffer = (ULONGLONG)buffer;
		arguments.size = size;
		arguments.process_id = (ULONGLONG)process_id;
		arguments.write = TRUE;
		arguments.cr3 = km::cr3_context;
		if (!DeviceIoControl(driver_handle, code_rw,
			&arguments, sizeof(arguments),
			nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr)) {
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	inline bool send_mouse(long x, long y, unsigned char button_flags) {

		if (!driver_handle || driver_handle == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
			throw std::runtime_error("Invalid driver handle");
		}

		KMOUSE_REQUEST req = { 0 };
		req.x = x;
		req.y = y;
		req.button_flags = button_flags;

		OVERLAPPED overlapped = { 0 };
		overlapped.hEvent = CreateEvent(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, nullptr);
		if (!overlapped.hEvent) {
			std::cerr << "CreateEvent failed: " << GetLastError() << std::endl;
			return false;
		}

		DeviceIoControl(driver_handle,
			MOUSE_REQUEST,
			&req, sizeof(req),
			nullptr, 0, nullptr, &overlapped);

		CloseHandle(overlapped.hEvent);

		return true;
	}
	inline uintptr_t fetch_cr3() {
		uintptr_t cr3 = 0;
		_MEMORY_OPERATION_DATA arguments = { 0 };
		arguments.pid = process_id;
		arguments.cr3 = (ULONGLONG*)&cr3;
		if (!DeviceIoControl(driver_handle, code_GetDirBase,
			&arguments, sizeof(arguments),
			nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr)) {
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}
	inline uintptr_t find_image() {
		uintptr_t image_address = 0;
		_ba arguments = { 0 };
		arguments.process_id = process_id;
		arguments.address = (ULONGLONG*)&image_address;
		if (!DeviceIoControl(driver_handle, code_ba,
			&arguments, sizeof(arguments),
			nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr)) {
			return false;
		}
		return image_address;
	}
	inline uintptr_t get_guarded_region() {
		std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(driver_mutex);
		try {
			uintptr_t guarded_region_address = 0;
			_ga arguments = { 0 };
			arguments.address = (ULONGLONG*)&guarded_region_address;
			if (!DeviceIoControl(driver_handle, code_get_guarded_region,
				&arguments, sizeof(arguments),
				nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr)) {
				throw std::runtime_error("DeviceIoControl failed for get_guarded_region");
			}
			return guarded_region_address;
		}
		catch (const std::exception& e) {
			std::cerr << "get_guarded_region error: " << e.what() << std::endl;
			return 0;
		}
	}
	inline INT32 find_process(LPCTSTR process_name) {
		PROCESSENTRY32 pt;
		HANDLE hsnap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
		if (hsnap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
			throw std::runtime_error("CreateToolhelp32Snapshot failed");
		}
		pt.dwSize = sizeof(PROCESSENTRY32);
		if (Process32First(hsnap, &pt)) {
			do {
				if (!lstrcmpi(pt.szExeFile, process_name)) {
					CloseHandle(hsnap);
					process_id = pt.th32ProcessID;
					return pt.th32ProcessID;
				}
			} while (Process32Next(hsnap, &pt));
		}
		CloseHandle(hsnap);
		return 0;
	}
}
template <typename T>
inline T read(uint64_t address) {

		T buffer{};
		km::read_physical((PVOID)address, &buffer, sizeof(T));
		return buffer;

	return T{};
}

template <typename T>
inline T write(uint64_t address, T buffer) {

		km::write_physical((PVOID)address, &buffer, sizeof(T));

	return buffer;
}
template<typename T>

inline std::string readstring(uint64_t Address, DWORD size = 64) {

		char buffer[128] = { 0 };
		if (size > 128) size = 128;
		km::read_physical((PVOID)Address, buffer, size);
		return std::string(buffer);

	return "";
}

    inline uintptr_t GetDriverModuleBase(const char* driver) {
        ULONG size = 0;
        NTSTATUS status = NtQuerySystemInformation((SYSTEM_INFORMATION_CLASS)0x0B, nullptr, 0, &size);

        if (status != 0xC0000004) {
            return 0;
        }

        std::vector<BYTE> buffer(size);
        PSYSTEM_MODULE_INFORMATION moduleInfo = reinterpret_cast<PSYSTEM_MODULE_INFORMATION>(buffer.data());

        status = NtQuerySystemInformation((SYSTEM_INFORMATION_CLASS)0x0B, moduleInfo, size, &size);
        if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
            return 0;
        }

        for (ULONG i = 0; i < moduleInfo->NumberOfModules; i++) {
            SYSTEM_MODULE& mod = moduleInfo->Modules[i];
            const char* moduleName = strrchr(mod.ImageName, '\\');
            if (moduleName) moduleName++; else moduleName = mod.ImageName;
            if (_stricmp(moduleName, driver) == 0) {
                return (uintptr_t)mod.ImageBase;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

      typedef struct ShadowRegionsDataStructure
    {
        uintptr_t OriginalPML4_t;
        uintptr_t ClonedPML4_t;
        uintptr_t GameCr3;
        uintptr_t ClonedCr3;
        uintptr_t FreeIndex;
    } ShadowRegionsDataStructure;

      inline uint64_t find_RAX()
      {
          int cpuInfo[4] = { 0 };
          __cpuid(cpuInfo, 1);
          return (uint64_t)cpuInfo[0];
      }

      inline uintptr_t decryptedClonedCR3(uintptr_t vgkbase)
      {
          uint64_t _RAX = find_RAX(); // EAX
          BYTE byte_140084CD0 = g_cheat.Read<BYTE>((PVOID)(vgkbase + 0x84CD0));
          uint64_t key = g_cheat.Read<uint64_t>((PVOID)(vgkbase + 0x84C20));

          uint64_t v5 = byte_140084CD0 & 0x73;
          uint64_t v11 = ~(int)_RAX;

          uint64_t v12 =
              (0x8000000000000001ULL * (int)_RAX
                  + 0xAFDBF65F8A4AC9C9ULL * ~key
                  + 0x2FDBF65F8A4AC9C9ULL * (key + 1)
                  + (((key ^ (int)_RAX) << 63) ^ 0x8000000000000000ULL))
              *
              (0x7D90DC33C620C593ULL * key * (0x13D0F34E00000000ULL * key + 0x483C4F8900000000ULL)
                  + 0xFD90DC33C620C592ULL * ~(key * (0x13D0F34E00000000ULL * key + 0x483C4F8900000000ULL))
                  + (key *
                      (0xCE3CE5E180000000ULL * ~key
                          + 0x55494E5B80000000ULL * (int)_RAX
                          + 0xC83B18136241A38DULL * v11
                          + 0x72F1C9B7E241A38DULL *
                          (
                              ((int)_RAX | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
                              (0x3F71D992FBB2CCEAULL - ((int)_RAX & 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL))
                              )
                          )
                      + 0x71C31A1E80000000ULL)
                  *
                  (0x99BF7D2380CF6EC3ULL * (int)_RAX
                      + 0x664082DC7F30913EULL * (v5 | key)
                      + 0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ULL * v11
                      + 0xE64082DC7F30913EULL * (~key & ~v5)
                      + ((key + (v5 | (int)_RAX) + (v5 & (key ^ (int)_RAX))) << 63))
                  + 0x2183995CC620C592ULL);

          uint64_t expr =
              0x49B74B6480000000ULL * key +
              0xC2D8B464B4418C6CULL * ~v5 +
              0x66B8CDC1FFFFFFFFULL * v5 +
              0x5C1FE6A2B4418C6DULL * ((v5 & key) - (key | ~v5));

          uint64_t logic =
              -3 * ~key +
              (v5 ^ key) +
              -2 * (v5 ^ (v5 | key)) +
              2 * (((byte_140084CD0 & 0x10 | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) ^ 0xC08E266D044D3314ULL) + (~key | v5 ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL)) -
              (v5 ^ ~key ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
              0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL;

          uint64_t v13 =
              ((~(expr * logic) ^ ~v12) << 63) +
              0x6C80110954C7304DULL *
              (
                  ((int)_RAX & (expr * logic)) -
                  (v11 & ~(expr * logic)) -
                  (int)_RAX
                  );

          uint64_t DecryptedCR3 =
              0x137FEEF6AB38CFB4ULL * (expr * logic) +
              v13 -
              0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL * v12 -
              0x4F167C5CD4C7304EULL;

          return DecryptedCR3;
      }

    inline  uintptr_t find_pml4_base()
    {
        // Note: This function needs to be adapted as vgk is now handled differently
        // For now, we'll assume vgk is available through utils::GetDriverModuleBase
        uintptr_t vgk = utils::GetDriverModuleBase("vgk.sys");
        if (!vgk) return 0;

        ShadowRegionsDataStructure Data = g_cheat.Read<ShadowRegionsDataStructure>((PVOID)(vgk + 0x84C08));
        uintptr_t DecClonedCr3 = decryptedClonedCR3(vgk);
        if (!DecClonedCr3) return 0;

        // Note: cr3_context is no longer part of BareCheats, needs to be handled differently
        uintptr_t source = Data.FreeIndex << 39;
        return source;
    }
}

 uintptr_t uworld_offset = 0;

 for (int i = 0x0; i < 0x500; i += 0x8)
 {
 uintptr_t address_to_read = pml4_base + i;

 auto potential_uworld = Kernel->read<uintptr_t>(address_to_read);

 if (potential_uworld != 0)
 {
 uintptr_t level_address = potential_uworld + offsets:
![image](https://www.unknowncheats.me/forum/images/smilies/tongue.gif)
ersistent_level;

 auto level = Kernel->read<uintptr_t>(level_address);
 if (level != 0)
 {
 uintptr_t owning_world_address = level + offsets::uworld_pointer;

 auto owning_world = Kernel->read<uintptr_t>(owning_world_address);

 if (owning_world == potential_uworld)
 {
 uworld = potential_uworld;

 uworld_offset = i;
 break;
 }
 }
 }
 }

 std::cout << "=== Iteration " << ++iteration << " ===" << std::endl;
 std::cout << "Actor count: " << (cache).actor_count << std::endl;

 int valid_actors = 0;

 for (int x = 0; x < (cache).actor_count; x++)
 {
 uintptr_t actor = Kernel->read<uintptr_t>((cache).actor_array + (x * 0x8));

 if (!actor) {
 std::cout << " - SKIPPED (null actor)" << std::endl;
 continue;
 }
 std::cout << std::endl;

 INT32 unique_id = Kernel->read<INT32>(actor + 0x38);
 std::cout << " Unique ID: " << unique_id;

 if (unique_id != 18743553) {
 std::cout << " - SKIPPED (wrong ID)" << std::endl;
 continue;
 }
 std::cout << " - MATCH!" << std::endl;

 bool ally = Kernel->read<bool>(actor + 0x0F29);
 std::cout << " Is Ally: " << (ally ? "true" : "false");

 if (ally) {
 std::cout << " - SKIPPED (ally)" << std::endl;
 continue;
 }
 std::cout << " - ENEMY!" << std::endl;

 uintptr_t damage_handler = Kernel->read<uintptr_t>(actor + offsets::damage_handler);
 std::cout << " Damage Handler: 0x" << std::hex << damage_handler << std::dec;

 if (!damage_handler) {
 std::cout << " - SKIPPED (null damage handler)" << std::endl;
 continue;
 }
 std::cout << std::endl;

 float health = Kernel->read<float>(damage_handler + offsets::health);
 std::cout << " Health: " << health;

 if (health <= 0) {
 std::cout << " - SKIPPED (dead)" << std::endl;
 continue;
 }
 std::cout << " - ALIVE!" << std::endl;

 uintptr_t mesh = Kernel->read<uintptr_t>(actor + offsets::mesh);
 std::cout << " Mesh: 0x" << std::hex << mesh << std::dec;

 if (!mesh) {
 std::cout << " - SKIPPED (null mesh)" << std::endl;
 continue;
 }
 std::cout << std::endl;

 uintptr_t bone_array = Kernel->read<uintptr_t>(mesh + offsets::bone_array);
 if (!bone_array) {
 bone_array = Kernel->read<uintptr_t>(mesh + offsets::bone_array_cache);
 std::cout << " Bone Array (primary): null, using cache: 0x" << std::hex << bone_array << std::dec;
 }
 else {
 std::cout << " Bone Array: 0x" << std::hex << bone_array << std::dec;
 }

 if (!bone_array) {
 std::cout << " - SKIPPED (null bone array)" << std::endl;
 continue;
 }
 std::cout << std::endl;

 uintptr_t bone_count = Kernel->read<int>(mesh + 0x740 + 0x8);
 std::cout << " Bone Count: " << bone_count << std::endl;

 tc.emplace_back(actor, mesh, bone_count, damage_handler, health, bone_array);
 valid_actors++;

 std::cout << " >>> ADDED TO CACHE! <<<" << std::endl;
 std::cout << " ---" << std::endl;
 }

 std::cout << "Valid players cached: " << valid_actors << "/" << (cache).actor_count << std::endl;
 std::cout << "=== End Iteration " << iteration << " ===" << std::endl << std::endl;

 {

      BYTE byte_140084CD0 = km::RKA<BYTE>(vgkbase + 0x84CD0);//byte
      uint64_t key = km::RKA<uint64_t>(vgkbase + 0x84C20);//key

      uint64_t v5 = byte_140084CD0 & 0x73;
      uint64_t v11 = ~(int)_RAX;

      uint64_t v12 =
          (0x8000000000000001ULL * (int)_RAX
              + 0xAFDBF65F8A4AC9C9ULL * ~key
              + 0x2FDBF65F8A4AC9C9ULL * (key + 1)
              + (((key ^ (int)_RAX) << 63) ^ 0x8000000000000000ULL))
          *
          (0x7D90DC33C620C593ULL * key * (0x13D0F34E00000000ULL * key + 0x483C4F8900000000ULL)
              + 0xFD90DC33C620C592ULL * ~(key * (0x13D0F34E00000000ULL * key + 0x483C4F8900000000ULL))
              + (key *
                  (0xCE3CE5E180000000ULL * ~key
                      + 0x55494E5B80000000ULL * (int)_RAX
                      + 0xC83B18136241A38DULL * v11
                      + 0x72F1C9B7E241A38DULL *
                      (
                          ((int)_RAX | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
                          (0x3F71D992FBB2CCEAULL - ((int)_RAX & 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL))
                          )
                      )
                  + 0x71C31A1E80000000ULL)
              *
              (0x99BF7D2380CF6EC3ULL * (int)_RAX
                  + 0x664082DC7F30913EULL * (v5 | key)
                  + 0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ULL * v11
                  + 0xE64082DC7F30913EULL * (~key & ~v5)
                  + ((key + (v5 | (int)_RAX) + (v5 & (key ^ (int)_RAX))) << 63))
              + 0x2183995CC620C592ULL);

      uint64_t expr =
          0x49B74B6480000000ULL * key +
          0xC2D8B464B4418C6CULL * ~v5 +
          0x66B8CDC1FFFFFFFFULL * v5 +
          0x5C1FE6A2B4418C6DULL * ((v5 & key) - (key | ~v5));

      uint64_t logic =
          -3 * ~key +
          (v5 ^ key) +
          -2 * (v5 ^ (v5 | key)) +
          2 * (((byte_140084CD0 & 0x10 | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) ^ 0xC08E266D044D3314ULL) + (~key | v5 ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL)) -
          (v5 ^ ~key ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
          0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL;

      uint64_t v13 =
          ((~(expr * logic) ^ ~v12) << 63) +
          0x6C80110954C7304DULL *
          (
              ((int)_RAX & (expr * logic)) -
              (v11 & ~(expr * logic)) -
              (int)_RAX
              );

      uint64_t DecryptedCR3 =
          0x137FEEF6AB38CFB4ULL * (expr * logic) +
          v13 -
          0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL * v12 -
          0x4F167C5CD4C7304EULL;

      return DecryptedCR3;
  }

inline  uintptr_t find_pml4_base()
{
    ShadowRegionsDataStructure Data = km::RKA<ShadowRegionsDataStructure>(km::vgk + 0x84C08);//shadow
    uintptr_t DecClonedCr3 = decryptedClonedCR3(km::vgk);
    if (!DecClonedCr3) return 0;
    km::cr3_context = DecClonedCr3;
    uintptr_t source = Data.FreeIndex << 39;
    return source;
}

```
// ==================== USED OFFSETS ====================
// Core world and game instance offsets
inline uintptr_t uworld = 0xC0;                                     // OwningWorld - used for world validation in main.cpp
inline uint64_t owning_game_instance = 0x1D8;                       // Game instance pointer - used for local player access in main.cpp
inline uint64_t persistent_level = 0x38;                            // Level containing actors - used for actor enumeration in main.cpp
inline uint64_t uworldtemp_real = 0xB575CE0;                        // HVCI ON UWORLD (old)
inline uint64_t uworld_pointer = 0x0B6BA3D0; //0xB6C43D0            // UWorld pointer address - used for finding UWorld in main.cpp (old: 0xB5A2C20)
inline uint64_t gamestate = 0x178;

// Actor and player management
inline uint64_t actor_array = 0xa0;                                 // Array of all actors in level - used for player enumeration in main.cpp
inline uintptr_t actor_count = 0xa8;                                // Count of actors in array - used for loop bounds in main.cpp
inline uint64_t local_players = 0x40;                               // Local players array - used for getting local player in main.cpp
inline uint64_t player_controller = 0x38;                           // Player controller pointer - used for camera and pawn access in main.cpp
inline uint64_t apawn = 0x510;                                      // Player pawn pointer - used for player data access in main.cpp
inline uint64_t player_state = 0x0480;                              // Player state data - used for team and mesh access in main.cpp
inline uint64_t player_array = 0xA0; //0x0478

// Camera system
inline uint64_t player_camera_manager = 0x520;                      // Camera manager - used for view calculations in main.cpp
inline uint64_t camera_cache_private = 0x17B0;                      // Camera view data - used for projection in structs_funcs.h
inline uint64_t control_rotation = 0x4E0;                           // Player control rotation - used for recoil control in main.cpp

// Mesh and rendering
inline uint64_t mesh = 0x4E8;                                       // Player mesh component - used for bone access in main.cpp
inline uint64_t root_component = 0x288;                             // Root scene component - used for position/rotation in main.cpp
inline uint64_t root_position = 0x170;                              // World position - used for ESP positioning in main.cpp
inline uint64_t root_rotation = 0x188;                              // World rotation - used for angle calculations in main.cpp
inline uint64_t bone_array = 0x730;                                 // Bone transform array - used for skeleton rendering in main.cpp
inline uint64_t bone_count = 0x738;                                 // Number of bones - used for bone iteration in main.cpp
inline uint64_t component_to_world = 0x2d0;                         // Transform matrix - used for bone world positions in main.cpp/structs_funcs.h
inline uintptr_t last_submit_time = 0x478;                          // VISABLE
inline uintptr_t last_render_time = 0x47C;                          // VISABLE

// Player identification and team system
inline uint64_t unique_id = 0x38;                                   // Actor unique identifier - used for player tracking in main.cpp
inline uintptr_t team_component = 0x6a8;                            // Team component pointer - used for team identification in main.cpp
inline uintptr_t team_id = 0x40;                                    // Team ID value - used for enemy/ally detection in main.cpp
inline uintptr_t was_ally = 0x0F29;                                 // Previous ally status - used for team validation in main.cpp

// Health and damage system
inline uint64_t damage_handler = 0xC68; //0x0C58;                   // Damage component - used for health access in main.cpp
inline uint64_t cached_life = 0x1E0;                                // Current health value - used for health display in main.cpp

// Actor state
inline uintptr_t dormant = 0x101;                                   // Actor dormant flag - used for visibility checks in main.cpp

// Ability/Smoke detection offsets
inline uint64_t static_mesh_component = 0x3b8;                      // Static mesh component - used for ability detection
inline uint64_t playfx_sphere = 0x410;                              // Sphere component for abilities - used for smoke radius
inline uint64_t sphere_radius = 0x568;                              // Sphere radius - used for smoke size
inline uint64_t object_id = 0x18;                                   // Object ID for FName resolution

// FName system offsets
inline uint64_t fname_pool = 0x0B830080; //0x0B83A080               // FName pool address - used for name resolution in main.cpp (old: 0xb715d40) could also be 0xB83A080
inline uint64_t fname_key = 0x0BA0F500; //0x0BA195C0                // FName encryption key - used for name decryption in main.cpp

// VGK/CR3 Shadow Regions offsets
inline uint64_t vgk_shadow_regions = 0x84C08;                       // VGK shadow regions data structure - used for PML4 base finding in utils.hpp
inline uint64_t vgk_byte_key = 0x84CD0;                             // VGK byte key for CR3 decryption - used in decryptedClonedCR3 in utils.hpp
inline uint64_t vgk_key = 0x84C20;                                  // VGK main key for CR3 decryption - used in decryptedClonedCR3 in utils.hpp

// Bomb stuff
inline uint64_t ABombGameState_C = 0xFE0;

// Inventory and equippable system
inline uint64_t inventory = 0xC08;                              // Inventory component - used for ability detection
inline uintptr_t current_equippable = 0x248;                    // Current equipped item/ability - used for ability detection

// Projectile system offsets
inline uint64_t projectile_throw_state = 0x11B0;                // OverhandThrowState (0x1090 for underhand)
inline uint64_t projectile_throw_tuning = 0x0310;               // FProjectileThrowTuning offset
```

For the current Weapon offset, you need to first get Fname, using Xor string Decrypt and FnamePool / FnameState, after that you need inventory and current equippable offsets.

  Code:
```
inline uint64_t fname_pool = 0xB8C5840;
inline uint64_t fname_state = 0xBAA5580;
inline uint64_t inventory = 0xc18;
inline uintptr_t current_equippable = 0x248;
```
  It will return you a smth, you decrypt it using the DecryptXor function ( all over UC ) and u will get Valorant Weapon names.

 You will also need this:

  Code:
```
const std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> WEAPON_MAP = {
    {"Ability_Melee_Base_C", "Knife"},

inline uintptr_t decryptedClonedCR3(uintptr_t vgkbase)
{
	uint64_t _RAX = find_RAX(); // EAX
	BYTE byte_140084CD0 = ReadMemory<BYTE>(vgkbase + 0x84F70);
	uint64_t key = ReadMemory<uint64_t>(vgkbase + 0x84EC0);

	uint64_t v5 = byte_140084CD0 & 0x73;
	uint64_t v11 = ~(int)_RAX;

	uint64_t v12 =
		(0x8000000000000001ULL * (int)_RAX
			+ 0xAFDBF65F8A4AC9C9ULL * ~key
			+ 0x2FDBF65F8A4AC9C9ULL * (key + 1)
			+ (((key ^ (int)_RAX) << 63) ^ 0x8000000000000000ULL))
		*
		(0x7D90DC33C620C593ULL * key * (0x13D0F34E00000000ULL * key + 0x483C4F8900000000ULL)
			+ 0xFD90DC33C620C592ULL * ~(key * (0x13D0F34E00000000ULL * key + 0x483C4F8900000000ULL))
			+ (key *
				(0xCE3CE5E180000000ULL * ~key
					+ 0x55494E5B80000000ULL * (int)_RAX
					+ 0xC83B18136241A38DULL * v11
					+ 0x72F1C9B7E241A38DULL *
					(
						((int)_RAX | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
						(0x3F71D992FBB2CCEAULL - ((int)_RAX & 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL))
						)
					)
				+ 0x71C31A1E80000000ULL)
			*
			(0x99BF7D2380CF6EC3ULL * (int)_RAX
				+ 0x664082DC7F30913EULL * (v5 | key)
				+ 0x19BF7D2380CF6EC2ULL * v11
				+ 0xE64082DC7F30913EULL * (~key & ~v5)
				+ ((key + (v5 | (int)_RAX) + (v5 & (key ^ (int)_RAX))) << 63))
			+ 0x2183995CC620C592ULL);

	uint64_t expr =
		0x49B74B6480000000ULL * key +
		0xC2D8B464B4418C6CULL * ~v5 +
		0x66B8CDC1FFFFFFFFULL * v5 +
		0x5C1FE6A2B4418C6DULL * ((v5 & key) - (key | ~v5));

	uint64_t logic =
		-3 * ~key +
		(v5 ^ key) +
		-2 * (v5 ^ (v5 | key)) +
		2 * (((byte_140084CD0 & 0x10 | 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) ^ 0xC08E266D044D3314ULL) + (~key | v5 ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL)) -
		(v5 ^ ~key ^ 0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL) -
		0x3F71D992FBB2CCEBULL;

	uint64_t v13 =
		((~(expr * logic) ^ ~v12) << 63) +
		0x6C80110954C7304DULL *
		(
			((int)_RAX & (expr * logic)) -
			(v11 & ~(expr * logic)) -
			(int)_RAX
			);

	uint64_t DecryptedCR3 =
		0x137FEEF6AB38CFB4ULL * (expr * logic) +
		v13 -
		0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL * v12 -
		0x4F167C5CD4C7304EULL;

	return (uintptr_t)DecryptedCR3;
}

I know the crash issue you mean
 But right now I actually reached a point where I get a messagebox instead of an instant crash
 The only thing I see right now is that module_base is null
 And that basically means the method im using is actually working
 It’s loading and reaching the code
 It just needs the module_base to resolve correctly
 So this is already a step forward compared to before

 VGK isnt really grabbing full files off your system
 What they focus on is the directory and the environment the file is coming from
 The path itself can make the file look suspicious even if the code is clean
 And it makes sense because sending full signed exe files would be unrealistic
 Once you add a cert the file becomes huge and uploading something like that in real time would basically be impossible for them
 So the path logic is what actually triggers the behavior
 And yeah signing the exe just makes everything look more legitimate and reduces the chance of the loader being flagged

 {

 }

 return 0;
 }

 uintptr_t DecryptedClonedCR3 = decryptedClonedCR3(km::vgk, true);
 if (!DecryptedClonedCR3) {
 return 0;
 }

 km::cr3_context = DecryptedClonedCR3;
 }
 else
 {
 Data = km::RKA<ShadowRegionsDataStructure>(km::vgk + 0x850E8);

 uintptr_t DecClonedCr3 = decryptedClonedCR3(km::vgk, false);
 if (!DecClonedCr3) return 0;

 km::cr3_context = DecClonedCr3;
 }

You can get actors by this TArray<AShooterCharacter*> Actors = FindAllShooterCharactersWithAlliance(World, MyShooter, EAresAlliance::Alliance_Any, false, true);
 TArray<AShooterCharacter*> FindAllShooterCharactersWithAlliance(UWorld* WorldContextObject, AShooterCharacter* LocalViewer, EAresAlliance Alliance, bool OnlyPlayerControlled, bool OnlyAlivePlayers)
 {
 auto function_name = L"ShooterGame.ShooterBlueprintLibrary.FindAllShooterCharactersWithAlliance";
 static UObject* Function = nullptr;

 if (!Function)
 Function = UObject::StaticFindObject(nullptr, nullptr, function_name, false);

 struct
 {
 UWorld* WorldContextObject;
 AShooterCharacter* LocalViewer;
 EAresAlliance Alliance;
 bool OnlyPlayerControlled;
 bool OnlyAlivePlayers;
 TArray<AShooterCharacter*> Out;
 } Parameters;

 Parameters.WorldContextObject = WorldContextObject;
 Parameters.LocalViewer = LocalViewer;
 Parameters.Alliance = Alliance;
 Parameters.OnlyPlayerControlled = OnlyPlayerControlled;
 Parameters.OnlyAlivePlayers = OnlyAlivePlayers;

 Function->ProcessEvent(Static_Class(), Function, &Parameters);
 return Parameters.Out;
 }
 enum class EAresAlliance : uint8_t {
 Alliance_Ally = 0,
 Alliance_Enemy = 1,
 Alliance_Neutral = 2,
 Alliance_Any = 3,
 Alliance_Count = 4,
 Alliance_MAX = 5
 };

> **evoxtm:**
> Originally Posted by evoxtm   anyone would mind to share LineTraceSingle native function?

  Code:
```
class system : public uobject
{
public:
	static system* static_class() {
		static system* klass = nullptr;
		if (!klass)
			klass = uobject::find_object<system>(_(L"Engine.KismetSystemLibrary"));

		return klass;
	}

	fhit_result line_trace_single(uobject* world_context, apawn* local_actor, fvector start, fvector end);
};

fhit_result system::line_trace_single(uobject* world_context, apawn* local_actor, fvector start, fvector end) {
	if (!this || !world_context || !local_actor) return fhit_result();

	static uobject* fn = nullptr;
	if (!fn)
		fn = uobject::find_object(_(L"Engine.KismetSystemLibrary.LineTraceSingle"));

	struct {
		uobject* world_context;
		fvector start;
		fvector end;
		ecollision_channel trace_channel;
		bool trace_complex;
		uint8_t pad_22[0x6];
		tarray<uint64_t> actors_to_ignore;
		uint8_t draw_debug_type;
		uint8_t pad_39[0x7];
		fhit_result out_hit;
		bool ignore_self;
		uint8_t pad_d9[0x3];
		flinearcolor trace_color;
		flinearcolor trace_hit_color;
		float draw_time;
		fstring in_trace_tag;
		bool return_value;
		uint8_t pad_111[0x7];
	} params{};

	tarray<uint64_t> objects;
	params.world_context = world_context;
	params.start = start;
	params.end = end;
	params.trace_channel = ecollision_channel::ecc_visibility;
	params.trace_complex = true;
	params.actors_to_ignore = objects;
	params.ignore_self = true;

	process_event(fn, &params);
	return params.out_hit;
}
```

static inline uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
{
    const uint64_t M_AA = 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAull;
    const uint64_t M_CC = 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCull;
    const uint64_t M_F0 = 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ull;
    const uint64_t M_FF = 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ull;
    const uint64_t MIX = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1Dull;

    uint64_t v4, v5, v6, v7, v8;
    uint64_t v13, v14, v15, v16, v17 = 0, v18 = 0;
    uint64_t v19, v20, v21, v22;
    uint64_t v24;

    uint64_t temp = MIX * static_cast<uint64_t>(
        key ^
        ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^
        (key << 25)
        );

    v4 = temp % 7ull;
    v5 = v4;
    v6 = state[v5];
    v7 = static_cast<uint32_t>(temp >> 32);
    v8 = static_cast<uint32_t>(v5 % 7u);

    uint32_t v4_low = static_cast<uint32_t>(v4);
    if (v4_low == 7u * (v4_low / 7u))
    {
        v6 = ~v6 - v7;
    }
    else if (v8 == 1u)
    {
        uint64_t sum2 = static_cast<uint64_t>(v7) + 2ull * v5;
        uint64_t x = sum2 + v6;
        uint64_t half = x >> 1;
        v6 = half ^ ((half ^ (x << 1)) & M_AA);
    }
    else if (v8 == 2u)
    {
        uint64_t half = v6 >> 1;
        uint64_t b = half ^ ((half ^ (v6 << 1)) & M_AA);
        v6 = static_cast<uint64_t>(v7) + v5 + b;

        if ((v5 % 7) == 4u)
        {
            uint64_t sum2 = static_cast<uint64_t>(v7) + 2ull * v5;
            v13 = ~sum2 ^ v6;

            uint64_t half2 = v13 >> 1;
            uint64_t t0 = half2 ^ ((half2 ^ (v13 << 1)) & M_AA);
            v14 = t0 >> 2;
            v15 = v14 ^ ((v14 ^ (t0 << 2)) & M_CC);
            v16 = (v15 >> 4) ^ (((v15 >> 4) ^ (v15 << 4)) & M_F0);
            v17 = v16 >> 8;
            v18 = ((v16 >> 8) ^ (v16 << 8)) & M_FF;

            v6 = __ROR8__(v17 ^ v18, 32);
        }
    }
    else if (v8 == 3u)
    {
        uint64_t v9 = static_cast<uint64_t>(v7) + 2ull * v5;
        uint8_t n = static_cast<uint8_t>(v9);
        uint8_t q = n / 63u;
        uint8_t shiftR = n - 63u * q + 1u;
        uint8_t shiftL = 63u * q - n + 63u;

        v6 = ((v6 >> shiftR) | (v6 << shiftL)) -
            static_cast<uint64_t>(v7 + static_cast<uint32_t>(v5));
    }

    if ((v5 % 7) == 5u)
    {
        uint64_t half = v6 >> 1;
        uint64_t b0 = half ^ ((half ^ (v6 << 1)) & M_AA);
        uint64_t t1 = b0 >> 2;
        uint64_t t2 = t1 ^ ((t1 ^ (b0 << 2)) & M_CC);
        uint64_t t3 = (t2 >> 4) ^ (((t2 >> 4) ^ (t2 << 4)) & M_F0);
        uint64_t t4 = t3 >> 8;
        uint64_t t5 = ((t3 >> 8) ^ (t3 << 8)) & M_FF;
        v6 = static_cast<uint64_t>(v7) + v5 + __ROR8__(t4 ^ t5, 32);
    }
    else if ((v5 % 7) == 6u)
    {
        uint64_t sum2 = static_cast<uint64_t>(v7) + 2ull * v5;
        v19 = (v6 ^ ~sum2) >> 1;
        v20 = v19 ^ ((v19 ^ ((v6 ^ ~sum2) << 1)) & M_AA);
        v21 = (v20 >> 2) ^ (((v20 >> 2) ^ (v20 << 2)) & M_CC);
        v22 = (v21 >> 4) ^ (((v21 >> 4) ^ (v21 << 4)) & M_F0);
        v17 = v22 >> 8;
        v18 = ((v22 >> 8) ^ (v22 << 8)) & M_FF;
        v6 = __ROR8__(v17 ^ v18, 32);
    }

    v24 = v6 ^ static_cast<uint64_t>(key);

    return v24;
}
```
