looks that this one still working, but idk what i change in nameKey, pml4base + 0x0 should work, but idk what i change when hvci on
 current nameKey is incorrect

  Code:
```
std::string get_fname(int key)
{
    UINT chunkOffset = (UINT)(key >> 16);
    USHORT nameOffset = (USHORT)key;
    uint64_t poolAddress = driver::proc_base_address + offsets::fname_pool + ((chunkOffset + 2) * 8);
    uint64_t namePoolChunk = driver::read<uint64_t>(poolAddress);
    uint64_t entryOffset = namePoolChunk + (4 * nameOffset);
    FNameEntry nameEntry = driver::read<FNameEntry>(entryOffset);

    std::string name(nameEntry.AnsiName);

    uintptr_t nameKey = driver::read<uintptr_t>(driver::proc_base_address + offsets::fname_pool_state + 0x38); // before was pml4base + 0x0

    if (name.size() < nameEntry.Header.Len)
    {
        return name;
    }

    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < nameEntry.Header.Len; i++)
    {
        BYTE b = i & 3;
        name[i] ^= nameEntry.Header.Len ^ *((LPBYTE)&nameKey + b);
    }

    return name;
}
```

uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
{
    uint64_t v3 = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1Di64
        * ((uint32_t)key ^ (((uint32_t)key ^ ((uint64_t)(uint32_t)key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (uint32_t)(key << 25));

    uint64_t idx = v3 % 7;
    uint64_t v5 = state[idx];
    uint64_t v6 = v3 >> 32;
    uint32_t mod7 = (uint32_t)idx % 7;

    if (mod7 == 0)
    {
        uint64_t v8 = ((v5 >> 1) ^ ((v5 >> 1) ^ (2 * v5)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAui64) >> 1;
        v5 = v8 ^ (v8 ^ (2 * ((v5 >> 1) ^ ((v5 >> 1) ^ (2 * v5)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAui64))) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAui64;
    }
    else if (mod7 == 1)
    {

        v5 = ~((v5 << (63 * (uint8_t)(((int)v6 + 2 * (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)v6 + 2 * (uint8_t)idx) + 63))
            | (v5 >> ((uint8_t)(((int)v6 + 2 * (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1)));
    }
    else if (mod7 == 2)
    {

        uint64_t tmp = (uint32_t)(v6 + 2 * idx) + v5;
        v5 = (tmp >> ((uint8_t)(((int)v6 + (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1))
            | (tmp << (63 * (uint8_t)(((int)v6 + (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)v6 + (uint8_t)idx) + 63));
    }
    else if (mod7 == 3)
    {

        uint64_t tmp = v5 - (uint32_t)(v6 + 2 * idx);
        uint64_t v38 = ((tmp >> 1) ^ ((tmp >> 1) ^ (2 * tmp)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAui64) >> 2;
        uint64_t v39 = v38 ^ (v38 ^ (4 * ((tmp >> 1) ^ ((tmp >> 1) ^ (2 * tmp)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAui64))) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCui64;
        uint64_t v40 = (v39 >> 4) ^ ((v39 >> 4) ^ (16 * v39)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ui64;
        v5 = __ROR8__((v40 >> 8) ^ ((v40 >> 8) ^ (v40 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ui64, 32);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 4)
    {
        v5 += (uint32_t)(v6 + 2 * idx) - (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(v6 + idx);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 5)
    {

        uint64_t tmp = v5 - (uint32_t)(v6 + 2 * idx);
        v5 = (tmp >> ((uint8_t)(((int)v6 + (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1))
            | (tmp << (63 * (uint8_t)(((int)v6 + (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)v6 + (uint8_t)idx) + 63));
    }
    else if (mod7 == 6)
    {

        v5 = ~((v5 << ((uint8_t)(((int)v6 + 2 * (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1))
            | (v5 >> (63 * (uint8_t)(((int)v6 + 2 * (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)v6 + 2 * (uint8_t)idx) + 63)));
    }

    return v5 ^ (uint32_t)key;
}

std::string get_fname(int key)
{
    uint chunkOffset = (uint)((int)(key) >> 16);
    ushort nameOffset = (ushort)key;
    std::uint64_t namePoolChunk = readv<std::uint64_t>((std::uintptr_t)((uintptr_t)g_base + fnamepool + ((chunkOffset + 2) * 8)));

    std::uint64_t entryOffset = namePoolChunk + (ulong)(4 * nameOffset);
    FNameEntry nameEntry = readv<FNameEntry>(entryOffset);

    auto name = nameEntry.AnsiName;
    std::uintptr_t nameKey = xor_key;

    if (nameEntry.Header.Len <= 365)
        for (std::uint16_t i = 0; i < nameEntry.Header.Len; i++)
        {
            BYTE b = i & 3;
            name[i] ^= nameEntry.Header.Len ^ *((LPBYTE)&nameKey + b);
        }

    return name;
}
```

  Code:
```
bool decrypt_name_key(uintptr_t valorant_base, uintptr_t* returned_xor)
{
    uintptr_t namepoolkey = readv<uintptr_t>(valorant_base + names_key);
    if (!namepoolkey)
    {
        printf("[-] offset name_pool_key invalid!\n");
        return false;
    }

#pragma pack(push, 1)
    struct state
    {
        uintptr_t keys[7];
    };
#pragma pack(pop)

    state xor_state = readv<state>(valorant_base + names_state);

    const auto address = decrypt_xor_keys(namepoolkey, (uintptr_t*)&xor_state);

    uintptr_t xors = readv<uintptr_t>(address);

    if (xors)
    {

        *returned_xor = xors;
        return true;
    }
    else
    {

        return false;
    }
}

FVector3 c2w(const Transform& componentToWorld, const Transform& boneTransform)
{
	const Matrix boneMatrix =
	boneTransform.to_matrix_with_scale() * componentToWorld.to_matrix_with_scale();

	return {boneMatrix.m[3][0], boneMatrix.m[3][1], boneMatrix.m[3][2]};
}

bool w2s(const Vector3& Target, Vector2* Dst, const Vector3& CameraLocation, const Rotator& CameraRotation, const float Fov)
{
		const float screen_center_x = (float)GetScreenWidth() / 2.f;
		const float screen_center_y = (float)GetScreenHeight() / 2.f;

		const auto camera_matrix = Matrix(CameraRotation, Target);
		const auto x = Vector3(camera_matrix.m[0][0], camera_matrix.m[0][1], camera_matrix.m[0][2]);
		const auto y = Vector3(camera_matrix.m[1][0], camera_matrix.m[1][1], camera_matrix.m[1][2]);
		const auto z = Vector3(camera_matrix.m[2][0], camera_matrix.m[2][1], camera_matrix.m[2][2]);

		const Vector3 v_delta = Target - CameraLocation;

		Vector3 transformed{};
		transformed.x = v_delta.dot(y);
		transformed.y = v_delta.dot(z);
		transformed.z = v_delta.dot(x);

		if (transformed.z < 1.00f)
			transformed.z = 1.00f;

		Dst->x = screen_center_x + transformed.x * (screen_center_x / tanf(Fov * static_cast<float>(M_PI) / 360.f)) / transformed.z;
		Dst->y = screen_center_y - transformed.y * (screen_center_x / tanf(Fov * static_cast<float>(M_PI) / 360.f)) / transformed.z;

		if (Dst->x >= 0.0f && Dst->x <= GetScreenWidth())
		{
			if (Dst->y >= 0.0f && Dst->y <= GetScreenHeight())
			{
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
}
```

uintptr_t Decrypt(uintptr_t vgk)
{
uint8_t index = *(volatile uint8_t*)(vgk + 0xACC50);
uintptr_t xorkey = *(volatile uintptr_t*)(vgk + 0xACC58);
uintptr_t encrypted = *(volatile uintptr_t*)(vgk + 0xACC60 + (index * sizeof(uintptr_t)));
uintptr_t decrypted = encrypted ^ xorkey;

return decrypted;
}
```

### Post #4586237 — weloveoverprice — 4th February 2026, 08:09 AM

Code:
```
uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
{
    uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1Dui64
        * (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));

    uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state[idx];
    uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
    uint32_t mod7 = (uint32_t)idx;

    if (mod7 == 0)
    {
        // ROR then subtract hi
        uint8_t q = (uint8_t)(((int)hi - 1) / 0x3F);
        uint8_t rshift = (uint8_t)hi - 63 * q;
        uint8_t lshift = 63 * q - ((uint8_t)hi - 1) + 63;
        val = ((val >> rshift) | (val << lshift)) - hi;
    }
    else if (mod7 == 1)
    {
        // ROL then add (hi + idx)
        uint32_t rot = hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx;
        uint8_t lshift = (uint8_t)(rot % 0x3F) + 1;
        uint8_t rshift = 63 * (uint8_t)(rot / 0x3F) - (uint8_t)hi - 2 * (uint8_t)idx + 63;
        val = ((val << lshift) | (val >> rshift)) + (uint32_t)(hi + idx);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 3)
    {
        // NOT(ROR)
        uint32_t rot = hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx;
        uint8_t rshift = (uint8_t)(rot % 0x3F) + 1;
        uint8_t lshift = 63 * (uint8_t)(rot / 0x3F) - (uint8_t)hi - 2 * (uint8_t)idx + 63;
        val = ~((val >> rshift) | (val << lshift));
    }
    else if (mod7 == 4)
    {
        // XOR with (hi + idx)
        val = val ^ (uint32_t)(hi + idx);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 5)
    {
        // Single bit-swap then XOR with ~(hi + idx)
        val = (val >> 1) ^ ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + idx) ^ (((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAui64);
    }

    return val ^ key;
}
```

inline uint64_t ROL8(uint64_t value, unsigned int shift) {
	const unsigned int mask = 63;
	shift &= mask;
	return (value << shift) | (value >> (64 - shift));
}
__forceinline uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
{
    uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1Dui64
        * (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));

    uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state[idx];
    uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
    uint32_t mod7 = (uint32_t)idx;

    if (mod7 == 0)
    {
        // ROR then subtract hi
        uint8_t q = (uint8_t)(((int)hi - 1) / 0x3F);
        uint8_t rshift = (uint8_t)hi - 63 * q;
        uint8_t lshift = 63 * q - ((uint8_t)hi - 1) + 63;
        val = ((val >> rshift) | (val << lshift)) - hi;
    }
    else if (mod7 == 1)
    {
        // ROL then add (hi + idx)
        uint32_t rot = hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx;
        uint8_t lshift = (uint8_t)(rot % 0x3F) + 1;
        uint8_t rshift = 63 * (uint8_t)(rot / 0x3F) - (uint8_t)hi - 2 * (uint8_t)idx + 63;
        val = ((val << lshift) | (val >> rshift)) + (uint32_t)(hi + idx);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 3)
    {
        // NOT(ROR)
        uint32_t rot = hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx;
        uint8_t rshift = (uint8_t)(rot % 0x3F) + 1;
        uint8_t lshift = 63 * (uint8_t)(rot / 0x3F) - (uint8_t)hi - 2 * (uint8_t)idx + 63;
        val = ~((val >> rshift) | (val << lshift));
    }
    else if (mod7 == 4)
    {
        // XOR with (hi + idx)
        val = val ^ (uint32_t)(hi + idx);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 5)
    {
        // Single bit-swap then XOR with ~(hi + idx)
        val = (val >> 1) ^ ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + idx) ^ (((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAui64);
    }

    return val ^ key;
}

				) +

		0x66B8CDC1FFFFFFFFULL * v5 +
		0x5C1FE6A2B4418C6DULL * ((v5 & key) - (key | ~v5));

uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
{
    uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1Dui64
        * (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));

    uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state[idx];
    uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
    uint32_t mod7 = (uint32_t)idx;

    if (mod7 == 0)
    {
        // ROR then subtract hi
        uint8_t q = (uint8_t)(((int)hi - 1) / 0x3F);
        uint8_t rshift = (uint8_t)hi - 63 * q;
        uint8_t lshift = 63 * q - ((uint8_t)hi - 1) + 63;
        val = ((val >> rshift) | (val << lshift)) - hi;
    }
    else if (mod7 == 1)
    {
        // ROL then add (hi + idx)
        uint32_t rot = hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx;
        uint8_t lshift = (uint8_t)(rot % 0x3F) + 1;
        uint8_t rshift = 63 * (uint8_t)(rot / 0x3F) - (uint8_t)hi - 2 * (uint8_t)idx + 63;
        val = ((val << lshift) | (val >> rshift)) + (uint32_t)(hi + idx);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 3)
    {
        // NOT(ROR)
        uint32_t rot = hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx;
        uint8_t rshift = (uint8_t)(rot % 0x3F) + 1;
        uint8_t lshift = 63 * (uint8_t)(rot / 0x3F) - (uint8_t)hi - 2 * (uint8_t)idx + 63;
        val = ~((val >> rshift) | (val << lshift));
    }
    else if (mod7 == 4)
    {
        // XOR with (hi + idx)
        val = val ^ (uint32_t)(hi + idx);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 5)
    {
        // Single bit-swap then XOR with ~(hi + idx)
        val = (val >> 1) ^ ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + idx) ^ (((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAui64);
    }

    return val ^ key;
}

bool decrypt_name_key(uintptr_t valorant_base, uintptr_t* returned_xor)
{
    uintptr_t namepoolkey = memory->read_memory<uintptr_t>(valorant_base + offsets::fname_key);
    if (!namepoolkey) return false;

    struct state { uintptr_t keys[7]; };
    state xor_state = memory->read_memory<state>(valorant_base + offsets::fname_state);
    const auto address = decrypt_xor_keys(static_cast<uint32_t>(namepoolkey), reinterpret_cast<uint64_t*>(&xor_state));
    uintptr_t xors = memory->read_memory<uintptr_t>(address);

    if (xors) {
        *returned_xor = xors;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool init_fname_system(uintptr_t game_base) {
    return decrypt_name_key(game_base, &xor_key);
}

std::string get_fname(int32_t key)
{
    if (key == 0 || xor_key == 0) return "";

    uint chunkOffset = (uint)((int)(key) >> 16);
    ushort nameOffset = (ushort)key;
    uintptr_t base = memory->process_base_address;

    std::uint64_t namePoolChunk = memory->read_memory<std::uint64_t>(
        base + offsets::fnamepool + ((chunkOffset + 2) * 8)
    );

    if (!namePoolChunk || namePoolChunk < 0x1000000 || namePoolChunk > 0x7FFFFFFFFFFF) return "";

    std::uint64_t entryOffset = namePoolChunk + (ulong)(4 * nameOffset);
    FNameEntry nameEntry = memory->read_memory<FNameEntry>(entryOffset);

    char name[1024];
    memcpy(name, nameEntry.AnsiName, sizeof(nameEntry.AnsiName));
    std::uintptr_t nameKey = xor_key;

    if (nameEntry.Header.Len <= 365) {
        for (std::uint16_t i = 0; i < nameEntry.Header.Len; i++) {
            BYTE b = i & 3;
            name[i] ^= nameEntry.Header.Len ^ *((LPBYTE)&nameKey + b);
        }
    }

    return std::string(name, nameEntry.Header.Len);
}
```

			uint8_t	 lshift = (uint8_t)(rot % 0x3F) + 1;
			uint8_t	 rshift = 63 * (uint8_t)(rot / 0x3F) - (uint8_t)hi - 2 * (uint8_t)idx + 63;
			val = ((val << lshift) | (val >> rshift)) + (uint32_t)(hi + idx);
		}
		else if (mod7 == 3)
		{
			// NOT(ROR)
			uint32_t rot = hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx;
			uint8_t	 rshift = (uint8_t)(rot % 0x3F) + 1;
			uint8_t	 lshift = 63 * (uint8_t)(rot / 0x3F) - (uint8_t)hi - 2 * (uint8_t)idx + 63;
			val = ~((val >> rshift) | (val << lshift));
		}
		else if (mod7 == 4)
		{
			// XOR with (hi + idx)
			val = val ^ (uint32_t)(hi + idx);
		}
		else if (mod7 == 5)
		{
			// Single bit-swap then XOR with ~(hi + idx)
			val = (val >> 1) ^ ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + idx) ^ (((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA);
		}

		return val ^ key;
	}

	bool decrypt_name_key(uintptr_t valorant_base, uintptr_t* returned_xor)
	{
		uintptr_t namepoolkey = memory.Read<uintptr_t>(valorant_base + O_FNameKey);
		if (!namepoolkey)
			return false;

		struct state
		{
			uintptr_t keys[7];
		};

		state	   xor_state = memory.Read<state>(valorant_base + O_FNameState);
		const auto address = decrypt_xor_keys(static_cast<uint32_t>(namepoolkey), reinterpret_cast<uint64_t*>(&xor_state));
		uintptr_t  xors = memory.Read<uintptr_t>(address);

		if (xors)
		{
			*returned_xor = xors;
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	std::string get_fname(int32_t key)
	{
		if (key == 0 || O_FNameXORKey == 0)
			return "";

		uint	  chunkOffset = (uint)((int)(key) >> 16);
		ushort	  nameOffset = (ushort)key;
		uintptr_t base = Pointers::BaseAddress;

		std::uint64_t namePoolChunk = memory.Read<std::uint64_t>(
			base + O_FNamePool + ((chunkOffset + 2) * 8));

		if (!namePoolChunk || namePoolChunk < 0x1000000 || namePoolChunk > 0x7FFFFFFFFFFF)
			return "";

		std::uint64_t entryOffset = namePoolChunk + (ulong)(4 * nameOffset);
		auto		  nameEntry = memory.Read<ValorantSDK::FNameEntry>(entryOffset);

		char name[1024];
		memcpy(name, nameEntry.AnsiName, sizeof(nameEntry.AnsiName));
		std::uintptr_t nameKey = O_FNameXORKey;

		if (nameEntry.Header.Len <= 365)
		{
			for (std::uint16_t i = 0; i < nameEntry.Header.Len; i++)
			{
				uint8_t b = i & 3;
				name[i] ^= nameEntry.Header.Len ^ *((uint8_t*)&nameKey + b);
			}
		}

		return std::string(name, nameEntry.Header.Len);
	}
```

### Post #4600787 — kunodee — 19th February 2026, 05:10 PM

Code:
```
uint64_t CDecryption::DecryptXorKeys(const uint32_t Key, const uint64_t* State)
{
    uint32_t rng = Key ^ (((Key ^ (Key >> 15)) >> 12)) ^ (Key << 25);
    uint64_t v3 = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * rng;
    uint64_t idx = v3 % 7;
    uint64_t val = State[idx];
    uint32_t high = (uint32_t)(v3 >> 32);
    uint32_t mod7 = (uint32_t)(idx % 7);

    auto CalcRot = [](uint32_t in) -> uint8_t {
        uint64_t res = ((uint64_t)in * 0x4104105ULL) >> 32;
        res = (res + ((in - res) >> 1)) >> 5;
        return (uint8_t)(63 * res);
    };

    uint64_t result;

    if (mod7 == 0)
    {
        result = ~(val - high);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 1)
    {
        uint32_t r = high + 2 * (uint32_t)idx;
        uint8_t rot = CalcRot(r);
        uint64_t base = val - (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(high + (uint32_t)idx);
        result = (base >> ((uint8_t)rot - (uint8_t)r + 0x3F))
            | (base << ((uint8_t)r - (uint8_t)rot + 1));
    }
    else if (mod7 == 3)
    {
        result = val + (uint32_t)(high + 2 * (uint32_t)idx)
            - (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(high + (uint32_t)idx);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 4)
    {
        uint64_t gray = (val >> 1) ^ ((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
        result = (uint32_t)(high + 2 * (uint32_t)idx) + gray;
    }
    else if (mod7 == 5)
    {
        uint64_t gray = (val >> 1) ^ ((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
        result = gray - (uint32_t)(high + 2 * (uint32_t)idx);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 6)
    {
        uint32_t r = high + 2 * (uint32_t)idx;
        uint8_t rot = CalcRot(r);
        uint64_t base = (uint32_t)(high + (uint32_t)idx) + val;
        result = (base >> ((uint8_t)rot - (uint8_t)r + 0x3F))
            | (base << ((uint8_t)r - (uint8_t)rot + 1));
    }
    else
    {
        result = val;
    }

    return result ^ Key;
}

uint64_t CDecryption::DecryptNameKey()
{
    uint64_t NamePoolKey = Driver::ReadPhysicalMemory<uint64_t>(Driver::ProcessBaseAddress + (Offsets::FNameState + 0x38));

    uint64_t StateRaw[7] = {};
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        StateRaw[i] = Driver::ReadPhysicalMemory<uint64_t>(
            Driver::ProcessBaseAddress + Offsets::FNameState + (i * 8));
    }

    uint64_t v3 = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * (uint32_t)NamePoolKey;
    uint64_t idx = v3 % 7;
    uint32_t high = (uint32_t)(v3 >> 32);
    uint64_t Addresses = DecryptXorKeys((uint32_t)NamePoolKey, StateRaw);
    uint64_t FinalKey = Driver::ReadPhysicalMemory<uint64_t>(Addresses);
    return FinalKey;
}
```

### Post #4610549 — CrazyHater — 2nd March 2026, 07:17 PM

Hi, wanted to let you guys know, you can still get the VGKPool's PML4 from BPT:

  Code:
```
bool Valorant::FindVGKPool()
{
	const uintptr_t VGK_POOL_SIZE = 0x200000;
	const uintptr_t DTB_PAGE_SIZE = 0x1000;
	auto fnValidPtr = [](uintptr_t ptr) -> bool
		{
			return ptr && (ptr & 0xfff) != 0xfff && ptr >= 0x1AD000 && ptr <= 0x7FFFFFFFFFFF;
		};

	DWORD iPoolTagEntry = 0;
	PVMMDLL_MAP_POOL pPoolMap = NULL;
	PVMMDLL_MAP_POOLENTRY pPoolEntryTag;
	bool GetBigPoolResult = VMMDLL_Map_GetPool((VMM_HANDLE)this->pDMA->hVMM, &pPoolMap, VMMDLL_POOLMAP_FLAG_BIG);
	if (!GetBigPoolResult) {
		spdlog::error("Failed to get kernel memory pool");
		return false;
	}
	if (pPoolMap->dwVersion != VMMDLL_MAP_POOL_VERSION) {
		spdlog::error("VMMDLL_Map_GetPool - BAD VERSION");
		VMMDLL_MemFree(pPoolMap); pPoolMap = NULL;
		return false;
	}

	VMMDLL_PROCESS_INFORMATION kernel;
	ZeroMemory(&kernel, sizeof(VMMDLL_PROCESS_INFORMATION));
	kernel.wVersion = VMMDLL_PROCESS_INFORMATION_VERSION;
	kernel.magic = VMMDLL_PROCESS_INFORMATION_MAGIC;
	SIZE_T pcb_kernel = sizeof(VMMDLL_PROCESS_INFORMATION);

	if (!VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformation((VMM_HANDLE)this->pDMA->hVMM, 4 | VMMDLL_PID_PROCESS_WITH_KERNELMEMORY, &kernel, &pcb_kernel)) {
		spdlog::error("Failed to get ntoskrnl");
	}

	bool bRetFlag = false;
	for (int i = 0; i < pPoolMap->cMap; i++) {
		PVMMDLL_MAP_POOLENTRY pPoolEntry = &pPoolMap->pMap[i];
		if (pPoolEntry->cb != DTB_PAGE_SIZE)
			continue;

		uintptr_t pPoolPhysical = this->pDMA->MemVirt2Phys(pPoolEntry->va, kernel.paDTB);
		if (!pPoolPhysical)
			uintptr_t pPoolPhysical = this->pDMA->InternalVirtToPhys(pPoolEntry->va, kernel.paDTB);
		if (!pPoolPhysical)
			continue;

		uintptr_t PML4EntriesBuffer[512] = { 0 };
		this->pDMA->Read(-1, pPoolPhysical, PML4EntriesBuffer, 0x1000);

		// df37b600040
		uintptr_t pWorldTranslate = this->pDMA->MemVirt2Phys(this->ppUWorld, pPoolPhysical);

		if (pWorldTranslate > 0x1AD000)
		{
			uintptr_t WorldPtr = this->pDMA->Read<uintptr_t>(-1, pWorldTranslate);

			if (!ValorantMemory::isVGKPoolAddress(WorldPtr))
				continue;
			uintptr_t pLevelTranslate = this->pDMA->MemVirt2Phys(WorldPtr + this->pOffsets->PersistentLevel, pPoolPhysical);
			if (pLevelTranslate < 0x1AD000)
				continue;

			uintptr_t pLevel = this->pDMA->Read<uintptr_t>(-1, pLevelTranslate);

			// chaos [removed]
			TArray<uintptr_t> ActorArray = this->pDMA->Read<TArray<uintptr_t>>(
				-1,
				this->pDMA->MemVirt2Phys(
					pLevel + this->pOffsets->ActorArray,
					pPoolPhysical
				)
			);

			if (!ValorantMemory::isVGKPoolAddress(pLevel)
				|| !fnValidPtr((uintptr_t)ActorArray.Data)
				)
				continue;

			this->VGKShadowDTB = pPoolPhysical;
			this->VGKPoolPhysical = pPoolPhysical;
			bRetFlag = true;
			memcpy(pDMA->PML4EntriesBuffer, PML4EntriesBuffer, sizeof(PML4EntriesBuffer));
			pDMA->SetCustomPML4Buffer(this->PID, pPoolPhysical);
			return true;
		}
		else continue;

		/*spdlog::info("PhysicalAddr : [{:X}]", pPoolPhysical);
		printf("PoolType : %d\n", pPoolEntry->tpPool);
		printf("PoolSize : %X\n", pPoolEntry->cb);*/
	}
	return bRetFlag;
}
```

 Of course, a new allocation for page tables will be created every few seconds.

 I am personally HVCI restricted so I never worked on it, but I am sure you can still have fun brute forcing this, even on DMA.

```
  decrypt xor keys :
  c:
```
static uint64_t ror64(uint64_t v, uint8_t n) {
    n &= 63;
    return n ? (v >> n) | (v << (64 - n)) : v;
}

static uint64_t gray_decode(uint64_t t) {
    return (t >> 1) ^ (((t >> 1) ^ (2 * t)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
}

static uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(uint32_t key, const uint64_t* s) {
    uint32_t rng = key ^ (((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12)) ^ (key << 25);
    uint64_t v = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * rng;
    uint64_t idx = v % 7;
    uint64_t val = s[idx];
    uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(v >> 32);
    uint32_t m = (uint32_t)(idx % 7);
    uint64_t r;
    if (m == 0) { r = ~val + hi; }
    else if (m == 1) {
        uint32_t rot = hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx;
        uint8_t rs = (uint8_t)(rot % 63) + 1;
        r = (uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) + ror64(val, rs);
    }
    else if (m == 3) { r = val + (uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) - (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx); }
    else if (m == 4) { r = gray_decode(val - (uint32_t)(hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx)); }
    else if (m == 5) { r = gray_decode((uint32_t)(hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx) + val); }
    else if (m == 6) {
        uint32_t rot = hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx;
        uint8_t rs = (uint8_t)(rot % 63) + 1;
        r = ror64(val, rs) - (uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx);
    }
    else { r = val; }
    return r ^ key;
}
```

> **Mockerz:**

Yeah

  Code:
```
__forceinline uint64_t FName::decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
{
    const uint64_t hash =
        0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL *
        (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));

    const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state[idx];

    const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
    const uint32_t mod7 = (uint32_t)idx % 7;

    if (mod7 == 0)
    {

        uint8_t l = (uint8_t)(((int)hi - 1) % 0x3F) + 1;
        uint8_t r = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi - 1) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)hi - 1) + 63;

        val = ~((val >> r) | (val << l));
    }
    else if (mod7 == 1)
    {

        uint64_t v = val - (uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx);

        v = ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (v << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
        v = (v >> 2) ^ (((v >> 2) ^ (v << 2)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL);
        v = (v >> 4) ^ (((v >> 4) ^ (v << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL);
        v = (v >> 8) ^ (((v >> 8) ^ (v << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL);

        val = _rotr64(v, 32);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 2)
    {
        val -= (uint32_t)(hi + idx) +
            (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 3)
    {
        uint64_t v = val + (uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx);

        uint8_t l = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
        uint8_t r = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) / 0x3F)
            - ((uint8_t)hi + (uint8_t)idx)
            + 63;

        val = (v >> r) | (v << l);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 4)
    {
        val = (val >> 1)
            ^ ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + idx)
            ^ (((val >> 1) ^ (val << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 5)
    {
        uint64_t v = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx) ^ val;

        v = ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (v << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
        v = (v >> 2) ^ (((v >> 2) ^ (v << 2)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL);
        v = (v >> 4) ^ (((v >> 4) ^ (v << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL);
        v = (v >> 8) ^ (((v >> 8) ^ (v << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL);

        val = _rotr64(v, 32);
    }
    else if (mod7 == 6)
    {
        uint64_t v = val;

        v = ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (v << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
        v = (v >> 2) ^ (((v >> 2) ^ (v << 2)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL);
        v = (v >> 4) ^ (((v >> 4) ^ (v << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL);
        v = (v >> 8) ^ (((v >> 8) ^ (v << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL);

        val = (uint32_t)(hi + idx) + _rotr64(v, 32);
    }

    return val ^ key;
}
```

>         v = (v >> 4) ^ (((v >> 4) ^ (v << 4)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL);
>         v = (v >> 8) ^ (((v >> 8) ^ (v << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL);

>         val = _rotr64(v, 32);

>

>     }
>
>     return val ^ key;

### Post #4613963 — R7flex2 — 6th March 2026, 07:42 PM

Code:
```
#pragma once
#include "memory/memory.hpp"
#include "sdk/offsets.hpp"
#include <unicorn/unicorn.h>
#include <vector>
#include <string>

namespace gobject {

inline uint64_t routine_start = 0;
inline uint64_t routine_end = 0;
inline uint64_t gobjects_addr = 0;
inline std::vector<uint8_t> routine_bytes;

inline const char* decrypt_block_pattern = "8B 15 ?? ?? ?? ?? 4C 8D 15 ?? ?? ?? ??";
inline const char* end_pattern = "49 33 C2";
inline const char* end_pattern_alt = "4C 31 C2";

inline uint64_t find_gobjects_from_lea(uint64_t lea_addr) {
	int32_t rel = memory->read_memory<int32_t>(lea_addr + 9);
	return lea_addr + 13 + rel;
}

inline uint64_t find_routine_end(uint64_t routine_start) {
	uint64_t end_addr = memory->pattern_scan(routine_start, 0x500, end_pattern);
	if (!end_addr) end_addr = memory->pattern_scan(routine_start, 0x500, end_pattern_alt);
	return end_addr ? end_addr + 3 : routine_start + 0x400;
}

inline const char* resolve_error = nullptr;

inline bool resolve(uint64_t base, size_t size = 0) {
	resolve_error = nullptr;
	if (!base) { resolve_error = "no base"; return false; }
	if (!size) {
		uint32_t e_lfanew = memory->read_memory<uint32_t>(base + 0x3C);
		size = memory->read_memory<uint32_t>(base + e_lfanew + 0x50);
		if (!size) size = 0x10000000;
	}

	routine_start = memory->pattern_scan(base, size, decrypt_block_pattern);
	if (!routine_start) { resolve_error = "no decrypt block"; return false; }

	gobjects_addr = find_gobjects_from_lea(routine_start);
	routine_end = find_routine_end(routine_start);
	size_t routine_len = routine_end - routine_start;
	if (routine_len > 0x1000 || routine_len == 0) { resolve_error = "bad routine size"; return false; }
	routine_bytes.resize(routine_len);
	if (!memory->read_physical_memory(reinterpret_cast<void*>(routine_start), routine_bytes.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(routine_len))) {
		resolve_error = "read routine fail";
		return false;
	}
	return true;
}

inline bool resolve_module(const std::wstring& module_name) {
	uint64_t base = memory->get_process_base(module_name);
	return base && resolve(base);
}

inline uint64_t decrypt_gobject_array() {
	if (!routine_start || !gobjects_addr || routine_bytes.empty()) return 0;

	uc_engine* uc = nullptr;
	if (uc_open(UC_ARCH_X86, UC_MODE_64, &uc) != UC_ERR_OK) return 0;

	uint64_t code_page = routine_start & ~0xFFFULL;
	uint64_t code_size = ((routine_end - code_page) + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFFULL;
	uint64_t gob_page = gobjects_addr & ~0xFFFULL;
	constexpr uint64_t fake_obj = 0x10000;

	std::vector<uint8_t> code_buf(code_size);
	if (!memory->read_physical_memory(reinterpret_cast<void*>(code_page), code_buf.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(code_size))) {
		uc_close(uc);
		return 0;
	}

	std::vector<uint8_t> state_buf(0x40);
	if (!memory->read_physical_memory(reinterpret_cast<void*>(gobjects_addr), state_buf.data(), 0x40)) {
		uc_close(uc);
		return 0;
	}

	if (uc_mem_map(uc, code_page, code_size, UC_PROT_ALL) != UC_ERR_OK) {
		uc_close(uc);
		return 0;
	}
	uc_mem_write(uc, code_page, code_buf.data(), code_size);

	if (uc_mem_map(uc, gob_page, 0x1000, UC_PROT_ALL) != UC_ERR_OK) {
		uc_close(uc);
		return 0;
	}
	uc_mem_write(uc, gobjects_addr, state_buf.data(), 0x40);

	if (uc_mem_map(uc, fake_obj, 0x1000, UC_PROT_READ | UC_PROT_WRITE) != UC_ERR_OK) {
		uc_close(uc);
		return 0;
	}
	uint32_t zero = 0;
	uc_mem_write(uc, fake_obj + 0x0C, &zero, 4);

	uint64_t rsp = 0x7FFFF000;
	if (uc_mem_map(uc, rsp - 0x1000, 0x2000, UC_PROT_READ | UC_PROT_WRITE) != UC_ERR_OK) {
		uc_close(uc);
		return 0;
	}
	uc_reg_write(uc, UC_X86_REG_RSP, &rsp);
	uc_reg_write(uc, UC_X86_REG_RBX, &fake_obj);
	uc_reg_write(uc, UC_X86_REG_RCX, &fake_obj);

	uc_err err = uc_emu_start(uc, routine_start, routine_end, 0, 0);
	uint64_t rax = 0;
	if (err == UC_ERR_OK) uc_reg_read(uc, UC_X86_REG_RAX, &rax);
	uc_close(uc);
	return rax;
}

constexpr int FUOBJECTITEM_SIZE = 24;
constexpr int NUM_ELEMENTS_PER_CHUNK = 64 * 1024;

inline uint64_t get_object_at_index(uint64_t gobject_array_ptr, int32_t index) {
	uint64_t objects_ptr = memory->read_memory<uint64_t>(gobject_array_ptr);

	int32_t chunk_idx = index / NUM_ELEMENTS_PER_CHUNK;
	int32_t within_chunk = index % NUM_ELEMENTS_PER_CHUNK;

	uint64_t chunk_ptr = memory->read_memory<uint64_t>(objects_ptr + chunk_idx * 8);
	if (!chunk_ptr) return 0;

	uint64_t item_addr = chunk_ptr + within_chunk * FUOBJECTITEM_SIZE;
	return memory->read_memory<uint64_t>(item_addr);
}

inline uint64_t gobject_array_ptr = 0;
inline int32_t gobject_num_elements = 0;

inline bool init_gobject_array() {
	gobject_array_ptr = decrypt_gobject_array();
	if (!gobject_array_ptr) return false;

	gobject_num_elements = memory->read_memory<int32_t>(gobject_array_ptr + 20);
	return gobject_num_elements > 0 && gobject_num_elements < 50000000;
}

}

Hello, you guys don't really need to decrypt the pointer to FName's xor key.

 If you looked at the logic to decrypt FNames,
  Code:
```
		for (uint16 i = 0; i < dwStrLength; i++)
		{
			chBuffer[i] ^= dwStrLength ^ *((BYTE*)&XorKey + (i & 3));
		}
```
  you would realize its fairly easy to brute force the key itself, no need to read it from the game's memory.

 Here is some example code:

  Code:
```

std::string DecryptName(FNameEntry Entry, DWORD XorKey)
{
	uint16 dwStrLength = Entry.NameEntryHeader.dwSTRLen;
	bool bWideStr = Entry.NameEntryHeader.bWideSTR;
	if (bWideStr)
		dwStrLength = *(const uint16*)&Entry.NameEntryHeader & 0xFFFE;
	char chBuffer[1024]{};
	if (dwStrLength < 1024)
	{
		memcpy_s(chBuffer, 128, Entry.first_char_encrypted, sizeof(Entry.first_char_encrypted));
		for (uint16 i = 0; i < dwStrLength; i++)
		{
			chBuffer[i] ^= dwStrLength ^ *((BYTE*)&XorKey + (i & 3));
		}
		chBuffer[dwStrLength] = '\0';
		return std::string(chBuffer);
	}
	return std::string();
}

int Valorant::BruteForceFNameXorKey(ValorantMemory* memReader)
{
	DWORD DecryptionKey = 0;
	int FNameIndex = 3;
	std::string TargetFName = "ByteProperty";
	int chunkOffset = ((int)(FNameIndex) >> 16);
	WORD nameOffset = FNameIndex;
	uintptr_t FNamePoolChunk;

	if (this->bIsChinese)
		memReader->AddRead(
			(this->ProcessBaseAddress + this->pOffsets->FNamePoolCN + (static_cast<unsigned long long>(chunkOffset) + 2) * 8),
			&FNamePoolChunk,
			sizeof(uintptr_t)
		);
	else
		memReader->AddRead(
			(this->ProcessBaseAddress + this->pOffsets->FNamePool + (static_cast<unsigned long long>(chunkOffset) + 2) * 8),
			&FNamePoolChunk,
			sizeof(uintptr_t)
		);

	memReader->ExecuteBatch(true);

	uintptr_t FNameEntryOffset = FNamePoolChunk + (static_cast<unsigned long long>(4) * nameOffset);
	FNameEntry fNameEntry;
	memReader->AddRead(FNameEntryOffset, &fNameEntry, sizeof(FNameEntry));
	memReader->ExecuteBatch(true);

	uint16 dwStrLength = fNameEntry.NameEntryHeader.dwSTRLen;
	bool bWideStr = fNameEntry.NameEntryHeader.bWideSTR;
	if (bWideStr)
		dwStrLength = *(const uint16*)&fNameEntry.NameEntryHeader & 0xFFFE;

	// xor key is  dword (4 bytes)
	BYTE keyBytes[4] = { 0 };

	// we try to target "ByteProperty" (12 characters)
	for (int byteIndex = 0; byteIndex < 4; byteIndex++)
	{
		for (int testByte = 0; testByte < 256; testByte++)
		{
			bool allMatch = true;
			for (uint16 i = byteIndex; i < dwStrLength && i < TargetFName.length(); i += 4)
			{
				char decrypted = fNameEntry.first_char_encrypted[i] ^ dwStrLength ^ testByte;
				if (decrypted != TargetFName[i])
				{
					allMatch = false;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (allMatch)
			{
				keyBytes[byteIndex] = (BYTE)testByte;
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	// assign bytes
	DecryptionKey = *((DWORD*)keyBytes);

	std::string decryptedName = DecryptName(fNameEntry, DecryptionKey);
	//printf("Brute forced Decryption Key: 0x%08X // real key : 0x%08X\n", DecryptionKey, this->GameWorldData->FNameDecryptionKey);
	//printf("Decrypted Name: %s\n", decryptedName.c_str());

	if (decryptedName == TargetFName)
	{
		spdlog::info("Found: FNameXorState");
		//printf("Successfully found FName decryption key!\n");
		return (int)DecryptionKey;
	}
	else
	{
		spdlog::error("Failed to Find FNameXorState");
		return 0;
	}
}

}

```
   Code:
```
#include <windows.h>
#include <iostream>

__int64 get_fpak_platform_file()
{
	auto delegate = *(__int64*)((uintptr_t)GetModuleHandleA(nullptr) + 0xBFA0C28);
	if (!delegate) return 0;
	return *(__int64*)(delegate + 24);
}

void bypass_pak_signing()
{
	auto delegate = (uint8_t*)((uintptr_t)GetModuleHandleA(nullptr) + 0xC2E98F8);
	DWORD old_protect;
	VirtualProtect(delegate, 0x20, PAGE_READWRITE, &old_protect);
	memset(delegate, 0, 0x20);
	VirtualProtect(delegate, 0x20, old_protect, &old_protect);

	auto fpak = get_fpak_platform_file();
	if (fpak) {
		auto bsigned_ptr = (uint8_t*)(fpak + 48);
		VirtualProtect(bsigned_ptr, 1, PAGE_READWRITE, &old_protect);
		*bsigned_ptr = 0;
		VirtualProtect(bsigned_ptr, 1, old_protect, &old_protect);
	}
}

void mount_custom_pak(const wchar_t* path, int priority)
{
	auto fpak = get_fpak_platform_file();
	if (!fpak) return;

	typedef bool(__fastcall* fn_mount)(__int64, const wchar_t*, int, const wchar_t*, bool, bool);
	auto mount = (fn_mount)((uintptr_t)GetModuleHandleA(nullptr) + 0x283E150);
	mount(fpak, path, priority, nullptr, true, false);
}

bool __stdcall DllMain(void* hinstDLL, std::uint32_t dwReason, void* lpReserved)
{
	if (dwReason != DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH) return true;

	bypass_pak_signing();
	mount_custom_pak(L"C:\\mods\\pakchunk1-Windows_P.pak", 10000);
	mount_custom_pak(L"C:\\mods\\pakchunk2-Windows_P.pak", 10001);
	mount_custom_pak(L"C:\\mods\\pakchunk3-Windows_P.pak", 10002);

	return true;
}
```

![image](https://www.unknowncheats.me/forum/images/smilies/hump.gif)

  Code:
```

 __forceinline uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
 {
     const uint64_t hash =
         0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL *
         (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
     const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
     uint64_t val = state[idx];
     const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
     const uint32_t mod7 = (uint32_t)(idx) % 7;

     if (mod7 == 0) {
         val = val - (2ULL * hi - 1);
     }
     else if (mod7 == 1) {
         uint64_t v = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx) ^ val;
         val = (v >> 1) ^ (((v >> 1) ^ (2 * v)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
     }
     else if (mod7 == 2) {
         uint64_t v = val;
         v = (v >> 1) ^ (((v >> 1) ^ (2 * v)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
         v = (v >> 2) ^ (((v >> 2) ^ (4 * v)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL);
         v = (v >> 4) ^ (((v >> 4) ^ (16 * v)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL);
         v = (v >> 8) ^ (((v >> 8) ^ (v << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL);
         val = (uint32_t)(hi + idx) + _rotr64(v, 32);
     }
     else if (mod7 == 3) {
         val = (val >> 1) ^ ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + idx) ^ (((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
     }
     else if (mod7 == 4) {
         uint64_t v = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx) ^ val;
         uint8_t l = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
         uint8_t r = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) / 0x3F)
             - ((uint8_t)hi + (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
         val = (v << l) | (v >> r);
     }
     else if (mod7 == 5) {
         uint64_t v = (val >> 1) ^ (((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
         val = (uint32_t)(hi + idx) + v;
     }
     else if (mod7 == 6) {
         uint64_t v = val;
         v = (v >> 2) ^ (((v >> 2) ^ (4 * v)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL);
         v = (v >> 4) ^ (((v >> 4) ^ (16 * v)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL);
         v = (v >> 8) ^ (((v >> 8) ^ (v << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL);
         val = _rotr64(v, 32);
     }

     return val ^ key;
 }
```

 __forceinline uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
 {
 const uint64_t hash =
 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL *
 (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
 const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
 uint64_t val = state[idx];
 const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
 const uint32_t mod7 = (uint32_t)(idx) % 7;

 if (mod7 == 0) {
 val = val - (2ULL * hi - 1);
 }
 else if (mod7 == 1) {
 uint64_t v = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx) ^ val;
 val = (v >> 1) ^ (((v >> 1) ^ (2 * v)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
 }
 else if (mod7 == 2) {
 uint64_t v = val;
 v = (v >> 1) ^ (((v >> 1) ^ (2 * v)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
 v = (v >> 2) ^ (((v >> 2) ^ (4 * v)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL);
 v = (v >> 4) ^ (((v >> 4) ^ (16 * v)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL);
 v = (v >> 8) ^ (((v >> 8) ^ (v << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL);
 val = (uint32_t)(hi + idx) + _rotr64(v, 32);
 }
 else if (mod7 == 3) {
 val = (val >> 1) ^ ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + idx) ^ (((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
 }
 else if (mod7 == 4) {
 uint64_t v = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx) ^ val;
 uint8_t l = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
 uint8_t r = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) / 0x3F)
 - ((uint8_t)hi + (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
 val = (v << l) | (v >> r);
 }
 else if (mod7 == 5) {
 uint64_t v = (val >> 1) ^ (((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
 val = (uint32_t)(hi + idx) + v;
 }
 else if (mod7 == 6) {
 uint64_t v = val;
 v = (v >> 2) ^ (((v >> 2) ^ (4 * v)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL);
 v = (v >> 4) ^ (((v >> 4) ^ (16 * v)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL);
 v = (v >> 8) ^ (((v >> 8) ^ (v << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL);
 val = _rotr64(v, 32);
 }

 return val ^ key;
 }

    __forceinline uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
    {
        const uint64_t hash =
            0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL *
            (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
        const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
        uint64_t val = state[idx];
        const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
        const uint32_t mod7 = (uint32_t)(idx) % 7;

        if (mod7 == 0) {
            val = val - (2ULL * hi - 1);
        }
        else if (mod7 == 1) {
            uint64_t v = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx) ^ val;
            val = (v >> 1) ^ (((v >> 1) ^ (2 * v)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
        }
        else if (mod7 == 2) {
            uint64_t v = val;
            v = (v >> 1) ^ (((v >> 1) ^ (2 * v)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
            v = (v >> 2) ^ (((v >> 2) ^ (4 * v)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL);
            v = (v >> 4) ^ (((v >> 4) ^ (16 * v)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL);
            v = (v >> 8) ^ (((v >> 8) ^ (v << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL);
            val = (uint32_t)(hi + idx) + _rotr64(v, 32);
        }
        else if (mod7 == 3) {
            val = (val >> 1) ^ ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + idx) ^ (((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
        }
        else if (mod7 == 4) {
            uint64_t v = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx) ^ val;
            uint8_t l = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
            uint8_t r = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) / 0x3F)
                - ((uint8_t)hi + (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
            val = (v << l) | (v >> r);
        }
        else if (mod7 == 5) {
            uint64_t v = (val >> 1) ^ (((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
            val = (uint32_t)(hi + idx) + v;
        }
        else if (mod7 == 6) {
            uint64_t v = val;
            v = (v >> 2) ^ (((v >> 2) ^ (4 * v)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL);
            v = (v >> 4) ^ (((v >> 4) ^ (16 * v)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL);
            v = (v >> 8) ^ (((v >> 8) ^ (v << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL);
            val = _rotr64(v, 32);
        }

        return val ^ key;
    }
```

static bool ReadCamera(bool verbose = false)
{
    auto IsValidUWorld = [](ULONGLONG uw) -> bool {
        if (!IsGameHeap(uw)) return false;
        ULONGLONG lvl = Read<ULONGLONG>(uw + 0x38); // PersistentLevel
        if (!IsGameHeap(lvl)) return false;
        ULONGLONG arr = Read<ULONGLONG>(lvl + 0xA0);
        if (!IsGameHeap(arr)) return false;
        ULONGLONG diff = (arr > lvl) ? (arr - lvl) : (lvl - arr);
        if (diff > 0x200000000ULL) return false;
        int cnt = Read<int>(lvl + 0xA8);
        return cnt >= 2 && cnt < 8192;
    };

    static bool  s_gworldScanned = false;
    static ULONGLONG s_uworld   = 0;

    ULONGLONG uworld = Read<ULONGLONG>(g_Base + offsets::gworld);
    if (!IsValidUWorld(uworld)) uworld = s_uworld; // fall back to cached

    if (!IsValidUWorld(uworld)) {
        s_uworld = 0; uworld = 0;
        ConLog("[*] Scanning for UWorld (best actor count)...\n");

        ULONGLONG bestWorld = 0; int bestCnt = 0; std::ptrdiff_t bestOff = 0;
        for (ULONGLONG addr = g_Base + 0x8000000; addr < g_Base + 0x14000000; addr += 8) {
            ULONGLONG c = Read<ULONGLONG>(addr);
            if (!IsValidUWorld(c)) continue;
            ULONGLONG lvl = Read<ULONGLONG>(c + 0x38);
            int cnt = Read<int>(lvl + 0xA8);
            if (cnt > bestCnt) { bestCnt = cnt; bestWorld = c; bestOff = (std::ptrdiff_t)(addr - g_Base); }
        }
        if (!bestWorld) {
            wsprintfA(g_Status, "[-] UWorld not found"); ConLog("[-] UWorld scan failed\n");
            s_gworldScanned = true; return false;
        }
        uworld = bestWorld; offsets::gworld = bestOff;
        s_uworld = uworld; s_gworldScanned = true;
        ULONGLONG lvl2 = Read<ULONGLONG>(uworld + 0x38);
        ConLog("[+] UWorld=0x%llX  off=0x%llX  Level=0x%llX  actors=%d\n",
            uworld, (ULONGLONG)bestOff, lvl2, bestCnt);
    }
    if (verbose) ConLog("[DBG] UWorld=0x%llX\n", uworld);

    ULONGLONG level = Read<ULONGLONG>(uworld + offsets::persistent_level); // +0x38
    if (verbose) ConLog("[DBG] UWorld=0x%llX  Level=0x%llX\n", uworld, level);

    LocalContext lc{};
    static ULONGLONG s_cachedPC = 0;

    auto FindPC = [&]() -> bool {

        // === PATH 1: ViewportClient chain (unencrypted in Valorant) ===
        // UWorld+0x118 -> UGameViewportClient -> try offsets for ULocalPlayer ptr
        {
            ULONGLONG vc = Read<ULONGLONG>(uworld + offsets::viewport_client); // +0x118
            if (IsGameHeap(vc)) {
                // task.txt: LocalPlayer=0x40. Try common offsets for LP ptr on viewport client.
                static const std::ptrdiff_t lpTries[] = { 0x40, 0x78, 0x80, 0x88, 0x90 };
                for (auto lpOff : lpTries) {
                    ULONGLONG lp = Read<ULONGLONG>(vc + lpOff);
                    if (!IsGameHeap(lp)) continue;
                    ULONGLONG pc = Read<ULONGLONG>(lp + offsets::player_controller); // +0x38
                    if (!IsGameHeap(pc)) continue;
                    ULONGLONG cm = Read<ULONGLONG>(pc + offsets::player_camera_manager); // +0x520
                    if (!IsGameHeap(cm)) continue;
                    ULONGLONG pawn = Read<ULONGLONG>(pc + offsets::acknowledge_pawn); // +0x510
                    lc.Controller = pc;
                    lc.Pawn = IsGameHeap(pawn) ? pawn : Read<ULONGLONG>(pc + offsets::local_player_pawn);
                    lc.ControlRotation = Read<FVector>(pc + offsets::control_rotation);
                    s_cachedPC = pc;
                    ConLog("[+] PC via VC+0x%X: vc=0x%llX lp=0x%llX pc=0x%llX pawn=0x%llX\n",
                        (int)lpOff, vc, lp, pc, lc.Pawn);
                    return true;
                }
                ConLog("[DBG] VC chain: vc=0x%llX � no valid LP found\n", vc);
            } else {
                ConLog("[DBG] VC invalid: UWorld+0x118=0x%llX\n", vc);
            }
        }

        if (IsGameHeap(s_cachedPC)) {
            ULONGLONG cm = Read<ULONGLONG>(s_cachedPC + offsets::player_camera_manager); // +0x520
            if (IsGameHeap(cm)) {
                lc.Controller = s_cachedPC;
                lc.Pawn = Read<ULONGLONG>(s_cachedPC + offsets::acknowledge_pawn);
                if (!IsGameHeap(lc.Pawn))
                    lc.Pawn = Read<ULONGLONG>(s_cachedPC + offsets::local_player_pawn);
                lc.ControlRotation = Read<FVector>(s_cachedPC + offsets::control_rotation);
                return true;
            }
            s_cachedPC = 0;
        }

        ULONGLONG lvl2   = Read<ULONGLONG>(uworld + offsets::persistent_level);
        ULONGLONG arrPtr = IsGameHeap(lvl2) ? Read<ULONGLONG>(lvl2 + offsets::actor_array) : 0;
        int count        = IsGameHeap(lvl2) ? Read<int>(lvl2 + offsets::actors_count) : 0;
        if (!IsGameHeap(arrPtr) || count <= 0 || count > 8192) return false;

        if (verbose) ConLog("[DBG] Scanning %d actors for PC...\n", count);
        int cmHits = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            ULONGLONG actor = Read<ULONGLONG>(arrPtr + i * 8);
            if (!IsGameHeap(actor)) continue;

            ULONGLONG scanCM = Read<ULONGLONG>(actor + offsets::camera_manager); // +0x540
            if (!IsGameHeap(scanCM)) continue;
            ULONGLONG realCM = Read<ULONGLONG>(actor + offsets::player_camera_manager); // +0x520
            if (!IsGameHeap(realCM)) continue;
            cmHits++;
            if (verbose && cmHits <= 10)
                ConLog("[DBG]  actor[%d]=0x%llX  scanCM=0x%llX  realCM=0x%llX\n", i, actor, scanCM, realCM);
            lc.Controller = actor;
            lc.Pawn = Read<ULONGLONG>(actor + offsets::acknowledge_pawn);
            if (!IsGameHeap(lc.Pawn))
                lc.Pawn = Read<ULONGLONG>(actor + offsets::local_player_pawn);
            lc.ControlRotation = Read<FVector>(actor + offsets::control_rotation);
            s_cachedPC = actor;
            if (verbose) ConLog("[+] PC via actor scan: actor[%d]=0x%llX  realCM=0x%llX  pawn=0x%llX\n",
                i, actor, realCM, lc.Pawn);
            return true;
        }
        if (verbose) ConLog("[DBG] No PC found � cmHits=%d\n", cmHits);
        return false;
    };

    if (!FindPC()) {
        wsprintfA(g_Status, "[-] No PlayerController found");
        return false;
    }

    FVector camPos = {};
    FVector camRot = {};
    float   camFOV = 103.f;

    ULONGLONG cm = Read<ULONGLONG>(lc.Controller + offsets::player_camera_manager); // +0x520
    if (!IsPtr(cm)) {
        wsprintfA(g_Status, "[-] No CameraManager");
        if (verbose) ConLog("[DBG] CM invalid  PC=0x%llX  off=0x%X  val=0x%llX\n",
            lc.Controller, (int)offsets::camera_manager,
            Read<ULONGLONG>(lc.Controller + offsets::camera_manager));
        return false;
    }
    if (verbose) ConLog("[DBG] CM=0x%llX\n", cm);

    FMinimalViewInfo vi = Read<FMinimalViewInfo>(cm + offsets::ViewInfo);

    // Valorant encrypts APlayerCameraManager contents � ViewInfo will be garbage.
    // Use ControlRotation from PC (unencrypted) for rotation.
    // Use ViewInfo only if it looks valid (some builds/patches leave it unencrypted).
    camRot = Read<FVector>(lc.Controller + offsets::control_rotation); // +0x4E0 (unencrypted)

    // Try ViewInfo for rotation override if it looks valid
    if (std::isfinite((float)vi.Rotation.X) && std::isfinite((float)vi.Rotation.Y) &&
        fabsf((float)vi.Rotation.X) <= 90.f && fabsf((float)vi.Rotation.Y) <= 180.f &&
        (fabsf((float)vi.Rotation.X) > 0.01f || fabsf((float)vi.Rotation.Y) > 0.01f)) {
        camRot = vi.Rotation;
        if (verbose) ConLog("[DBG] Using ViewInfo rotation\n");
    }

    // FOV: try ViewInfo first, fall back to hardcoded Valorant default
    camFOV = (std::isfinite(vi.FOV) && vi.FOV >= 50.f && vi.FOV <= 170.f) ? vi.FOV : 103.f;

    if (verbose) ConLog("[DBG] ViewInfo: rot=(%.1f,%.1f,%.1f) fov=%.1f loc=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)\n",
        (float)vi.Rotation.X, (float)vi.Rotation.Y, (float)vi.Rotation.Z, vi.FOV,
        (float)vi.Location.X, (float)vi.Location.Y, (float)vi.Location.Z);

    // ---- Get local pawn from ViewInfo location (camera pos = pawn head) ----
    // ViewInfo.Location IS the camera position when in first person.
    // Use it directly for W2S. Also find the local pawn actor by scanning.
    camPos = FVector(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    {
        ULONGLONG lvl2    = Read<ULONGLONG>(uworld + offsets::persistent_level);
        ULONGLONG arrPtr2 = IsGameHeap(lvl2) ? Read<ULONGLONG>(lvl2 + offsets::actor_array) : 0;
        int count2        = IsGameHeap(lvl2) ? Read<int>(lvl2 + offsets::actors_count) : 0;
        if (IsGameHeap(arrPtr2) && count2 > 0) {
            for (int i = 0; i < count2 && !IsGameHeap(lc.Pawn); i++) {
                ULONGLONG actor = Read<ULONGLONG>(arrPtr2 + i * 8);
                if (!IsGameHeap(actor) || actor == lc.Controller) continue;
                ULONGLONG mesh = Read<ULONGLONG>(actor + offsets::mesh);
                if (!IsGameHeap(mesh)) continue;
                ULONGLONG dh = Read<ULONGLONG>(actor + offsets::damage_handler);
                if (!IsGameHeap(dh)) continue;
                float hp = Read<float>(dh + offsets::health);
                if (!std::isfinite(hp) || hp < 1.f || hp > 325.f) continue;
                // Get root position for camera pos
                ULONGLONG root = Read<ULONGLONG>(actor + offsets::root_component);
                FVector rootPos = IsGameHeap(root) ? Read<FVector>(root + offsets::root_position) : FVector(0.0,0.0,0.0);
                if (!std::isfinite((float)rootPos.X) || (fabsf((float)rootPos.X)<0.1f && fabsf((float)rootPos.Y)<0.1f))
                    rootPos = GetEntityBone(mesh, 8);
                if (!std::isfinite((float)rootPos.X) || fabsf((float)rootPos.X) < 0.1f) continue;
                lc.Pawn = actor;
                camPos  = rootPos;
                if (verbose) ConLog("[DBG] LocalPawn=actor[%d]=0x%llX hp=%.0f pos=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)\n",
                    i, actor, hp, (float)rootPos.X, (float)rootPos.Y, (float)rootPos.Z);
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    if (verbose) ConLog("[DBG] Cam: rot=(%.1f,%.1f,%.1f) fov=%.1f pos=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) pawn=0x%llX\n",
        (float)camRot.X, (float)camRot.Y, (float)camRot.Z, camFOV, (float)camPos.X, (float)camPos.Y, (float)camPos.Z, lc.Pawn);

    g_PC        = lc.Controller;
    g_LocalPawn = lc.Pawn;
    g_PlayerController = lc.Controller;
    g_CamPos = camPos;
    g_CamRot = camRot;
    g_CamFOV = camFOV;
    g_ViewInfo.Location = camPos;
    g_ViewInfo.Rotation = camRot;
    g_ViewInfo.FOV      = camFOV;

    if (verbose) {
        ConLog("[DBG] Final camera: controller=0x%llX pawn=0x%llX pos=(%.1f,%.1f,%.1f) rot=(%.1f,%.1f,%.1f) fov=%.1f\n",
            lc.Controller, lc.Pawn,
            (float)camPos.X, (float)camPos.Y, (float)camPos.Z,
            (float)camRot.X, (float)camRot.Y, (float)camRot.Z,
            camFOV);
    }

    wsprintfA(g_Status, "[+] Cam OK  FOV=%.0f  Loc=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)", camFOV, (float)camPos.X, (float)camPos.Y, (float)camPos.Z);
    return true;
}

static bool ReadViewMatrix(float out[16], bool verbose = false) {
    if (!ReadCamera(verbose)) return false;

    RotMatrix tmp = MakeRotMatrix(g_ViewInfo.Rotation);
    FVector loc = g_ViewInfo.Location;
    // axis vectors from rotation matrix rows
    FVector axX(tmp.m[0][0], tmp.m[0][1], tmp.m[0][2]);
    FVector axY(tmp.m[1][0], tmp.m[1][1], tmp.m[1][2]);
    FVector axZ(tmp.m[2][0], tmp.m[2][1], tmp.m[2][2]);
    auto dot = [](FVector a, FVector b){ return a.X*b.X + a.Y*b.Y + a.Z*b.Z; };

    // Row-major view matrix (same order used in ProjectWorldToScreen)
    out[0]=(float)axY.X;  out[1]=(float)axY.Y;  out[2]=(float)axY.Z;  out[3]=(float)-dot(axY,loc);
    out[4]=(float)axZ.X;  out[5]=(float)axZ.Y;  out[6]=(float)axZ.Z;  out[7]=(float)-dot(axZ,loc);
    out[8]=(float)axX.X;  out[9]=(float)axX.Y;  out[10]=(float)axX.Z; out[11]=(float)-dot(axX,loc);
    out[12]=0.f;   out[13]=0.f;   out[14]=0.f;   out[15]=1.f;
    return true;
}

#pragma once
#include <cmath>
#include "Structs.h"

namespace GameMath
{

    static bool WorldToScreenVM(
        const FVector& world,
        const float m[16],
        float sw, float sh,
        FVector2D& out)
    {
        float x = m[0]*(float)world.X + m[4]*(float)world.Y + m[8] *(float)world.Z + m[12];
        float y = m[1]*(float)world.X + m[5]*(float)world.Y + m[9] *(float)world.Z + m[13];
        float w = m[3]*(float)world.X + m[7]*(float)world.Y + m[11]*(float)world.Z + m[15];

        if (!std::isfinite(x) || !std::isfinite(y) || !std::isfinite(w)) return false;
        if (w <= 0.001f) return false;

        float invW = 1.f / w;
        float sx = ( x * invW + 1.f) * 0.5f * sw;
        float sy = (-y * invW + 1.f) * 0.5f * sh;

        if (!std::isfinite(sx) || !std::isfinite(sy)) return false;
        if (sx < -sw || sx > sw*2.f || sy < -sh || sy > sh*2.f) return false;

        out.X = sx;
        out.Y = sy;
        return true;
    }

    static bool WorldToScreenView(
        const FVector& world,
        const float m[16],
        float sw, float sh,
        FVector2D& out,
        float fovDeg = 103.f)
    {
        float cx = m[0]*(float)world.X + m[1]*(float)world.Y + m[2] *(float)world.Z + m[3];
        float cy = m[4]*(float)world.X + m[5]*(float)world.Y + m[6] *(float)world.Z + m[7];
        float cz = m[8]*(float)world.X + m[9]*(float)world.Y + m[10]*(float)world.Z + m[11];

        if (!std::isfinite(cx)||!std::isfinite(cy)||!std::isfinite(cz)) return false;
        if (cz <= 0.01f) return false;

        float fovRad = fovDeg * 3.14159265f / 180.f;
        float f      = 1.f / tanf(fovRad * 0.5f);
        float aspect = sw / sh;

        float ndcX = (cx / cz) * f / aspect;
        float ndcY = (cy / cz) * f;
        float sx = ( ndcX + 1.f) * 0.5f * sw;
        float sy = (-ndcY + 1.f) * 0.5f * sh;

        if (!std::isfinite(sx)||!std::isfinite(sy)) return false;
        if (sx < -sw || sx > sw*2.f || sy < -sh || sy > sh*2.f) return false;

        out.X = sx;
        out.Y = sy;
        return true;
    }

    // Try VP matrix first, then view matrix fallback
    static bool WorldToScreen(
        const FVector& world,
        const float matrix[16],
        float sw, float sh,
        FVector2D& out,
        float fovDeg = 103.f)
    {
        if (WorldToScreenVM(world, matrix, sw, sh, out)) return true;
        return WorldToScreenView(world, matrix, sw, sh, out, fovDeg);
    }
}

> static bool ReadCamera(bool verbose = false)
> {
>     auto IsValidUWorld = [](ULONGLONG uw) -> bool {
>         if (!IsGameHeap(uw)) return false;
>         ULONGLONG lvl = Read<ULONGLONG>(uw + 0x38); // PersistentLevel
>         if (!IsGameHeap(lvl)) return false;
>         ULONGLONG arr = Read<ULONGLONG>(lvl + 0xA0);
>         if (!IsGameHeap(arr)) return false;
>         ULONGLONG diff = (arr > lvl) ? (arr - lvl) : (lvl - arr);
>         if (diff > 0x200000000ULL) return false;
>         int cnt = Read<int>(lvl + 0xA8);
>         return cnt >= 2 && cnt < 8192;
>     };
>
>     static bool  s_gworldScanned = false;
>     static ULONGLONG s_uworld   = 0;
>
>     ULONGLONG uworld = Read<ULONGLONG>(g_Base + offsets::gworld);
>     if (!IsValidUWorld(uworld)) uworld = s_uworld; // fall back to cached
>
>     if (!IsValidUWorld(uworld)) {
>         s_uworld = 0; uworld = 0;
>         ConLog("[*] Scanning for UWorld (best actor count)...\n");
>
>         ULONGLONG bestWorld = 0; int bestCnt = 0; std::ptrdiff_t bestOff = 0;
>         for (ULONGLONG addr = g_Base + 0x8000000; addr < g_Base + 0x14000000; addr += 8) {
>             ULONGLONG c = Read<ULONGLONG>(addr);
>             if (!IsValidUWorld(c)) continue;
>             ULONGLONG lvl = Read<ULONGLONG>(c + 0x38);
>             int cnt = Read<int>(lvl + 0xA8);
>             if (cnt > bestCnt) { bestCnt = cnt; bestWorld = c; bestOff = (std::ptrdiff_t)(addr - g_Base); }
>         }
>         if (!bestWorld) {
>             wsprintfA(g_Status, "[-] UWorld not found"); ConLog("[-] UWorld scan failed\n");
>             s_gworldScanned = true; return false;
>         }
>         uworld = bestWorld; offsets::gworld = bestOff;
>         s_uworld = uworld; s_gworldScanned = true;
>         ULONGLONG lvl2 = Read<ULONGLONG>(uworld + 0x38);
>         ConLog("[+] UWorld=0x%llX  off=0x%llX  Level=0x%llX  actors=%d\n",
>             uworld, (ULONGLONG)bestOff, lvl2, bestCnt);
>     }
>     if (verbose) ConLog("[DBG] UWorld=0x%llX\n", uworld);
>
>     ULONGLONG level = Read<ULONGLONG>(uworld + offsets::persistent_level); // +0x38
>     if (verbose) ConLog("[DBG] UWorld=0x%llX  Level=0x%llX\n", uworld, level);
>
>     LocalContext lc{};

>     auto FindPC = [&]() -> bool {
>
>         // === PATH 1: ViewportClient chain (unencrypted in Valorant) ===

>         {

>                 for (auto lpOff : lpTries) {

>
>         if (IsGameHeap(s_cachedPC)) {

>

>         (float)vi.Rotation.X, (float)vi.Rotation.Y, (float)vi.Rotation.Z, vi.FOV,
>         (float)vi.Location.X, (float)vi.Location.Y, (float)vi.Location.Z);

> static bool ReadViewMatrix(float out[16], bool verbose = false) {
>     if (!ReadCamera(verbose)) return false;
>
>     RotMatrix tmp = MakeRotMatrix(g_ViewInfo.Rotation);
>     FVector loc = g_ViewInfo.Location;
>     // axis vectors from rotation matrix rows
>     FVector axX(tmp.m[0][0], tmp.m[0][1], tmp.m[0][2]);
>     FVector axY(tmp.m[1][0], tmp.m[1][1], tmp.m[1][2]);
>     FVector axZ(tmp.m[2][0], tmp.m[2][1], tmp.m[2][2]);
>     auto dot = [](FVector a, FVector b){ return a.X*b.X + a.Y*b.Y + a.Z*b.Z; };
>
>     // Row-major view matrix (same order used in ProjectWorldToScreen)
>     out[0]=(float)axY.X;  out[1]=(float)axY.Y;  out[2]=(float)axY.Z;  out[3]=(float)-dot(axY,loc);
>     out[4]=(float)axZ.X;  out[5]=(float)axZ.Y;  out[6]=(float)axZ.Z;  out[7]=(float)-dot(axZ,loc);
>     out[8]=(float)axX.X;  out[9]=(float)axX.Y;  out[10]=(float)axX.Z; out[11]=(float)-dot(axX,loc);
>     out[12]=0.f;   out[13]=0.f;   out[14]=0.f;   out[15]=1.f;
>     return true;
> }
>

> #pragma once
> #include <cmath>
> #include "Structs.h"
>
> namespace GameMath
> {
>
>     static bool WorldToScreenVM(
>         const FVector& world,
>         const float m[16],
>         float sw, float sh,
>         FVector2D& out)
>     {
>         float x = m[0]*(float)world.X + m[4]*(float)world.Y + m[8] *(float)world.Z + m[12];
>         float y = m[1]*(float)world.X + m[5]*(float)world.Y + m[9] *(float)world.Z + m[13];
>         float w = m[3]*(float)world.X + m[7]*(float)world.Y + m[11]*(float)world.Z + m[15];
>
>         if (!std::isfinite(x) || !std::isfinite(y) || !std::isfinite(w)) return false;
>         if (w <= 0.001f) return false;
>
>         float invW = 1.f / w;
>         float sx = ( x * invW + 1.f) * 0.5f * sw;
>         float sy = (-y * invW + 1.f) * 0.5f * sh;
>
>         if (!std::isfinite(sx) || !std::isfinite(sy)) return false;
>         if (sx < -sw || sx > sw*2.f || sy < -sh || sy > sh*2.f) return false;
>
>         out.X = sx;
>         out.Y = sy;
>         return true;
>     }
>
>     static bool WorldToScreenView(
>         const FVector& world,
>         const float m[16],
>         float sw, float sh,
>         FVector2D& out,
>         float fovDeg = 103.f)
>     {
>         float cx = m[0]*(float)world.X + m[1]*(float)world.Y + m[2] *(float)world.Z + m[3];
>         float cy = m[4]*(float)world.X + m[5]*(float)world.Y + m[6] *(float)world.Z + m[7];
>         float cz = m[8]*(float)world.X + m[9]*(float)world.Y + m[10]*(float)world.Z + m[11];
>
>         if (!std::isfinite(cx)||!std::isfinite(cy)||!std::isfinite(cz)) return false;
>         if (cz <= 0.01f) return false;
>
>         float fovRad = fovDeg * 3.14159265f / 180.f;
>         float f      = 1.f / tanf(fovRad * 0.5f);
>         float aspect = sw / sh;
>
>         float ndcX = (cx / cz) * f / aspect;
>         float ndcY = (cy / cz) * f;
>         float sx = ( ndcX + 1.f) * 0.5f * sw;
>         float sy = (-ndcY + 1.f) * 0.5f * sh;
>
>         if (!std::isfinite(sx)||!std::isfinite(sy)) return false;
>         if (sx < -sw || sx > sw*2.f || sy < -sh || sy > sh*2.f) return false;
>
>         out.X = sx;
>         out.Y = sy;
>         return true;
>     }
>
>     // Try VP matrix first, then view matrix fallback
>     static bool WorldToScreen(
>         const FVector& world,
>         const float matrix[16],
>         float sw, float sh,
>         FVector2D& out,
>         float fovDeg = 103.f)
>     {
>         if (WorldToScreenVM(world, matrix, sw, sh, out)) return true;
>         return WorldToScreenView(world, matrix, sw, sh, out, fovDeg);
>     }
> }
>

std::uint64_t c_decryption::decrypt_xor_keys( const uint32_t key , const uint64_t* state ) {
    const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * ( key ^ ( ( key ^ ( key >> 15 ) ) >> 12 ) ^ ( key << 25 ) );
    const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state [ idx ];
    const uint32_t hi = ( uint32_t ) ( hash >> 32 );
    const uint32_t mod7 = ( uint32_t ) ( idx ) % 7;

    if ( mod7 == 0 ) {
        val = val + ( 2ULL * hi - 1 );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 1 ) {
        uint64_t step1 = ( ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * val ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL ) );
        uint64_t v16 = step1 >> 2;
        uint64_t v17 = v16 ^ ( ( v16 ^ ( 4 * step1 ) ) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL );
        uint64_t v18 = ( v17 >> 4 ) ^ ( ( ( v17 >> 4 ) ^ ( 16 * v17 ) ) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL );
        uint64_t rotr_val = ( v18 >> 8 ) ^ ( ( ( v18 >> 8 ) ^ ( v18 << 8 ) ) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL );
        val = ~( uint64_t ) ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx ) ^ _rotr64( rotr_val , 32 );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 2 ) {
        val = ~val - ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 3 ) {
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + 2 * ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        val = ~( ( val >> r ) | ( val << l ) );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 4 ) {
        val = ~( uint64_t ) ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx ) ^ ( val - ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx ) );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 5 ) {
        uint64_t temp = ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx ) + val;
        val = ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * temp ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 6 ) {
        val = ~( val - ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx ) );
    }

    return val ^ key;
}

      else if (mod7 == 4) {
          uint64_t v = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx) ^ val;
          uint8_t l = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
          uint8_t r = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) / 0x3F)
              - ((uint8_t)hi + (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
          val = (v << l) | (v >> r);
      }
      else if (mod7 == 5) {
          uint64_t v = (val >> 1) ^ (((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
          val = (uint32_t)(hi + idx) + v;
      }
      else if (mod7 == 6) {
          uint64_t v = val;
          v = (v >> 2) ^ (((v >> 2) ^ (4 * v)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL);
          v = (v >> 4) ^ (((v >> 4) ^ (16 * v)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL);
          v = (v >> 8) ^ (((v >> 8) ^ (v << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL);
          val = _rotr64(v, 32);
      }

      return val ^ key;
  }
```

   Code:
```
uint32_t GetKey()
{
    if (g_FNameKey)
        return g_FNameKey;

    constexpr const char* plaintext = "ByteProperty";
    constexpr uint16_t len = 12;
    constexpr int32_t index = 3;

    uint64_t base = ValorantContext::GetBaseAddress();
    if (!base) {
        return 0;
    }

    uint64_t poolBase = base + ValorantOffsets::FNamePool();

    uint32_t block  = static_cast<uint32_t>(index >> 16);
    uint32_t offset = static_cast<uint32_t>(index & 0xFFFF);

    uint64_t dataPtr =
        ValorantContext::Read<uint64_t>(poolBase + 0x10 + 8ull * block);
    if (!dataPtr) {
        return 0;
    }
    dataPtr += 4ull * offset;

    uint16_t header   = ValorantContext::Read<uint16_t>(dataPtr + 4);
    uint16_t read_len = header >> 1;

    if ((header & 1u) || read_len != len) {
        return 0;
    }

    char enc[len]{};
    if (!ValorantContext::ReadMemory(dataPtr + 6, enc, len)) {
        return 0;
    }

    uint32_t key = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
        reinterpret_cast<char*>(&key)[i] = enc[i] ^ plaintext[i] ^ len;

    g_FNameKey = key;
    // std::cout << "[DEBUG] FName Key resolved: " << std::hex << key << std::dec << std::endl;
    return key;
}
```

> **chuxia:**
> Originally Posted by chuxia   I have now decrypted GName and can start iterating through Actors, but I don't have a good method to filter enemy and friendly players and practice bots. I wonder if anyone has a relatively simple way to filter actors.

 uint32_t AActor::GetType()
 {
 return *(int32_t*)((uint8_t*)this + offset::ObjID);
 }

 uint32_t Type = Actor->GetType();
 if (!Type)
 continue;

 string Gname = Actor->GetName();
 if (Gname.empty() || Gname == "FXC_Footstep_C" || Gname == "FXC_JumpLand_C" || Gname == "FXC_JumpLaunch_C" || Gname == "Error")
 continue;

 if (Type == 18743553)
 {

 float ActorHP = Actor->GetHP();
 if (ActorHP > 100 || ActorHP <= 0)
 continue;

 uint32_t ObjID = Read<uint32_t>((unsigned long long)Actor + offset::FNameID);

 TempPlayerActors.push_back({ Actor, ObjID });
 }

 inline uint64_t ObjID = 0x38;

 which you can only do with an internal cheat, or you can place a shellcode that does it, in which case you can also do it externally.

 You might also want to take a closer look at ApplySkin, maybe you (or Claude) will find a way to set that up without using ApplySkin.

Hello
 No worries, I don�t mind at all
![image](https://www.unknowncheats.me/forum/images/smilies/smile.gif)

 VALORANT.exe RVA:
 - GWorld
 - FNamePool
 - GObjects

 UE5 offset:
 UWorld: PersistentLevel, OwningGameInstance, GameState
 UGameInstance: LocalPlayers
 ULocalPlayer: PlayerController
 APlayerController: AcknowledgedPawn, PlayerCameraManager
 APlayerCameraManager: CameraCachePrivate + FMinimalViewInfo (Location, Rotation, FOV)
 APawn: PlayerState, Mesh, Mesh1P, Mesh3P, TeamComponent, TeamId (tip: int/double?), DamageHandler, CachedLife,
 CachedShield, bIsVisible, LastRenderTime
 USkeletalMeshComponent: ComponentToWorld, CachedBoneSpaceTransforms, CachedComponentSpaceTransforms, BoneCount
 ULevel: Actors TArray (ptr + count)
 AGameState: PlayerArray
 FUObjectArray: Chunks, Max, Num, FUObjectItem stride
 FNamePool: Blocks offset, FNameEntry encoding

 vgk.sys (shadow CR3 decrypt):
 - VGK_SHADOW_STRUCT RVA
 - VGK_POINTER_KEY RVA
 - VGK_POINTER_STATE RVA
 - VGK_STATE_INDEX RVA
 - CR3 decrypt routine
 - ShadowRegionsDataStructure layout

heres latest state and pool and decrypt_xor_keys

 uintptr_t Uworld = 0xC1AD2A0;
 uintptr_t FnamePool = 0xC34B800;
 uintptr_t FnameState = 0xC536280;

 uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
 {
 const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
 const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
 uint64_t val = state[idx];
 const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
 const uint32_t m7 = (uint32_t)idx % 7;

 auto lfsr1 = [](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
 return (x >> 1) ^ ((x >> 1) ^ (2 * x)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
 };
 auto bitrev_ror32 = [&](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
 uint64_t a = lfsr1(x);
 uint64_t b = (a >> 2) ^ ((a >> 2) ^ (4 * a)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
 uint64_t c = (b >> 4) ^ ((b >> 4) ^ (16 * b)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
 uint64_t d = (c >> 8) ^ ((c >> 8) ^ (c << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
 return _rotr64(d, 32);
 };
 auto rotr63 = [](uint64_t x, uint32_t r) -> uint64_t {
 uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
 return (x >> s) | (x << (64 - s));
 };

 if (m7 == 0) {
 val = bitrev_ror32(lfsr1(bitrev_ror32(val)));
 }
 else if (m7 == 1) {
 val = lfsr1(val ^ ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx));
 }
 else if (m7 == 2) {
 val = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) ^ (val - (uint32_t)(hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx));
 }
 else if (m7 == 3) {
 val ^= (uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx);
 }
 else if (m7 == 4) {
 val = (uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) + lfsr1(val);
 }
 else if (m7 == 5) {
 val = lfsr1(val - (uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx));
 }
 else {
 val = rotr63(val, hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx) - (uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx);
 }

 return val ^ key;
 }

 uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
 {
 const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
 const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
 uint64_t val = state[idx];
 const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
 const uint32_t m7 = (uint32_t)idx % 7;

 auto lfsr1 = [](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
 return (x >> 1) ^ ((x >> 1) ^ (2 * x)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
 };
 auto bitrev_ror32 = [&](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
 uint64_t a = lfsr1(x);
 uint64_t b = (a >> 2) ^ ((a >> 2) ^ (4 * a)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
 uint64_t c = (b >> 4) ^ ((b >> 4) ^ (16 * b)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
 uint64_t d = (c >> 8) ^ ((c >> 8) ^ (c << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
 return _rotr64(d, 32);
 };
 auto rotr63 = [](uint64_t x, uint32_t r) -> uint64_t {
 uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
 return (x >> s) | (x << (64 - s));
 };

 if (m7 == 0) {
 val = bitrev_ror32(lfsr1(bitrev_ror32(val)));
 }
 else if (m7 == 1) {
 val = rotr63(~val, hi + (uint32_t)idx);
 }
 else if (m7 == 2) {
 val = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) ^ (val - (uint32_t)(hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx));
 }
 else if (m7 == 3) {
 val = ~rotr63(val, hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx);
 }
 else if (m7 == 4) {
 val = ~bitrev_ror32(val);
 }
 else if (m7 == 5) {
 val = lfsr1(~val);
 }
 else {
 val = (uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) + bitrev_ror32(val);
 }

 return val ^ key;
 }

> uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
> {
> const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
> const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
> uint64_t val = state[idx];
> const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
> const uint32_t m7 = (uint32_t)idx % 7;
>
> auto lfsr1 = [](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
>     return (x >> 1) ^ ((x >> 1) ^ (2 * x)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
> };
>
> auto bitrev_ror32 = [&](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
>     uint64_t a = lfsr1(x);
>     uint64_t b = (a >> 2) ^ ((a >> 2) ^ (4 * a)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
>     uint64_t c = (b >> 4) ^ ((b >> 4) ^ (16 * b)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
>     uint64_t d = (c >> 8) ^ ((c >> 8) ^ (c << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
>     return _rotr64(d, 32);
> };
>
> auto rotr63 = [](uint64_t x, uint32_t r) -> uint64_t {
>     uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
>     return (x >> s) | (x << (64 - s));
> };
>
> if (m7 == 0) {
>     val = bitrev_ror32(lfsr1(bitrev_ror32(val)));
> }
> else if (m7 == 1) {
>     val = rotr63(~val, hi + (uint32_t)idx);
> }
> else if (m7 == 2) {
>     val = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) ^ (val - (uint32_t)(hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx));
> }
> else if (m7 == 3) {
>     val = ~rotr63(val, hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx);
> }
> else if (m7 == 4) {
>     val = ~bitrev_ror32(val);
> }
> else if (m7 == 5) {
>     val = lfsr1(~val);
> }
> else {
>     val = (uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) + bitrev_ror32(val);
> }
>
> return val ^ key;
> }

![image](https://www.unknowncheats.me/forum/images/smilies/sadwavey.gif)

  Code:
```
struct State {
	uintptr_t keys[7];
};
std::string UE::UObject::Name(uint64_t basee) {
	int key = this->Name();
	auto cached_name = cachedFnames.find(key);
	if (cached_name != cachedFnames.end())
		return cached_name->second;

	uint chunkOffset = (uint)((int)(key) >> 16);
	ushort nameOffset = (ushort)key;

	std::uint64_t namePoolChunk = process.Read<std::uint64_t>(
		base + Offsets::gNames + ((chunkOffset + 2) * 8)
	);
	std::uint64_t entryOffset = namePoolChunk + (ulong)(4 * nameOffset);
	FNameEntry nameEntry = process.Read<FNameEntry>(entryOffset);

	auto name = nameEntry.AnsiName;
	std::uintptr_t nameKey = decrypt_name_key();

	if (nameEntry.Header.Len <= 365) {
		for (std::uint16_t i = 0; i < nameEntry.Header.Len; i++) {
			BYTE b = i & 3;
			name[i] ^= nameEntry.Header.Len ^ *((LPBYTE)&nameKey + b);
		}
	}

	return name;
}
inline auto decrypt_name_key = []() -> uintptr_t {
	const auto keys = process.Read<uintptr_t>(base + 0xC536280 + 0x40);
	const auto state = process.Read<State>(base + 0xC536280);
	const auto name_ptr = decrypt_xor_keys(keys, (uintptr_t*)&state);
	return  process.Read<uintptr_t>(name_ptr);
	};

__forceinline uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
{
	const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
	const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
	uint64_t val = state[idx];
	const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
	const uint32_t m7 = (uint32_t)idx % 7;

	auto lfsr1 = [](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
		return (x >> 1) ^ ((x >> 1) ^ (2 * x)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
		};

	auto bitrev_ror32 = [&](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
		uint64_t a = lfsr1(x);
		uint64_t b = (a >> 2) ^ ((a >> 2) ^ (4 * a)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
		uint64_t c = (b >> 4) ^ ((b >> 4) ^ (16 * b)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
		uint64_t d = (c >> 8) ^ ((c >> 8) ^ (c << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
		return _rotr64(d, 32);
		};

	auto rotr63 = [](uint64_t x, uint32_t r) -> uint64_t {
		uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
		return (x >> s) | (x << (64 - s));
		};

	if (m7 == 0) {
		val = bitrev_ror32(lfsr1(bitrev_ror32(val)));
	}
	else if (m7 == 1) {
		val = rotr63(~val, hi + (uint32_t)idx);
	}
	else if (m7 == 2) {
		val = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) ^ (val - (uint32_t)(hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx));
	}
	else if (m7 == 3) {
		val = ~rotr63(val, hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx);
	}
	else if (m7 == 4) {
		val = ~bitrev_ror32(val);
	}
	else if (m7 == 5) {
		val = lfsr1(~val);
	}
	else {
		val = (uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) + bitrev_ror32(val);
	}

	return val ^ key;
}
```

std::string UE::UObject::Name(uint64_t basee) {
	int key = this->Name();
	auto cached_name = cachedFnames.find(key);
	if (cached_name != cachedFnames.end())
		return cached_name->second;

	uint chunkOffset = (uint)((int)(key) >> 16);
	ushort nameOffset = (ushort)key;

	std::uint64_t namePoolChunk = process.Read<std::uint64_t>(
		base + Offsets::gNames + ((chunkOffset + 2) * 8)
	);
	std::uint64_t entryOffset = namePoolChunk + (ulong)(4 * nameOffset);
	FNameEntry nameEntry = process.Read<FNameEntry>(entryOffset);

	auto name = nameEntry.AnsiName;
	std::uint64_t nameKey = decrypt_name_key();
	std::cout << "NameKey: " << nameKey << "\n";

	if (nameEntry.Header.Len <= 365) {
		for (std::uint16_t i = 0; i < nameEntry.Header.Len; i++) {
			BYTE b = i & 3;
			name[i] ^= nameEntry.Header.Len ^ *((LPBYTE)&nameKey + b);
		}
	}

	return name;
}

__forceinline uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
{
	const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
	const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
	uint64_t val = state[idx];
	const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
	const uint32_t m7 = (uint32_t)idx % 7;

	auto lfsr1 = [](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
		return (x >> 1) ^ ((x >> 1) ^ (2 * x)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
		};

	auto bitrev_ror32 = [&](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
		uint64_t a = lfsr1(x);
		uint64_t b = (a >> 2) ^ ((a >> 2) ^ (4 * a)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
		uint64_t c = (b >> 4) ^ ((b >> 4) ^ (16 * b)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
		uint64_t d = (c >> 8) ^ ((c >> 8) ^ (c << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
		return _rotr64(d, 32);
		};

	auto rotr63 = [](uint64_t x, uint32_t r) -> uint64_t {
		uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
		return (x >> s) | (x << (64 - s));
		};

	if (m7 == 0) {
		val = bitrev_ror32(lfsr1(bitrev_ror32(val)));
	}
	else if (m7 == 1) {
		val = rotr63(~val, hi + (uint32_t)idx);
	}
	else if (m7 == 2) {
		val = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) ^ (val - (uint32_t)(hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx));
	}
	else if (m7 == 3) {
		val = ~rotr63(val, hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx);
	}
	else if (m7 == 4) {
		val = ~bitrev_ror32(val);
	}
	else if (m7 == 5) {
		val = lfsr1(~val);
	}
	else {
		val = (uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) + bitrev_ror32(val);
	}

	return val ^ key;
}
inline auto decrypt_name_key = []() -> uint64_t {
	const auto key = process.Read<uint32_t>(base + 0xC536280 + 0x40);
	std::cout << "key: " << key << "\n";
	const auto state = process.Read<State>(base + 0xC536280);
	std::cout << "state: " << key << "\n";

	return decrypt_xor_keys(key, state.keys);
	};
```

    class u_mesh_component : public u_primitive_component {
    public:
        bool was_recently_rendered( float tung_tung_tung_sahur ) {
            // UPrimitiveComponent::WasRecentlyRendered
            // 40 53 48 83 EC ? 48 8B 81 ? ? ? ? 48 8B D9 0F 29 74 24 ? 0F 28 F1 48 85 C0 75
            auto world = g_process->read<uintptr_t>( current_class + 0xd0 );
            auto delta_time_seconds = g_process->read<float>( world + 0x764 );
            auto time_seconds = g_process->read<double>( world + 0x738 );

            auto last_render_time = g_process->read<float>( current_class + 0x484 ); // BoundsScale + 0x8
            auto time_since = time_seconds - last_render_time;

            auto render_time_threshold = fmaxf( tung_tung_tung_sahur , delta_time_seconds + 0.000099999997f );
            return time_since <= render_time_threshold;
        }
    };
```

   Code:
```
std::string get_fname(int key)
{
	if (!key) return "";

	uint chunkOffset = (uint)((int)(key) >> 16);
	ushort nameOffset = (ushort)key;

	std::uint64_t namePoolChunk = memoryManager.RPM<std::uint64_t>(
		(std::uintptr_t)(memoryManager.base + offsets::fnamepool + ((chunkOffset + 2) * 8)));

	if (!namePoolChunk) return "";

	// stride = 4 (Valorant FNamePool)
	std::uint64_t entryOffset = namePoolChunk + (ulong)(4 * nameOffset);

	FNameEntry nameEntry = memoryManager.RPM<FNameEntry>(entryOffset);

	uint16_t len = nameEntry.Header.Len;
	if (len == 0 || len > 365) return "";

	// decrypt: key = 8 bytes from module base+0x0
	std::uintptr_t nameKey = memoryManager.RPM<uintptr_t>(memoryManager.base + 0x0);
	for (std::uint16_t i = 0; i < len; i++)
	{
		BYTE b = i & 3;
		nameEntry.AnsiName[i] ^= len ^ *((LPBYTE)&nameKey + b);
	}

	return std::string(nameEntry.AnsiName, len);
}
```
