```
std::uint64_t c_decryption::decrypt_xor_keys( const uint32_t key , const uint64_t* state ) {
    const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * ( key ^ ( ( key ^ ( key >> 15 ) ) >> 12 ) ^ ( key << 25 ) );
    const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state [ idx ];
    const uint32_t hi = ( uint32_t ) ( hash >> 32 );
    const uint32_t m7 = ( uint32_t ) idx % 7;

    auto lfsr1 = [ ] ( uint64_t x ) -> uint64_t {
        return ( x >> 1 ) ^ ( ( x >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * x ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
    };

    auto rotr63 = [ ] ( uint64_t x , uint32_t r ) -> uint64_t {
        uint8_t s = ( uint8_t ) ( r % 0x3F ) + 1;
        return ( x >> s ) | ( x << ( 64 - s ) );
    };

    auto rotl63 = [ ] ( uint64_t x , uint32_t r ) -> uint64_t {
        uint8_t s = ( uint8_t ) ( r % 0x3F ) + 1;
        return ( x << s ) | ( x >> ( 64 - s ) );
    };

    if ( m7 == 0 ) {
        val = lfsr1( val + hi - 1 );
    }
    else if ( m7 == 1 || m7 == 3 ) {

    }
    else if ( m7 == 2 ) {
        val ^= ( hi + idx );
    }
    else if ( m7 == 4 ) {
        val = rotl63( ~val , hi + idx );
    }
    else if ( m7 == 5 ) {
        val = rotr63( val + hi + 2 * idx , hi + idx );
    }
    else if ( m7 == 6 ) {
        val = lfsr1( rotr63( val , hi + 2 * idx ) );
    }

    return val ^ key;
}
```

 inline uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
 {
 const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
 const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
 uint64_t val = state[idx];
 const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
 const uint32_t m7 = (uint32_t)idx % 7;

 auto lfsr1 = [](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
 return (x >> 1) ^ ((x >> 1) ^ (2 * x)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
 };

 auto rotr63 = [](uint64_t x, uint32_t r) -> uint64_t {
 uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
 return (x >> s) | (x << (64 - s));
 };

 auto rotl63 = [](uint64_t x, uint32_t r) -> uint64_t {
 uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
 return (x << s) | (x >> (64 - s));
 };

 if (m7 == 0) {
 val = lfsr1(val + hi - 1);
 }
 else if (m7 == 1 || m7 == 3) {

 }
 else if (m7 == 2) {
 val ^= (hi + idx);
 }
 else if (m7 == 4) {
 val = rotl63(~val, hi + idx);
 }
 else if (m7 == 5) {
 val = rotr63(val + hi + 2 * idx, hi + idx);
 }
 else if (m7 == 6) {
 val = lfsr1(rotr63(val, hi + 2 * idx));
 }

 return val ^ key;
 }

namespace decryptuworld {
	typedef          __int64 ll;
	typedef unsigned __int64 ull;
	typedef          char   int8;
	typedef   signed char   sint8;
	typedef unsigned char   uint8;
	typedef          short  int16;
	typedef   signed short  sint16;
	typedef unsigned short  uint16;
	typedef          int    int32;
	typedef   signed int    sint32;
	typedef unsigned int    uint32;
	typedef ll              int64;
	typedef ll              sint64;
	typedef ull             uint64;
	typedef unsigned int uint;

	template<class T> T __ROL__(T value, int count)
	{
		const uint nbits = sizeof(T) * 8;
		if (count > 0)
		{
			count %= nbits;
			T high = value >> (nbits - count);
			if (T(-1) < 0)
				high &= ~((T(-1) << count));
			value <<= count;
			value |= high;
		}
		else
		{
			count = -count % nbits;
			T low = value << (nbits - count);
			value >>= count;
			value |= low;
		}
		return value;
	}

	inline uint8  __ROL1__(uint8  value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint8)value, count); }
	inline uint16 __ROL2__(uint16 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint16)value, count); }
	inline uint32 __ROL4__(uint32 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint32)value, count); }
	inline uint64 __ROL8__(uint64 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint64)value, count); }
	inline uint8  __ROR1__(uint8  value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint8)value, -count); }
	inline uint16 __ROR2__(uint16 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint16)value, -count); }
	inline uint32 __ROR4__(uint32 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint32)value, -count); }
	inline uint64 __ROR8__(uint64 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint64)value, -count); }

	struct State {
		uintptr_t keys[7];
	};

	inline uint64_t rotr63(uint64_t x, uint32_t r) {
		uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
		return (x >> s) | (x << (64 - s));
	}

	inline uint64_t rotl63(uint64_t x, uint32_t r) {
		uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
		return (x << s) | (x >> (64 - s));
	}

	inline uint64_t bitrev64(uint64_t v) {
		uint64_t t = (v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (2 * v)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
		uint64_t t2 = (t >> 2) ^ ((t >> 2) ^ (4 * t)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
		uint64_t t3 = (t2 >> 4) ^ ((t2 >> 4) ^ (16 * t2)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
		return __ROR8__((t3 >> 8) ^ ((t3 >> 8) ^ (t3 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL, 32);
	}

	uint64_t decrypt_gworld_b1(uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state) {
		uint32_t k = key;

		uint64_t v26 = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL *
			(uint64_t)((uint32_t)k ^
				(uint32_t)(((uint32_t)k ^ (uint32_t)((uint64_t)(uint32_t)k >> 15)) >> 12) ^
				(uint32_t)(k << 25));

		uint64_t v27 = v26 % 7;
		uint64_t v28 = state[v27];
		uint32_t v29 = (uint32_t)(v26 >> 32); // HIDWORD
		uint32_t v30 = (uint32_t)(v27 % 7);
		uint64_t v34 = 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;

		if ((uint32_t)v27 == 7 * ((uint32_t)v27 / 7)) {
			v34 = bitrev64(~v28);
			goto LABEL_32;
		}

		if (v30 == 1) {
			uint32_t v45 = v29 + 2 * (uint32_t)v27;
			v34 = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(v29 + (uint32_t)v27)
				+ rotl63(v28,
					63 * (uint8_t)(v45 / 0x3F)
					- ((uint8_t)v29 + 2 * (uint8_t)(uint32_t)v27)
					+ 63);
			v34 = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(v29 + (uint32_t)v27) + rotr63(v28, v45);
			goto LABEL_39;
		}

		if (v30 == 2) {
			uint32_t r = (uint32_t)(v29 + (uint32_t)v27);
			v34 = rotl63(~v28, r);
			goto LABEL_32;
		}

	LABEL_39:
		v34 = v28;

		switch ((uint32_t)v27 % 7) {
		case 3: {
			uint64_t v46 = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(v29 + 2 * (uint32_t)v27) ^ v28;
			v34 = (v46 >> 1) ^ ((v46 >> 1) ^ (2 * v46)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
			break;
		}
		case 4: {
			v34 = ~bitrev64(v28);
			break;
		}
		case 5: {
			uint32_t r = (uint32_t)(uint32_t)(v29 + (uint32_t)v27);
			v34 = rotl63(~v28, r);
			break;
		}
		case 6: {
			v34 = bitrev64(v28);
			break;
		}
		default:
			break;
		}

	LABEL_32:
		uint64_t v35 = v34 ^ (uint64_t)(uint32_t)key;
		return v35;
	}

	uintptr_t decryptWorld() {
		uintptr_t GWORLD_STATE = 0xA7C38C0;
		uintptr_t GWORLD_KEY = GWORLD_STATE + 0x38;

		printf(xorstr("----START DECRYPT GWORLD (NEW)----\n"));

		uint32_t key = data::read_universal<uint32_t>(gamein.Base + GWORLD_KEY);
		printf(xorstr("Key: [0x%x]\n"), key);

		State state = data::read_universal<State>(gamein.Base + GWORLD_STATE);
		for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++)
			printf(xorstr("State[%d]: [0x%llx]\n"), i, state.keys[i]);

		uint64_t ptr_addr = decrypt_gworld_b1(key, state.keys);
		printf(xorstr("Ptr address: [0x%llx]\n"), ptr_addr);

		if (ptr_addr < 0x10000000000ULL || ptr_addr > 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFULL) {
			printf(xorstr("[-] BAD ptr_addr: 0x%llx\n"), ptr_addr);
			return 0;
		}

		uintptr_t uworld = data::read_universal<uintptr_t>(ptr_addr);
		printf(xorstr("UWorld: [0x%llx]\n"), uworld);

		if (uworld < 0x10000000000ULL || uworld > 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFULL) {
			printf(xorstr("[-] BAD UWorld\n"));
			while (true) {
				uworld = data::read_universal<uintptr_t>(ptr_addr);
				if (uworld) {
					printf(xorstr("UWorld: [0x%llx]\n"), uworld);
					return uworld;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		printf(xorstr("----END DECRYPT----\n\n"));
		return uworld;
	}
}

  Code:

```
   Code:
```
    __forceinline uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
    {
        const uint64_t hash =
            0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL *
            (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
        const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
        uint64_t       val = state[idx];
        const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
        const uint32_t i32 = (uint32_t)idx;

        auto swap_pairs = [](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
            return (x >> 1) ^ (((x >> 1) ^ (x << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
            };

        auto bit_reverse = [](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
            x = ((x >> 1) & 0x5555555555555555ULL) | ((x & 0x5555555555555555ULL) << 1);
            x = ((x >> 2) & 0x3333333333333333ULL) | ((x & 0x3333333333333333ULL) << 2);
            x = ((x >> 4) & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0FULL) | ((x & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0FULL) << 4);
            x = ((x >> 8) & 0x00FF00FF00FF00FFULL) | ((x & 0x00FF00FF00FF00FFULL) << 8);
            x = ((x >> 16) & 0x0000FFFF0000FFFFULL) | ((x & 0x0000FFFF0000FFFFULL) << 16);
            return (x >> 32) | (x << 32);
            };

        auto rotl63 = [](uint64_t x, uint32_t r) -> uint64_t {
            uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
            return (x << s) | (x >> (64 - s));
            };

        auto rotr63 = [](uint64_t x, uint32_t r) -> uint64_t {
            uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
            return (x >> s) | (x << (64 - s));
            };

        switch (i32) {
        case 0: val = swap_pairs(val + (hi - 1));                         break;
        case 1: val = val + i32;                                          break;
        case 2: val = bit_reverse(val + (hi + 2 * i32));                  break;
        case 3: val = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + i32) ^ bit_reverse(val); break;
        case 4: val = rotl63(val + (hi + 2 * i32), hi + i32);             break;
        case 5: val = swap_pairs(val) ^ ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + i32);  break;
        case 6: val = rotr63(val - (hi + 2 * i32), hi + i32);             break;
        }

        return val ^ key;
    }
```

std::uint64_t c_decryption::decrypt_xor_keys( const uint32_t key , const uint64_t* state ) {
    const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * ( key ^ ( ( key ^ ( key >> 15 ) ) >> 12 ) ^ ( key << 25 ) );
    const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state [ idx ];
    const uint32_t hi = ( uint32_t ) ( hash >> 32 );
    const uint32_t mod7 = ( uint32_t ) ( idx ) % 7;

    if ( mod7 == 0 ) {
        uint64_t temp = val + hi - 1;
        val = ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * temp ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 1 ) {
        val += ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx ) - ( uint64_t ) ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 2 ) {
        uint64_t temp = val + ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx );
        uint64_t step1 = ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * temp ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
        uint64_t v7 = step1 >> 2;
        uint64_t v8 = v7 ^ ( ( v7 ^ ( 4 * step1 ) ) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL );
        uint64_t v9 = ( v8 >> 4 ) ^ ( ( ( v8 >> 4 ) ^ ( 16 * v8 ) ) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL );
        uint64_t rotr_val = ( v9 >> 8 ) ^ ( ( ( v9 >> 8 ) ^ ( v9 << 8 ) ) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL );
        val = _rotr64( rotr_val , 32 );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 3 ) {
        uint64_t step1 = ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * val ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
        uint64_t v22 = step1 >> 2;
        uint64_t v23 = v22 ^ ( ( v22 ^ ( 4 * step1 ) ) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL );
        uint64_t v24 = ( v23 >> 4 ) ^ ( ( ( v23 >> 4 ) ^ ( 16 * v23 ) ) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL );
        uint64_t rotr_val = ( v24 >> 8 ) ^ ( ( ( v24 >> 8 ) ^ ( v24 << 8 ) ) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL );
        val = ~( uint64_t ) ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx ) ^ _rotr64( rotr_val , 32 );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 4 ) {
        uint64_t temp = val + ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx );
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        val = ( temp << l ) | ( temp >> r );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 5 ) {
        val = ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * val ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL ) ^ ~( uint64_t ) ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 6 ) {
        uint64_t temp = val - ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx );
        uint8_t r = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint8_t l = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        val = ( temp >> r ) | ( temp << l );
    }

    return val ^ key;
}

 ) +
 0x2183995CC620C592ULL
 );

 << std::hex << v11 << std::endl;

 ((mask & key) - (key | ~mask));

 uintptr_t find_pml4_base()
 {
 ShadowRegionsDataStructure Data =
 driver::RKA<ShadowRegionsDataStructure>(Mod::ModBaseVGK + 0x0);

 << std::hex << Data.FreeIndex << std::endl;

 << std::hex << DecClonedCr3 << std::endl;

 {

 Mod::Cr3Context = DecClonedCr3;

 std::cout << "[LOG] Mod::Cr3Context set to: 0x"
 << std::hex << Mod::Cr3Context << std::endl;

 uintptr_t source = Data.FreeIndex << 39;

 std::cout << "[LOG] Calculated PML4 base: 0x"
 << std::hex << source << std::endl;

 return source;
 }

 namespace decryptuworld {
 typedef __int64 ll;

 template<class T> T __ROL__(T value, int count)
 {
 const uint nbits = sizeof(T) * 8;
 if (count > 0)
 {
 count %= nbits;
 T high = value >> (nbits - count);
 if (T(-1) < 0)
 high &= ~((T(-1) << count));
 value <<= count;
 value |= high;
 }
 else
 {
 count = -count % nbits;
 T low = value << (nbits - count);
 value >>= count;
 value |= low;
 }
 return value;
 }

 inline uint8 __ROL1__(uint8 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint8)value, count); }
 inline uint16 __ROL2__(uint16 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint16)value, count); }
 inline uint32 __ROL4__(uint32 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint32)value, count); }
 inline uint64 __ROL8__(uint64 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint64)value, count); }
 inline uint8 __ROR1__(uint8 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint8)value, -count); }
 inline uint16 __ROR2__(uint16 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint16)value, -count); }
 inline uint32 __ROR4__(uint32 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint32)value, -count); }
 inline uint64 __ROR8__(uint64 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint64)value, -count); }

 struct State {
 uintptr_t keys[7];
 };

 inline uint64_t rotr63(uint64_t x, uint32_t r) {
 uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
 return (x >> s) | (x << (64 - s));
 }

 inline uint64_t rotl63(uint64_t x, uint32_t r) {
 uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
 return (x << s) | (x >> (64 - s));
 }

 inline uint64_t bitrev64(uint64_t v) {
 uint64_t t = (v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (2 * v)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
 uint64_t t2 = (t >> 2) ^ ((t >> 2) ^ (4 * t)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
 uint64_t t3 = (t2 >> 4) ^ ((t2 >> 4) ^ (16 * t2)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
 return __ROR8__((t3 >> 8) ^ ((t3 >> 8) ^ (t3 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL, 32);
 }

 uint64_t decrypt_gworld_b1(uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state) {
 uint32_t k = key;

 uint64_t v26 = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL *
 (uint64_t)((uint32_t)k ^
 (uint32_t)(((uint32_t)k ^ (uint32_t)((uint64_t)(uint32_t)k >> 15)) >> 12) ^
 (uint32_t)(k << 25));

 uint64_t v27 = v26 % 7;
 uint64_t v28 = state[v27];
 uint32_t v29 = (uint32_t)(v26 >> 32); // HIDWORD
 uint32_t v30 = (uint32_t)(v27 % 7);
 uint64_t v34 = 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;

 if ((uint32_t)v27 == 7 * ((uint32_t)v27 / 7)) {
 v34 = bitrev64(~v28);
 goto LABEL_32;
 }

 if (v30 == 1) {
 uint32_t v45 = v29 + 2 * (uint32_t)v27;
 v34 = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(v29 + (uint32_t)v27)
 + rotl63(v28,
 63 * (uint8_t)(v45 / 0x3F)
 - ((uint8_t)v29 + 2 * (uint8_t)(uint32_t)v27)
 + 63);
 v34 = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(v29 + (uint32_t)v27) + rotr63(v28, v45);
 goto LABEL_39;
 }

 if (v30 == 2) {
 uint32_t r = (uint32_t)(v29 + (uint32_t)v27);
 v34 = rotl63(~v28, r);
 goto LABEL_32;
 }

 LABEL_39:
 v34 = v28;

 switch ((uint32_t)v27 % 7) {
 case 3: {
 uint64_t v46 = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(v29 + 2 * (uint32_t)v27) ^ v28;
 v34 = (v46 >> 1) ^ ((v46 >> 1) ^ (2 * v46)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
 break;
 }
 case 4: {
 v34 = ~bitrev64(v28);
 break;
 }
 case 5: {
 uint32_t r = (uint32_t)(uint32_t)(v29 + (uint32_t)v27);
 v34 = rotl63(~v28, r);
 break;
 }
 case 6: {
 v34 = bitrev64(v28);
 break;
 }
 default:
 break;
 }

 LABEL_32:
 uint64_t v35 = v34 ^ (uint64_t)(uint32_t)key;
 return v35;
 }

 uintptr_t decryptWorld() {
 uintptr_t GWORLD_STATE = 0xA7C38C0;
 uintptr_t GWORLD_KEY = GWORLD_STATE + 0x38;

 printf(xorstr("----START DECRYPT GWORLD (NEW)----\n"));

 uint32_t key = data::read_universal<uint32_t>(gamein.Base + GWORLD_KEY);
 printf(xorstr("Key: [0x%x]\n"), key);

 State state = data::read_universal<State>(gamein.Base + GWORLD_STATE);
 for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++)
 printf(xorstr("State[%d]: [0x%llx]\n"), i, state.keys[i]);

 uint64_t ptr_addr = decrypt_gworld_b1(key, state.keys);
 printf(xorstr("Ptr address: [0x%llx]\n"), ptr_addr);

 if (ptr_addr < 0x10000000000ULL || ptr_addr > 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFULL) {
 printf(xorstr("[-] BAD ptr_addr: 0x%llx\n"), ptr_addr);
 return 0;
 }

 uintptr_t uworld = data::read_universal<uintptr_t>(ptr_addr);
 printf(xorstr("UWorld: [0x%llx]\n"), uworld);

 if (uworld < 0x10000000000ULL || uworld > 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFULL) {
 printf(xorstr("[-] BAD UWorld\n"));
 while (true) {
 uworld = data::read_universal<uintptr_t>(ptr_addr);
 if (uworld) {
 printf(xorstr("UWorld: [0x%llx]\n"), uworld);
 return uworld;
 }
 }
 return 0;
 }

 printf(xorstr("----END DECRYPT----\n\n"));
 return uworld;
 }
 }

 namespace decryptuworld {
 typedef __int64 ll;
 typedef unsigned __int64 ull;
 typedef char int8;
 typedef signed char sint8;
 typedef unsigned char uint8;
 typedef short int16;
 typedef signed short sint16;
 typedef unsigned short uint16;
 typedef int int32;
 typedef signed int sint32;
 typedef unsigned int uint32;
 typedef ll int64;
 typedef ll sint64;
 typedef ull uint64;
 typedef unsigned int uint;

 template<class T> T __ROL__(T value, int count)
 {
 const uint nbits = sizeof(T) * 8;
 if (count > 0)
 {
 count %= nbits;
 T high = value >> (nbits - count);
 if (T(-1) < 0)
 high &= ~((T(-1) << count));
 value <<= count;
 value |= high;
 }
 else
 {
 count = -count % nbits;
 T low = value << (nbits - count);
 value >>= count;
 value |= low;
 }
 return value;
 }

 inline uint8 __ROL1__(uint8 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint8)value, count); }
 inline uint16 __ROL2__(uint16 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint16)value, count); }
 inline uint32 __ROL4__(uint32 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint32)value, count); }
 inline uint64 __ROL8__(uint64 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint64)value, count); }
 inline uint8 __ROR1__(uint8 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint8)value, -count); }
 inline uint16 __ROR2__(uint16 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint16)value, -count); }
 inline uint32 __ROR4__(uint32 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint32)value, -count); }
 inline uint64 __ROR8__(uint64 value, int count) { return __ROL__((uint64)value, -count); }

 struct State {
 uintptr_t keys[7];
 };

 inline uint64_t rotr63(uint64_t x, uint32_t r) {
 uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
 return (x >> s) | (x << (64 - s));
 }

 inline uint64_t rotl63(uint64_t x, uint32_t r) {
 uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
 return (x << s) | (x >> (64 - s));
 }

 inline uint64_t bitrev64(uint64_t v) {
 uint64_t t = (v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (2 * v)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
 uint64_t t2 = (t >> 2) ^ ((t >> 2) ^ (4 * t)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
 uint64_t t3 = (t2 >> 4) ^ ((t2 >> 4) ^ (16 * t2)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
 return __ROR8__((t3 >> 8) ^ ((t3 >> 8) ^ (t3 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL, 32);
 }

 uint64_t decrypt_gworld_b1(uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state) {
 uint32_t k = key;

 uint64_t v26 = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL *
 (uint64_t)((uint32_t)k ^
 (uint32_t)(((uint32_t)k ^ (uint32_t)((uint64_t)(uint32_t)k >> 15)) >> 12) ^
 (uint32_t)(k << 25));

 uint64_t v27 = v26 % 7;
 uint64_t v28 = state[v27];
 uint32_t v29 = (uint32_t)(v26 >> 32); // HIDWORD
 uint32_t v30 = (uint32_t)(v27 % 7);
 uint64_t v34 = 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;

 if ((uint32_t)v27 == 7 * ((uint32_t)v27 / 7)) {
 v34 = bitrev64(~v28);
 goto LABEL_32;
 }

 if (v30 == 1) {
 uint32_t v45 = v29 + 2 * (uint32_t)v27;
 v34 = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(v29 + (uint32_t)v27)
 + rotl63(v28,
 63 * (uint8_t)(v45 / 0x3F)
 - ((uint8_t)v29 + 2 * (uint8_t)(uint32_t)v27)
 + 63);
 v34 = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(v29 + (uint32_t)v27) + rotr63(v28, v45);
 goto LABEL_39;
 }

 if (v30 == 2) {
 uint32_t r = (uint32_t)(v29 + (uint32_t)v27);
 v34 = rotl63(~v28, r);
 goto LABEL_32;
 }

 LABEL_39:
 v34 = v28;

 switch ((uint32_t)v27 % 7) {
 case 3: {
 uint64_t v46 = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(v29 + 2 * (uint32_t)v27) ^ v28;
 v34 = (v46 >> 1) ^ ((v46 >> 1) ^ (2 * v46)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
 break;
 }
 case 4: {
 v34 = ~bitrev64(v28);
 break;
 }
 case 5: {
 uint32_t r = (uint32_t)(uint32_t)(v29 + (uint32_t)v27);
 v34 = rotl63(~v28, r);
 break;
 }
 case 6: {
 v34 = bitrev64(v28);
 break;
 }
 default:
 break;
 }

 LABEL_32:
 uint64_t v35 = v34 ^ (uint64_t)(uint32_t)key;
 return v35;
 }

 uintptr_t decryptWorld() {
 uintptr_t GWORLD_STATE = 0xA7C38C0;
 uintptr_t GWORLD_KEY = GWORLD_STATE + 0x38;

 printf(xorstr("----START DECRYPT GWORLD (NEW)----\n"));

 uint32_t key = data::read_universal<uint32_t>(gamein.Base + GWORLD_KEY);
 printf(xorstr("Key: [0x%x]\n"), key);

 State state = data::read_universal<State>(gamein.Base + GWORLD_STATE);
 for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++)
 printf(xorstr("State[%d]: [0x%llx]\n"), i, state.keys[i]);

 uint64_t ptr_addr = decrypt_gworld_b1(key, state.keys);
 printf(xorstr("Ptr address: [0x%llx]\n"), ptr_addr);

 if (ptr_addr < 0x10000000000ULL || ptr_addr > 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFULL) {
 printf(xorstr("[-] BAD ptr_addr: 0x%llx\n"), ptr_addr);
 return 0;
 }

 uintptr_t uworld = data::read_universal<uintptr_t>(ptr_addr);
 printf(xorstr("UWorld: [0x%llx]\n"), uworld);

 if (uworld < 0x10000000000ULL || uworld > 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFULL) {
 printf(xorstr("[-] BAD UWorld\n"));
 while (true) {
 uworld = data::read_universal<uintptr_t>(ptr_addr);
 if (uworld) {
 printf(xorstr("UWorld: [0x%llx]\n"), uworld);
 return uworld;
 }
 }
 return 0;
 }

 printf(xorstr("----END DECRYPT----\n\n"));
 return uworld;
 }
 }

```
   Code:
```
std::uint64_t c_decryption::decrypt_xor_keys( const uint32_t key , const uint64_t* state ) {
    const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * ( key ^ ( ( key ^ ( key >> 15 ) ) >> 12 ) ^ ( key << 25 ) );
    const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state [ idx ];
    const uint32_t hi = ( uint32_t ) ( hash >> 32 );
    const uint32_t mod7 = ( uint32_t ) ( idx ) % 7;

    auto swap_pairs = []( uint64_t x ) -> uint64_t {
        return ( x >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( x >> 1 ) ^ ( x << 1 ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
    };
    auto bit_reverse = []( uint64_t x ) -> uint64_t {
        x = ( x >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( x >> 1 ) ^ ( x << 1 ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
        x = ( x >> 2 ) ^ ( ( ( x >> 2 ) ^ ( x << 2 ) ) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL );
        x = ( x >> 4 ) ^ ( ( ( x >> 4 ) ^ ( x << 4 ) ) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL );
        x = ( x >> 8 ) ^ ( ( ( x >> 8 ) ^ ( x << 8 ) ) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL );
        return ( x >> 32 ) | ( x << 32 );
    };
    auto rotl_63 = []( uint64_t x , uint32_t r ) -> uint64_t {
        uint32_t m = r % 63;
        return ( x << ( m + 1 ) ) | ( x >> ( 63 - m ) );
    };
    auto rotr_63 = []( uint64_t x , uint32_t r ) -> uint64_t {
        uint32_t m = r % 63;
        return ( x >> ( m + 1 ) ) | ( x << ( 63 - m ) );
    };

    if ( mod7 == 0 ) {
        val = rotl_63( bit_reverse( val ) , hi );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 1 ) {
        val = rotr_63( rotl_63( val , (uint32_t)( hi + 2 * idx ) ) , (uint32_t)( hi + idx ) );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 2 ) {
        val = swap_pairs( rotl_63( val , (uint32_t)( hi + 2 * idx ) ) );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 3 ) {
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 4 ) {
        val = ~( val + (uint32_t)( hi + 2 * idx ) );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 5 ) {
        val = swap_pairs( rotr_63( val , (uint32_t)( hi + 2 * idx ) ) );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 6 ) {
        val = ( val + (uint32_t)( hi + 2 * idx ) ) ^ ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)( hi + idx );
    }

    return val ^ key;
}
```

>   FName Decryption (Updated 12.07)
>
>  Text encryption has been updated for Patch 12.07. Here's the new setup with HVCI support:
>
>   Code:
> ```
> uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
> {
> const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
> const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
> uint64_t val = state[idx];
> const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
> const uint32_t m7 = (uint32_t)idx % 7;
>
> auto lfsr1 = [](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
>     return (x >> 1) ^ ((x >> 1) ^ (2 * x)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
> };
>
> auto bitrev_ror32 = [&](uint64_t x) -> uint64_t {
>     uint64_t a = lfsr1(x);
>     uint64_t b = (a >> 2) ^ ((a >> 2) ^ (4 * a)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
>     uint64_t c = (b >> 4) ^ ((b >> 4) ^ (16 * b)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
>     uint64_t d = (c >> 8) ^ ((c >> 8) ^ (c << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
>     return _rotr64(d, 32);
> };
>
> auto rotr63 = [](uint64_t x, uint32_t r) -> uint64_t {
>     uint8_t s = (uint8_t)(r % 0x3F) + 1;
>     return (x >> s) | (x << (64 - s));
> };
>
> if (m7 == 0) {
>     val = bitrev_ror32(lfsr1(bitrev_ror32(val)));
> }
> else if (m7 == 1) {
>     val = rotr63(~val, hi + (uint32_t)idx);
> }
> else if (m7 == 2) {
>     val = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) ^ (val - (uint32_t)(hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx));
> }
> else if (m7 == 3) {
>     val = ~rotr63(val, hi + 2 * (uint32_t)idx);
> }
> else if (m7 == 4) {
>     val = ~bitrev_ror32(val);
> }
> else if (m7 == 5) {
>     val = lfsr1(~val);
> }
> else {
>     val = (uint32_t)(hi + (uint32_t)idx) + bitrev_ror32(val);
> }
>
> return val ^ key;
> }
> ```

    const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * ( key ^ ( ( key ^ ( key >> 15 ) ) >> 12 ) ^ ( key << 25 ) );
    const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state [ idx ];

    const uint32_t mod7 = ( uint32_t ) ( idx ) % 7;

    if ( mod7 == 0 ) {
        uint64_t step1 = ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * val ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
        uint64_t step2 = ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( ( ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( 4 * step1 ) ) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL );
        uint64_t step3 = ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( ( ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( 16 * step2 ) ) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL );
        uint64_t step4 = ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( ( ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( step3 << 8 ) ) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL );
        uint64_t rotr_val = _rotr64( step4 , 32 );

        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( int ) hi % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( int ) hi / 0x3F ) - ( uint8_t ) hi + 63;
        val = ( rotr_val << l ) | ( rotr_val >> r );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 1 ) {
        uint8_t l1 = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint8_t r1 = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + 2 * ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint64_t temp1 = ( val << l1 ) | ( val >> r1 );

        uint8_t r2 = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint8_t l2 = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        val = ( temp1 >> r2 ) | ( temp1 << l2 );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 2 ) {
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + 2 * ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint64_t temp1 = ( val << l ) | ( val >> r );
        val = ( temp1 >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( temp1 >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * temp1 ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 3 ) {
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 4 ) {
        val = ~( ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx ) + val );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 5 ) {

        uint8_t l = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + 2 * ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint64_t temp1 = ( val >> r ) | ( val << l );

    }

    return val ^ key;

inline static void* g_world = nullptr;
inline static const wchar_t* map_refs[] = {
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/Init/Init.Init"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/Menu/MainMenuV2.MainMenuV2"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/Poveglia/Range.Range"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/Poveglia/Poveglia.Poveglia"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/Ascent/Ascent.Ascent"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/Canyon/Canyon.Canyon"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/Bonsai/Bonsai.Bonsai"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/Duality/Duality.Duality"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/Foxtrot/Foxtrot.Foxtrot"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/Port/Port.Port"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/Triad/Triad.Triad"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/Pitt/Pitt.Pitt"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/Jam/Jam.Jam"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/Juliett/Juliett.Juliett"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/HURM/HURM_Yard/HURM_Yard.HURM_Yard"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/HURM/HURM_Alley/HURM_Alley.HURM_Alley"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/HURM/HURM_Bowl/HURM_Bowl.HURM_Bowl"),
OBF(L"/Game/Maps/HURM/HURM_Helix/HURM_Helix.HURM_Helix")
};

inline bool from_map()
{
    for (const wchar_t* path : map_refs)
    {
        UObject* obj = UObject::StaticFindObject(nullptr, nullptr, path, NULL);
        if (obj != nullptr)
        {
            g_world = obj;
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

inline bool from_viewport()
{
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i)
    {
        wchar_t name[64];
        _snwprintf(name, 64, OBF(L"AresGameViewportClient_214748%04d"), i);
        auto* vp = reinterpret_cast<viewport_t*>(UObject::StaticFindObject(nullptr, nullptr, name, NULL));
        if (vp)
        {
            auto* w = vp->get_world();
            if (w)
            {
                g_world = w;
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

inline bool from_netdriver()
{
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i)
    {
        wchar_t net_name[64];
        _snwprintf(net_name, 64, OBF(L"AresNetDriver_21474%05d"), i);
        auto* drv = reinterpret_cast<netdriver_t*>(UObject::StaticFindObject(nullptr, nullptr, net_name, NULL));
        if (drv)
        {
            auto* w = drv->get_world();
            if (w)
            {
                g_world = w;
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

inline bool from_instance()
{
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i)
    {
        wchar_t inst_name[64], id_buf[16];
        _snwprintf(id_buf, 16, OBF(L"214748%04d"), i);
        _snwprintf(inst_name, 64, OBF(L"BPAresGameInstance_C_%ls"), id_buf);
        auto* obj = UObject::StaticFindObject(nullptr, nullptr, inst_name, NULL);
        if (obj)
        {
            g_instance_id = _wtoi(id_buf);
            g_instance = obj;
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

inline void* get_world()
{
    if (!g_world)
        if (!from_map())
            if (!from_viewport())
                from_netdriver();

    return g_world;
}
```

    const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state [ idx ];

    const uint32_t mod7 = ( uint32_t ) ( idx ) % 7;

    if ( mod7 == 0 ) {
        uint64_t temp = ~val;
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( int ) hi % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( int ) hi / 0x3F ) - ( uint8_t ) hi + 63;
        val = ( temp << l ) | ( temp >> r );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 1 ) {
        uint64_t temp = val - ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx );
        uint8_t l = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint8_t r = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        val = ( temp << l ) | ( temp >> r );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 2 ) {
        uint64_t temp = ~( uint64_t ) ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx ) ^ val;
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        val = ( temp >> r ) | ( temp << l );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 3 ) {
        uint64_t temp = ~val;
        uint64_t step1 = ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * temp ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
        uint64_t step2 = ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( ( ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( 4 * step1 ) ) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL );
        uint64_t step3 = ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( ( ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( 16 * step2 ) ) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL );
        uint64_t step4 = ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( ( ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( step3 << 8 ) ) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL );
        val = _rotr64( step4 , 32 );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 4 ) {

        uint64_t step4 = ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( ( ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( step3 << 8 ) ) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL );

		static auto Sl = UKismetStringLibrary::StaticClass();
		static FName Neck      = Sl->ConvStringToName(XorStr(L"Neck"));
		static FName Pelvis    = Sl->ConvStringToName(XorStr(L"Pelvis"));
		static FName RShoulder = Sl->ConvStringToName(XorStr(L"R_Shoulder"));
		static FName LShoulder = Sl->ConvStringToName(XorStr(L"L_Shoulder"));
		static FName RHip      = Sl->ConvStringToName(XorStr(L"R_Hip"));
		static FName LHip      = Sl->ConvStringToName(XorStr(L"L_Hip"));
		static FName RElbow    = Sl->ConvStringToName(XorStr(L"R_Elbow"));
		static FName LElbow    = Sl->ConvStringToName(XorStr(L"L_Elbow"));
		static FName RHand     = Sl->ConvStringToName(XorStr(L"R_Hand"));
		static FName LHand     = Sl->ConvStringToName(XorStr(L"L_Hand"));
		static FName RKnee     = Sl->ConvStringToName(XorStr(L"R_Knee"));
		static FName LKnee     = Sl->ConvStringToName(XorStr(L"L_Knee"));
		static FName RFoot     = Sl->ConvStringToName(XorStr(L"R_Foot"));
		static FName LFoot     = Sl->ConvStringToName(XorStr(L"L_Foot"));

		struct Joint { FVector2D S; bool Valid; };
		auto Project = [&](FName Bone) -> Joint
		{
			Joint J{};
			J.Valid = PC->WorldToScreen(Mesh->GetSocketLocation(Bone), &J.S);
			return J;
		};

		const Joint NeckJ = Project(Neck);
		const Joint PelvJ = Project(Pelvis);
		const Joint RSh   = Project(RShoulder);
		const Joint LSh   = Project(LShoulder);
		const Joint RHp   = Project(RHip);
		const Joint LHp   = Project(LHip);
		const Joint REl   = Project(RElbow);
		const Joint LEl   = Project(LElbow);
		const Joint RHn   = Project(RHand);
		const Joint LHn   = Project(LHand);
		const Joint RKn   = Project(RKnee);
		const Joint LKn   = Project(LKnee);
		const Joint RFt   = Project(RFoot);
		const Joint LFt   = Project(LFoot);

		auto Connect = [&](const Joint& A, const Joint& B)
		{
			if (A.Valid && B.Valid) GameCanvas->DrawLine(A.S, B.S, Color, 1.0f);
		};

		Connect(NeckJ, PelvJ);
		Connect(NeckJ, RSh); Connect(RSh, REl); Connect(REl, RHn);
		Connect(NeckJ, LSh); Connect(LSh, LEl); Connect(LEl, LHn);
		Connect(PelvJ, RHp); Connect(RHp, RKn); Connect(RKn, RFt);
		Connect(PelvJ, LHp); Connect(LHp, LKn); Connect(LKn, LFt);
```

### Post #4709636 — chuxia — 15th June 2026, 08:18 AM

> **hubei:**
> Originally Posted by hubei   Does anyone know if chinese valorant bones are different from mesh?
>
>  (actor) + 0x4F0 + 0x748 = 0
>  actor->mesh->bone_array_count = 0
>
>  Reading bones/count from the actor mesh always returns 0, not sure why? Is it different on CN Valorant?

actor + 0x4F0 → USkeletalMeshComponent* (mesh)
 mesh + 0x6F0 → BoneArray (FTransform[] pointer)
 mesh + 0x6F8 → BoneCount (bone count)

> Originally Posted by chuxia   actor + 0x4F0 → USkeletalMeshComponent* (mesh)

>  mesh + 0x6F8 → BoneCount (bone count)

Is there any site for offsets that has an API I can use for auto updating?

  Code:
```
struct FMinimalViewInfo {
    struct fvector Location {};
    struct fvector Rotation {};
    float FOV;
};
```

  Code:
```
        fvector HeadWorld = bone_matrix(8, pawn.BoneArray, pawn.Mesh);
        fvector RootWorld = bone_matrix(0, pawn.BoneArray, pawn.Mesh);

        FVector2D HeadScreen = w2s(HeadWorld);
        FVector2D RootScreen = w2s(RootWorld);
```
   Code:
```
inline fvector bone_matrix(int index, uintptr_t array, uintptr_t mesh)
{
    ftransform comp_to_world = Driver::Read<ftransform>(mesh + Offsets::ComponentToWorld);
    ftransform bone = Driver::Read<ftransform>(array + (index * 0x60));
    D3DMATRIX Matrix;
    Matrix = MatrixMultiplication(bone.ToMatrixWithScale(), comp_to_world.ToMatrixWithScale());

    return fvector(Matrix._41, Matrix._42, Matrix._43);
}
```
   Code:
```
inline void get_view()
{
    Cache::view = Driver::Read<FMinimalViewInfo>(
        GameCache::PlayerCameraManager + Offsets::CameraPrivate + 0x10
    );
}

inline FVector2D w2s(fvector world_location)
{
    auto ViewInfo = Cache::view;
    fvector CameraLocation = ViewInfo.Location;
    frotator CameraRotation = ViewInfo.Rotation;

    D3DMATRIX rotation_matrix = matrix(CameraRotation);
    auto& axis_x = rotation_matrix.m[0];
    auto& axis_y = rotation_matrix.m[1];
    auto& axis_z = rotation_matrix.m[2];

    fvector delta = world_location - CameraLocation;

    auto transformed_x = delta.Dot(fvector(axis_y[0], axis_y[1], axis_y[2]));
    auto transformed_y = delta.Dot(fvector(axis_z[0], axis_z[1], axis_z[2]));
    auto transformed_z = max(delta.Dot(fvector(axis_x[0], axis_x[1], axis_x[2])), 1.0f);

    float FovAngle = ViewInfo.FOV;

    float fov_rad = FovAngle * M_PI / 180.0f;
    float fov_tan = tanf(fov_rad / 2.0f);

    int screen_width_center = GetSystemMetrics(0) / 2;
    int screen_height_center = GetSystemMetrics(1) / 2;

    float screen_x = screen_width_center + (transformed_x / fov_tan) * screen_width_center / transformed_z;
    float screen_y = screen_height_center - (transformed_y / fov_tan) * screen_width_center / transformed_z;

    return FVector2D(screen_x, screen_y);
}
```

 Is this correct to get everything?

__forceinline uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
{
	const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
	const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
	uint64_t val = state[idx];
	const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
	const uint32_t mod7 = (uint32_t)(idx) % 7;

	if (mod7 == 0) {
		uint8_t r = (uint8_t)(((int)hi - 1) % 0x3F) + 1;
		uint8_t l = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi - 1) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)hi - 1) + 63;
		val = ~(uint64_t)hi ^ ((val >> r) | (val << l));
	}
	else if (mod7 == 1) {
		uint8_t r1 = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + 2 * (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
		uint8_t l1 = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + 2 * (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)hi + 2 * (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
		uint64_t temp = (val >> r1) | (val << l1);
		uint8_t r2 = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
		uint8_t l2 = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)hi + (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
		val = (temp >> r2) | (temp << l2);
	}
	else if (mod7 == 2) {
		val = (val ^ ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx)) + (uint32_t)(hi + idx);
	}
	else if (mod7 == 3) {
		uint8_t r1 = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + 2 * (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
		uint8_t l1 = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + 2 * (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)hi + 2 * (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
		uint64_t temp = (val >> r1) | (val << l1);
		uint8_t l2 = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
		uint8_t r2 = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)hi + (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
		val = (temp << l2) | (temp >> r2);
	}
	else if (mod7 == 4) {
		uint64_t step1 = (val >> 1) ^ (((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
		uint64_t step2 = (step1 >> 2) ^ (((step1 >> 2) ^ (4 * step1)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL);
		uint64_t step3 = (step2 >> 4) ^ (((step2 >> 4) ^ (16 * step2)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL);
		uint64_t step4 = (step3 >> 8) ^ (((step3 >> 8) ^ (step3 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL);
		val = (uint32_t)(hi + idx) + _rotr64(step4, 32);
	}
	else if (mod7 == 5) {
		uint64_t temp = ~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx) ^ val;
		uint8_t l = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
		uint8_t r = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)hi + (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
		val = (temp << l) | (temp >> r);
	}
	else if (mod7 == 6) {
		uint64_t temp = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx) + val;
		uint8_t l = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
		uint8_t r = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)hi + (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
		val = (temp << l) | (temp >> r);
	}

	return val ^ key;
}

#pragma once

    inline std::uint32_t MakeKeyFromNone(const char encryptedNone[4])
    {
        constexpr char expected[4] = { 'N', 'o', 'n', 'e' };
        std::uint8_t key[4]{};
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
            key[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(encryptedNone[i]) ^ 4u ^ static_cast<std::uint8_t>(expected[i]);
        return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(key[0]) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(key[1]) << 8) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(key[2]) << 16) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(key[3]) << 24);
    }

    inline char DecodeChar(char encrypted, std::uint32_t key, std::uint32_t index, std::uint32_t length)
    {
        const auto* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&key);
        return encrypted ^ static_cast<char>(length) ^ bytes[index & 3u];
    }

    inline char16_t DecodeWideChar(char16_t encrypted, std::uint32_t key, std::uint32_t index, std::uint32_t length)
    {
        auto value = encrypted;
        auto* bytes = reinterpret_cast<std::uint8_t*>(&value);
        const auto* keyBytes = reinterpret_cast<const std::uint8_t*>(&key);
        bytes[0] ^= static_cast<std::uint8_t>(length) ^ keyBytes[(index * 2u) & 3u];
        bytes[1] ^= static_cast<std::uint8_t>(length) ^ keyBytes[(index * 2u + 1u) & 3u];
        return value;
    }
}
} // namespace Decrypt

#pragma once

// auto generated by beardumper
// Helpers for games that wrap or encrypt the public GObjects address.

#include <bit>
#include <cstdint>

namespace Decrypt
{
namespace ValorantGObjects
{
    inline constexpr std::uintptr_t SlotsOffset = 0x40;
    inline constexpr std::uintptr_t SeedOffset = 0x78;
    inline constexpr std::uint64_t Multiplier = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1Dull;

    inline std::uint32_t Rol63Amount(std::uint32_t value)
    {
        return (value % 63u) + 1u;
    }

    inline std::uint64_t PairSwap(std::uint64_t value)
    {
        return (value >> 1) ^ (((value >> 1) ^ (value << 1)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAull);
    }

    inline std::uintptr_t Decode(std::uint64_t seedValue, std::uint64_t encodedSlotValue)
    {
        const std::uint32_t seed = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(seedValue);
        const std::uint32_t x = seed ^ (seed << 25) ^ (((seed ^ (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(seed) >> 15)) >> 12) & 0xFFFFFFFFu);
        const std::uint64_t mixed = Multiplier * static_cast<std::uint64_t>(x);
        const std::uint32_t shift = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(mixed >> 32);
        const std::uint32_t slot = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(mixed % 7u);
        std::uint64_t value = encodedSlotValue;

        switch (slot) {
        case 0: value = std::rotr(value, Rol63Amount(shift - 1u)) ^ ~static_cast<std::uint64_t>(shift); break;
        case 1: value -= static_cast<std::uint32_t>(shift + 2u * slot); value ^= ~static_cast<std::uint64_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(shift + slot)); break;
        case 2: value = PairSwap(value) ^ ~static_cast<std::uint64_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(shift + slot)); break;
        case 3: break;
        case 4: value = std::rotr(PairSwap(value), Rol63Amount(shift + slot)); break;
        case 5: value = PairSwap(value) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(shift + slot); break;
        case 6: value += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(shift + slot); value += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(shift + 2u * slot); break;
        }

        return static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(value ^ seed);
    }

    template <typename Read64>
    inline std::uintptr_t GetFUObjectArray(std::uintptr_t processBase, std::uintptr_t gobjectsRva, Read64 read64)
    {
        const std::uintptr_t wrapper = processBase + gobjectsRva;
        const std::uint64_t seedValue = read64(wrapper + SeedOffset);
        const std::uint32_t seed = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(seedValue);
        const std::uint32_t x = seed ^ (seed << 25) ^ (((seed ^ (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(seed) >> 15)) >> 12) & 0xFFFFFFFFu);
        const std::uint64_t mixed = Multiplier * static_cast<std::uint64_t>(x);
        const std::uint32_t slot = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(mixed % 7u);
        return Decode(seedValue, read64(wrapper + SlotsOffset + static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(slot) * 8u));
    }
}
} // namespace Decrypt

        return {};

    const auto equippable = Driver::Read<uintptr_t>(inventory + Offsets::CurrentEquipable);
    if (!equippable)

    const auto obj_name = get_fname(equippable);

    if (obj_name.empty())
        return {};

    if (auto it = weapon_map.find(obj_name); it != weapon_map.end())
        return it->second;

    if (obj_name.find("Totem") != std::string::npos)

    if (obj_name.find("Defuser") != std::string::npos)

        return it->second;

    constexpr const char* default_prefix = "Default__";
    if (name.rfind(default_prefix, 0) == 0)
    {
        std::string trimmed = name.substr(strlen(default_prefix));
        it = agent_map.find(trimmed);

        if (it != agent_map.end())
            return it->second;
    }

    for (const auto& [agent_class, agent_name] : agent_map)
    {
        if (name.find(agent_class) != std::string::npos)
            return agent_name;
    }

    return name;
}
```

### Post #4743341 — jacobs5496 — 17th July 2026, 02:30 AM

GWorld (double deref required):
 base + 0xCD01E30 → ptr → *ptr = UWorld

 UWorld traversal:
 UWorld + 0x38 → PersistentLevel
 UWorld + 0x178 → GameState
 UWorld + 0x1D8 → GameInstance

 Player chain:
 GameInstance + 0x40 → LocalPlayers (TArray)
 LocalPlayers[0] + 0x38 → PlayerController
 PlayerController + 0x518 → AcknowledgedPawn (LocalPawn)
 PlayerController + 0x528 → PlayerCameraManager

 Actor iteration:
 PersistentLevel + 0xA0 → ActorArray (TArray ptr)
 PersistentLevel + 0xA8 → ActorCount (int32)

 Per-actor (ShooterCharacter):
 +0x290 → RootComponent
 +0x488 → PlayerState (on Pawn)
 +0x4F0 → Mesh (SkeletalMeshComponent)
 +0x6A8 → TeamComponent (on PlayerState)
 +0xBC0 → SpawnedCharacter (on ShooterPlayerState)
 +0xC08 → Inventory
 +0xC68 → DamageHandler
 +0xF40 → Mesh1P
 +0xF48 → MeshOverlay1P
 +0xF50 → MeshCosmetic3P
 +0xF68 → WasAlly
 +0x1158 → FacingControlRotation

 DamageHandler:
 +0x200 → Health

 Mesh/Bones (from SDK):
 +0x300 → ComponentToWorld (FTransform)
 +0x760 → BoneArray
 +0x768 → BoneCount
 +0x4A4 → BoundsScale
 +0x4A8 → LastSubmitTime
 +0x4AC → LastRenderTimeOnScreen

 Camera:
 PlayerCameraManager + 0x580 → CameraFOV
 PlayerCameraManager + 0x59C → CameraRotation

 Globals:
 GWorld RVA: 0xCD01E30
 FNamePool RVA: 0xCEBB2C0

```
std::string c_decryption::get_fname( int key ) {
    uint chunkOffset = ( uint ) ( ( int ) ( key ) >> 16 );
    ushort nameOffset = ( ushort ) key;

    std::uint64_t namePoolChunk = hypercall::read_va<std::uint64_t>(
        hypercall::image_base + 0xCEBB2C0 + ( ( chunkOffset + 2 ) * 8 )
    );

    std::uint64_t entryOffset = namePoolChunk + ( ulong ) ( 4 * nameOffset );
    FNameEntry nameEntry = hypercall::read_va<FNameEntry>( entryOffset );
    auto name = nameEntry.AnsiName;
    std::uintptr_t nameKey = hypercall::xor_key;

    if ( nameEntry.Header.Len <= 365 ) {
        for ( std::uint16_t i = 0; i < nameEntry.Header.Len; i++ ) {
            BYTE b = i & 3;
            name [ i ] ^= nameEntry.Header.Len ^ *( ( LPBYTE ) &nameKey + b );
        }
    }
    return name;
}

std::uint64_t c_decryption::decrypt_xor_keys( const uint32_t key , const uint64_t* state ) {
    const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * ( key ^ ( ( key ^ ( key >> 15 ) ) >> 12 ) ^ ( key << 25 ) );
    const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state [ idx ];
    const uint32_t hi = ( uint32_t ) ( hash >> 32 );
    const uint32_t mod7 = ( uint32_t ) ( idx ) % 7;

    if ( mod7 == 0 ) {
        uint8_t r = ( uint8_t ) hi - 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi - 1 ) / 0x3F );
        uint8_t l = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi - 1 ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi - 1 ) + 63;
        val = ~( ( val >> r ) | ( val << l ) );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 1 ) {
        val = val - ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx ) - ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 2 ) {
        val = ( val ^ ~( uint64_t ) ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx ) ) + ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 3 ) {
        val ^= ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 4 ) {
        val = ( ~( uint64_t ) ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx ) ^ val ) - ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 5 ) {
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + 2 * ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint64_t temp = ( val << l ) | ( val >> r );

        uint64_t step1 = ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * temp ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
        uint64_t step2 = ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( ( ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( 4 * step1 ) ) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL );
        uint64_t step3 = ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( ( ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( 16 * step2 ) ) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL );
        uint64_t step4 = ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( ( ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( step3 << 8 ) ) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL );
        val = _rotr64( step4 , 32 );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 6 ) {
        uint32_t v10 = hi + 2 * idx;
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( v10 / 0x3F ) - ( uint8_t ) v10 + 63;
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( v10 % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint64_t temp = ( val >> r ) | ( val << l );
        val = ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * temp ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
    }

    return val ^ key;
}

bool c_decryption::decrypt_name_key( std::uintptr_t valorant_base , std::uintptr_t* returned_xor ) {
    uintptr_t namepoolkey = hypercall::read_va<uintptr_t>( valorant_base + 0xD0C6E40 + 0x38 );
    if ( !namepoolkey ) return false;

    struct state {
        uintptr_t keys [ 7 ];
    };

    state xor_state = hypercall::read_va<state>( valorant_base + 0xD0C6E40 );
    const auto address = decrypt_xor_keys( namepoolkey , ( uintptr_t* ) &xor_state );
    uintptr_t xors = hypercall::read_va<uintptr_t>( address );

    if ( xors ) {
        *returned_xor = xors;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

std::uint64_t c_decryption::decrypt_xor_keys( const uint32_t key , const uint64_t* state ) {
    const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * ( key ^ ( ( key ^ ( key >> 15 ) ) >> 12 ) ^ ( key << 25 ) );
    const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state [ idx ];
    const uint32_t hi = ( uint32_t ) ( hash >> 32 );
    const uint32_t mod7 = ( uint32_t ) ( idx ) % 7;

    if ( mod7 == 0 ) {
        uint64_t step1 = ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * val ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
        uint64_t step2 = ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( ( ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( 4 * step1 ) ) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL );
        uint64_t step3 = ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( ( ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( 16 * step3 ) ) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL );
        uint64_t step4 = ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( ( ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( step3 << 8 ) ) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL );
        val = _rotr64( step4 , 32 ) - hi;
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 1 ) {
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        val = ( ~val >> r ) | ( ~val << l );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 2 ) {
        val = ( ~( uint64_t ) ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx ) ^ val ) - ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 3 ) {
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + 2 * ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint64_t temp = ( val >> r ) | ( val << l );
        val = ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * temp ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 4 ) {
        uint8_t l = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint8_t r = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        val = ( ~val << l ) | ( ~val >> r );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 5 ) {
        uint64_t temp = val - ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx );
        uint8_t l = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint8_t r = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        val = ( temp << l ) | ( temp >> r );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 6 ) {
        val ^= ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx );
    }

    return val ^ key;
}

std::uint64_t c_decryption::decrypt_gworld( const uint32_t key , const uint64_t* state ) {
    const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * ( key ^ ( ( key ^ ( key >> 15 ) ) >> 12 ) ^ ( key << 25 ) );
    const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state [ idx ];
    const uint32_t hi = ( uint32_t ) ( hash >> 32 );
    const uint32_t mod7 = ( uint32_t ) ( idx ) % 7;

    if ( mod7 == 0 ) {
        uint64_t temp = val + hi;
        uint64_t step1 = ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * temp ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
        uint64_t step2 = ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( ( ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( 4 * step1 ) ) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL );
        uint64_t step3 = ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( ( ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( 16 * step2 ) ) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL );
        uint64_t step4 = ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( ( ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( step3 << 8 ) ) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL );
        val = _rotr64( step4 , 32 );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 1 ) {
        uint8_t l = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint8_t r = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        val = ~( ( val << l ) | ( val >> r ) );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 2 ) {
        val = ~( uint64_t ) ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx ) ^ ( ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx ) + val );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 3 ) {
        uint64_t step1 = ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * val ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
        uint8_t l = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + 2 * ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint8_t r = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        val = ( step1 << l ) | ( step1 >> r );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 4 ) {
        uint64_t temp = val - ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx );
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + 2 * ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        val = ( temp >> r ) | ( temp << l );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 5 ) {
        uint64_t step1 = ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * val ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
        uint64_t step2 = ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( ( ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( 4 * step1 ) ) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL );
        uint64_t step3 = ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( ( ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( 16 * step2 ) ) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL );
        uint64_t step4 = ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( ( ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( step3 << 8 ) ) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL );
        val = _rotr64( step4 , 32 );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 6 ) {
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        val = ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx ) + ( ( val >> r ) | ( val << l ) );
    }

    return val ^ key;
}

std::uint64_t c_decryption::decrypt_xor_keys( const uint32_t key , const uint64_t* state ) {
    const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * ( key ^ ( ( key ^ ( key >> 15 ) ) >> 12 ) ^ ( key << 25 ) );
    const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state [ idx ];
    const uint32_t hi = ( uint32_t ) ( hash >> 32 );
    const uint32_t mod7 = ( uint32_t ) ( idx ) % 7;

    if ( mod7 == 0 ) {
        uint64_t step1 = ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * val ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
        uint64_t step2 = ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( ( ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( 4 * step1 ) ) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL );
        uint64_t step3 = ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( ( ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( 16 * step2 ) ) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL );
        uint64_t step4 = ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( ( ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( step3 << 8 ) ) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL );
        val = _rotr64( step4 , 32 ) - hi;
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 1 ) {
        val = ( ~( uint64_t ) ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx ) ^ val ) - ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 2 ) {
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        val = ( ~val >> r ) | ( ~val << l );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 3 ) {
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + 2 * ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint64_t temp = ( val >> r ) | ( val << l );
        val = ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * temp ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 4 ) {
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        val = ( ~val >> l ) | ( ~val << r );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 5 ) {
        uint64_t temp = val - ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx );
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        val = ( temp >> l ) | ( temp << r );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 6 ) {
        val ^= ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx );
    }

    return val ^ key;
}

    const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
    uint64_t val = state [ idx ];
    const uint32_t hi = ( uint32_t ) ( hash >> 32 );
    const uint32_t mod7 = ( uint32_t ) ( idx ) % 7;

    if ( mod7 == 0 ) {
        uint64_t temp = val + hi;
        uint64_t step1 = ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( temp >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * temp ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
        uint64_t step2 = ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( ( ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( 4 * step1 ) ) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL );
        uint64_t step3 = ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( ( ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( 16 * step2 ) ) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL );
        uint64_t step4 = ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( ( ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( step3 << 8 ) ) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL );
        val = _rotr64( step4 , 32 );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 1 ) {
        uint8_t l = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint8_t r = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        val = ~( ( val << l ) | ( val >> r ) );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 2 ) {
        val = ~( uint64_t ) ( uint32_t ) ( hi + 2 * idx ) ^ ( ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx ) + val );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 3 ) {
        uint64_t step1 = ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * val ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
        uint8_t l = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + 2 * ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint8_t r = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        val = ( step1 << l ) | ( step1 >> r );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 4 ) {
        uint64_t temp = val - ( uint32_t ) ( hi + idx );
        uint8_t r = 63 * ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) / 0x3F ) - ( ( uint8_t ) hi + 2 * ( uint8_t ) idx ) + 63;
        uint8_t l = ( uint8_t ) ( ( ( int ) hi + 2 * ( int ) idx ) % 0x3F ) + 1;
        val = ( temp >> r ) | ( temp << l );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 5 ) {
        uint64_t step1 = ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( ( ( val >> 1 ) ^ ( 2 * val ) ) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL );
        uint64_t step2 = ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( ( ( step1 >> 2 ) ^ ( 4 * step1 ) ) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL );
        uint64_t step3 = ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( ( ( step2 >> 4 ) ^ ( 16 * step2 ) ) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL );
        uint64_t step4 = ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( ( ( step3 >> 8 ) ^ ( step3 << 8 ) ) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL );
        val = _rotr64( step4 , 32 );
    }
    else if ( mod7 == 6 ) {

namespace Wireframe {
	constexpr uint8_t WireframeFlag = 1 << 5;
	constexpr uint8_t WireframeColor = 0x05;

	__forceinline void ApplyWireframe(void* mesh) {
		if (!mesh) return;

		uint8_t* meshFlags = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mesh) + Offsets::bForceWireframe);
		uint8_t* meshColor = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mesh) + Offsets::wireframe_num_1);

		*meshFlags |= WireframeFlag;
		*meshColor = WireframeColor;
	}

	__forceinline bool HasWireframe(void* mesh) {
		if (!mesh) return false;
		uint8_t* meshFlags = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mesh) + Offsets::bForceWireframe);
		return (*meshFlags & WireframeFlag) != 0;
	}
}
```

> 	__forceinline void ApplyWireframe(void* mesh) {
> 		if (!mesh) return;
>
> 		uint8_t* meshFlags = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mesh) + Offsets::bForceWireframe);
> 		uint8_t* meshColor = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mesh) + Offsets::wireframe_num_1);
>
> 		*meshFlags |= WireframeFlag;
> 		*meshColor = WireframeColor;
> 	}
>
> 	__forceinline bool HasWireframe(void* mesh) {
> 		if (!mesh) return false;
> 		uint8_t* meshFlags = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mesh) + Offsets::bForceWireframe);
> 		return (*meshFlags & WireframeFlag) != 0;
> 	}
> }
> ```

thanks +rep

    s.erase( s.begin( ) ,
        std::find_if( s.begin( ) , s.end( ) ,
            [ ] ( unsigned char c ) { return !std::isspace( c ); } ) );

static std::string rtrim( std::string s ) {
    s.erase( std::find_if( s.rbegin( ) , s.rend( ) ,
        [ ] ( unsigned char c ) { return !std::isspace( c ); } ).base( ) ,
        s.end( ) );
    return s;
}

static std::string trim( std::string s ) {
    return ltrim( rtrim( std::move( s ) ) );
}

static std::vector<token> parse_pattern( const std::string& pattern_str ) {
    std::vector<token> tokens;
    std::istringstream ss( pattern_str );
    std::string word;

    while ( ss >> word ) {
        if ( !word.empty( ) && ( word.back( ) == 'h' || word.back( ) == 'H' ) )
            word.pop_back( );

        if ( word.size( ) >= 2 && word[ 0 ] == '0' && ( word[ 1 ] == 'x' || word[ 1 ] == 'X' ) )
            word = word.substr( 2 );

        token tok {};
        if ( word == "?" ) {
            tok.wildcard = true;
            tok.value = 0;
        }
        else {
            tok.wildcard = false;
            unsigned int v = 0;
            if ( std::sscanf( word.c_str( ) , "%2x" , &v ) != 1 )
                throw std::runtime_error( "invalid hex token in pattern: '" + word + "'" );
            tok.value = static_cast< unsigned char >( v );
        }
        tokens.push_back( tok );
    }

    if ( tokens.empty( ) )
        throw std::runtime_error( "pattern is empty or invalid" );

    return tokens;
}

static size_t scan_pattern( const unsigned char* data , size_t size ,
    const std::vector<token>& tokens )
{
    const size_t pat_len = tokens.size( );
    if ( pat_len == 0 || pat_len > size )
        return std::string::npos;

    for ( size_t i = 0; i <= size - pat_len; ++i ) {
        bool match = true;
        for ( size_t j = 0; j < pat_len; ++j ) {
            if ( !tokens[ j ].wildcard && data[ i + j ] != tokens[ j ].value ) {
                match = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if ( match )
            return i;
    }
    return std::string::npos;
}

static std::string open_file_picker( ) {
    wchar_t wide_path[ MAX_PATH ] = {};

    OPENFILENAMEW ofn {};
    ofn.lStructSize = sizeof( ofn );
    ofn.lpstrFile = wide_path;
    ofn.nMaxFile = MAX_PATH;
    ofn.lpstrFilter = L"Executables\0*.exe\0All Files\0*.*\0";
    ofn.nFilterIndex = 1;
    ofn.Flags = OFN_PATHMUSTEXIST | OFN_FILEMUSTEXIST;

    if ( !GetOpenFileNameW( &ofn ) )
        return {};

    int needed = WideCharToMultiByte( CP_ACP , 0 , wide_path , -1 , nullptr , 0 , nullptr , nullptr );
    if ( needed <= 0 )
        return {};

    std::string result( static_cast< size_t >( needed - 1 ) , '\0' );
    WideCharToMultiByte( CP_ACP , 0 , wide_path , -1 , &result[ 0 ] , needed , nullptr , nullptr );
    return result;
}

    },

    //    " 29 B8 ? ? ? ? 48 8B 05 ? ? ? ? 48 33 C4 48 89 45"

int main( ) {
    {
        HANDLE hOut = GetStdHandle( STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE );
        DWORD mode = 0;
        GetConsoleMode( hOut , &mode );
        SetConsoleMode( hOut , mode | ENABLE_VIRTUAL_TERMINAL_PROCESSING );
    }

    std::cout << "Select Dumped Valorant .EXE file in the file dialog...\n";
    const std::string file_path = open_file_picker( );
    system( "cls" );

    if ( file_path.empty( ) ) {
        std::cerr << "No file selected. Exiting.\n";
        system( "pause" );
        return 1;
    }

    std::ifstream ifs( file_path , std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate );
    if ( !ifs ) {
        std::cerr << "Error: could not open file: " << file_path << "\n";
        system( "pause" );
        return 2;
    }

    const auto file_size = static_cast< size_t >( ifs.tellg( ) );
    ifs.seekg( 0 );

    std::vector<unsigned char> file_data( file_size );
    if ( !ifs.read( reinterpret_cast< char* >( file_data.data( ) ) ,
        static_cast< std::streamsize >( file_size ) ) ) {
        std::cerr << "Error reading file.\n";
        system( "pause" );
        return 3;
    }
    ifs.close( );

    std::ofstream ofs( "results.txt" );
    if ( !ofs ) {
        std::cerr << "Error creating results.txt\n";
    }

    for ( const auto& entry : g_patterns ) {
        try {
            const auto tokens = parse_pattern( entry.pattern );
            const size_t hit = scan_pattern( file_data.data( ) , file_size , tokens );

            std::time_t now = std::time( nullptr );
            std::tm tm {};
            localtime_s( &tm , &now );

            char time_buf[ 64 ];
            std::strftime( time_buf , sizeof( time_buf ) , "%Y-%m-%d : %H:%M:%S" , &tm );

            if ( hit != std::string::npos ) {
                size_t output = hit;

                if ( entry.name == "GWorld" ) {
                    int32_t rel = *reinterpret_cast< int32_t* >( file_data.data( ) + hit + 3 );
                    size_t resolved = hit + 7 + rel;
                    output = resolved;
                }

                std::cout << time_buf << " | \033[32mSUCCESS\033[0m "
                    << entry.name << ": 0x"
                    << std::hex << std::uppercase << output << "\n";

                if ( ofs )
                    ofs << time_buf << " | SUCCESS "
                    << entry.name << ": 0x"
                    << std::hex << std::uppercase << output << "\n";
            }
            else {
                std::cout << time_buf << " | \033[31mFAILED\033[0m "
                    << entry.name << ": 0x0\n";

                if ( ofs )
                    ofs << time_buf << " | FAILED "
                    << entry.name << ": 0x0\n";
            }

        }
        catch ( const std::exception& ex ) {
            std::cerr << "Error in " << entry.name << ": " << ex.what( ) << "\n";
        }
    }

    if ( ofs ) {
        ofs.close( );
        std::cout << "\nResults saved to results.txt\n";
    }

    return std::getchar( );
}

        constexpr u64 Rotl(u64 value, u32 pivot) noexcept

            return (value << n) | (value >> (64u - n));

        constexpr u64 Rotr(u64 value, u32 pivot) noexcept
        {

            return (value >> n) | (value << (64u - n));

        constexpr u64 Swap(u64 value) noexcept
        {
            return ((value & Mask) << Shift) | ((value >> Shift) & Mask);
        }

        constexpr u64 PairSwap(u64 value) noexcept
        {
            return Swap<1, 0x5555555555555555ull>(value);
        }

        constexpr u64 Permute(u64 value) noexcept
        {
            value = PairSwap(value);
            value = Swap<2, 0x3333333333333333ull>(value);
            value = Swap<4, 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0Full>(value);
            value = Swap<8, 0x00FF00FF00FF00FFull>(value);
            return (value >> 32) | (value << 32);
        }

        {

        }

        constexpr u64 Decode(u64 value, State s) noexcept
        {

            const u32 b = s.shift + 2u * s.slot;

            switch (s.slot)
            {
            case 0: return Permute(value) - s.shift;
            case 1: return Permute(value ^ Not32(b));
            case 2: return PairSwap(value) ^ Not32(a);
            case 3: return Rotl(Rotl(value, b), a);
            case 4: return Rotr(Rotr(value, b), a);
            case 5: return PairSwap(value ^ Not32(b));
            case 6: return Permute(value) + a;

        const u64 seed64 = read64(wrapper + SeedOffset);
        if (!seed64 || seed64 == ~u64{0}) return 0;

        const u32 seed = static_cast<u32>(seed64);
        const auto state = detail::MakeState(seed);
        const u64 encoded = read64(
            wrapper + KeysOffset + static_cast<uptr>(state.slot) * sizeof(u64));

        return static_cast<uptr>(detail::Decode(encoded, state) ^ seed);

    inline uptr GetItem(uptr chunks, u32 index, Read64 read64)

namespace Decrypt::ValorantFName {

constexpr std::uint8_t KeyByte(std::uint32_t key, std::uint32_t i) {
    return key >> ((i & 3u) * 8u);
}

constexpr std::uint32_t MakeKeyFromNone(const char* s) {
    std::uint32_t key{};
    for (std::uint32_t i{}; i < 4; ++i)
        key |= std::uint32_t(std::uint8_t(s[i]) ^ 4u ^ "None"[i]) << (i * 8u);
    return key;
}

constexpr char DecodeChar(char c, std::uint32_t key,
                          std::uint32_t i, std::uint32_t length) {
    return char(std::uint8_t(c) ^ std::uint8_t(length) ^ KeyByte(key, i));
}

constexpr char16_t DecodeWideChar(char16_t c, std::uint32_t key,
                                 std::uint32_t i, std::uint32_t length) {
    const auto l = std::uint8_t(length);
    return c ^ char16_t((l ^ KeyByte(key, i * 2u)) |
                       ((l ^ KeyByte(key, i * 2u + 1u)) << 8u));
}

}
```

__forceinline uint64_t decrypt_xor_keys(const uint32_t key, const uint64_t* state)
const uint64_t hash = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL * (key ^ ((key ^ (key >> 15)) >> 12) ^ (key << 25));
const uint64_t idx = hash % 7;
uint64_t val = state[idx];
const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);
const uint32_t mod7 = (uint32_t)(idx) % 7;

if (mod7 == 0) {
	uint64_t step1 = (val >> 1) ^ (((val >> 1) ^ (2 * val)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
	uint64_t step2 = (step1 >> 2) ^ (((step1 >> 2) ^ (4 * step1)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL);
	uint64_t step3 = (step2 >> 4) ^ (((step2 >> 4) ^ (16 * step2)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL);
	uint64_t step4 = (step3 >> 8) ^ (((step3 >> 8) ^ (step3 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL);
	val = _rotr64(step4, 32) - hi;
}
else if (mod7 == 1) {
	val = (~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx) ^ val) - (uint32_t)(hi + idx);
}
else if (mod7 == 2) {
	uint8_t l = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
	uint8_t r = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)hi + (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
	val = (~val >> r) | (~val << l);
}
else if (mod7 == 3) {
	uint8_t l = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + 2 * (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
	uint8_t r = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + 2 * (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)hi + 2 * (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
	uint64_t temp = (val >> r) | (val << l);
	val = (temp >> 1) ^ (((temp >> 1) ^ (2 * temp)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
}
else if (mod7 == 4) {
	uint8_t l = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
	uint8_t r = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)hi + (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
	val = (~val >> l) | (~val << r);
}
else if (mod7 == 5) {
	uint64_t temp = val - (uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx);
	uint8_t l = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
	uint8_t r = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)hi + (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
	val = (temp >> l) | (temp << r);
}
else if (mod7 == 6) {
	val ^= (uint32_t)(hi + idx);
}

return val ^ key;
```

	uint64_t val = state[idx];
	const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(hash >> 32);

	if (mod7 == 0) {
		uint8_t r = (uint8_t)hi - 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi - 1) / 0x3F);
		uint8_t l = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi - 1) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)hi - 1) + 63;

	}
	else if (mod7 == 3) {
		val ^= (uint32_t)(hi + idx);
	}
	else if (mod7 == 4) {
		val = (~(uint64_t)(uint32_t)(hi + 2 * idx) ^ val) - (uint32_t)(hi + idx);
	}
	else if (mod7 == 5) {
		uint8_t l = (uint8_t)(((int)hi + 2 * (int)idx) % 0x3F) + 1;
		uint8_t r = 63 * (uint8_t)(((int)hi + 2 * (int)idx) / 0x3F) - ((uint8_t)hi + 2 * (uint8_t)idx) + 63;
		uint64_t temp = (val << l) | (val >> r);

		uint64_t step1 = (temp >> 1) ^ (((temp >> 1) ^ (2 * temp)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
		uint64_t step2 = (step1 >> 2) ^ (((step1 >> 2) ^ (4 * step1)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL);
		uint64_t step3 = (step2 >> 4) ^ (((step2 >> 4) ^ (16 * step2)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL);
		uint64_t step4 = (step3 >> 8) ^ (((step3 >> 8) ^ (step3 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL);
		val = _rotr64(step4, 32);
	}
	else if (mod7 == 6) {
		uint32_t v10 = hi + 2 * idx;
		uint8_t r = 63 * (uint8_t)(v10 / 0x3F) - (uint8_t)v10 + 63;
		uint8_t l = (uint8_t)(v10 % 0x3F) + 1;
		uint64_t temp = (val >> r) | (val << l);
		val = (temp >> 1) ^ (((temp >> 1) ^ (2 * temp)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
	}

	return val ^ key;
}

   Code:
```
    bones_c::bone_map bones_c::resolve( std::uintptr_t mesh )
    {
        if ( !mesh )
        {
            return {};
        }

        const auto skeletal_mesh = hv.read_vm<std::uintptr_t>( mesh + offsets.skinned_mesh_component.skeletal_mesh );
        if ( !skeletal_mesh )
        {
            return {};
        }

        {
            std::shared_lock lock( this->mutex );
            if ( const auto found = this->cache.find( skeletal_mesh ); found != this->cache.end( ) )
            {
                return found->second;
            }
        }

        std::unique_lock lock( this->mutex );

        if ( const auto existing = this->cache.find( skeletal_mesh ); existing != this->cache.end( ) )
        {
            return existing->second;
        }

        const auto bone_info = hv.read_vm<engine::tarray<engine::fmesh_bone_info>>( skeletal_mesh + offsets.skeletal_mesh.morph_targets + 0x20 );
        if ( !bone_info.has_data( ) || bone_info.count > 500 )
        {
            return {};
        }

        static constexpr std::pair<std::string_view, std::int32_t bone_map::*> entries[ ]
        {
            { "Head", &bone_map::head },
            { "Neck", &bone_map::neck },
            { "neck", &bone_map::neck },
            { "spine4", &bone_map::spine_04 },
            { "Spine4", &bone_map::spine_04 },
            { "spine_04", &bone_map::spine_04 },
            { "Splitter", &bone_map::pelvis },
            { "pelvis", &bone_map::pelvis },

            { "L_Shoulder", &bone_map::upperarl },
            { "upperarl", &bone_map::upperarl },
            { "L_Elbow", &bone_map::lowerarl },
            { "lowerarl", &bone_map::lowerarl },
            { "L_Hand", &bone_map::hand_l },
            { "hand_l", &bone_map::hand_l },

            { "R_Shoulder", &bone_map::upperarr },
            { "upperarr", &bone_map::upperarr },
            { "R_Elbow", &bone_map::lowerarr },
            { "lowerarr", &bone_map::lowerarr },
            { "R_Hand", &bone_map::hand_r },
            { "hand_r", &bone_map::hand_r },

            { "L_Hip", &bone_map::thigh_l },
            { "thigh_l", &bone_map::thigh_l },
            { "L_Knee", &bone_map::calf_l },
            { "calf_l", &bone_map::calf_l },
            { "L_Foot", &bone_map::foot_l },
            { "foot_l", &bone_map::foot_l },

            { "R_Hip", &bone_map::thigh_r },
            { "thigh_r", &bone_map::thigh_r },
            { "R_Knee", &bone_map::calf_r },
            { "calf_r", &bone_map::calf_r },
            { "R_Foot", &bone_map::foot_r },
            { "foot_r", &bone_map::foot_r }
        };

        bone_map map{};
        const auto raw = bone_info.fetch_all( );

        for ( const auto& bone : raw )
        {
            const auto bone_name = fname.to_string( static_cast< std::int32_t >( bone.name_index ) );

            if ( bone_name.empty( ) )
            {
                continue;
            }

            if ( const auto found = std::ranges::find( entries, std::string_view{ bone_name }, &std::pair<std::string_view, std::int32_t bone_map::*>::first ); found != std::end( entries ) )
            {
                map.*found->second = static_cast< std::int32_t >( &bone - &raw[ 0 ] );
            }
        }

        return this->cache[ skeletal_mesh ] = map;
    }
```
